AbyssText_Rule_Des_S2_PeriodDuty:
· Complete any gameplay in <color=#FFAF2C>"Periodic Conquest"</color> to earn <color=#FFAF2C>Bounty Points</color> and claim generous <color=#FFAF2C>item rewards</color>.
· In <color=#FFAF2C>"Hollow Zero - Lost Void"</color>, <color=#FFAF2C>Shadow Crystal Data</color> obtained each week through first-time rewards and regular rewards will be converted to Bounty Points at a 1:1 ratio.
· In <color=#FFAF2C>"Enigma of the Labyrinth"</color>, complete Weekly Commission missions each week to earn Bounty Points.
· As your Inter-Knot Lv. increases, <color=#FFAF2C>higher-level</color> Bounty Commissions will be unlocked at the next commission reset, offering <color=#FFAF2C>even greater</color> rewards upon completion.
· Bounty Commissions reset every Monday at 04:00.
AbyssVersionReminder_S2_Content_310:
<color=#FFFFFF>New Content</color>
• More Rewards: <color=#D9A600>New entries and corresponding rewards have been added</color> in Exploration Missions.

• New Tactical Prism Programs: Added Tactical Prism Programs for Agents <color=#D9A600>Remielle and Sigrid</color>, along with the corresponding Exploration Missions. (Sigrid's Tactical Prism Program will be made available at the same time as her Exclusive Channel.)

Accessoriy_Desc_412011313:
An Ether soundwave-resistant headgear developed by the Omond Research Station. Rumor has it that the design was inspired by a Public Security Officer that one of the designers looked up to.
Meow! Now you can explore the Divine Maze too, meow!
Accessoriy_Desc_412011314: A cross-shaped crown forged from starlight, said to have witnessed a long-awaited farewell a century in the making.
Accessoriy_Desc_412011315:
"Mr. K, dancing's easy! Just open your arms, then twirl to the beat... That's it!"
"Ehn-nhu... Nhe... (Hm? O—Okay, I'll give it a try...)"
Accessoriy_Desc_412011316: The nimblest ride, the coolest rider... only to get stuck at the longest red light.
Accessoriy_Desc_412011317:
"Magic shades, magic shades, who's the brightest of them all?"
"Put me on, and you'll have your answer."
"Okay, I did. Now what?"
"Now everyone else looks pretty gray."
"Which means you're the brightest in the world."

ActivityBigCat_SelectAvatarDesc_1311: Astra Yao is a powerful support Agent who can provide a variety of DMG bonuses to teammates and restore their HP. Make good use of her skills to enable your squad to trigger more frequent Quick Assists and Chain Attacks, dealing massive DMG to enemies.
ActivityBigCat_SelectAvatarDesc_1331: Vivian is a multi-functional Agent in Anomaly teams. She can trigger Abloom on targets afflicted with Attribute Anomaly to deal additional Anomaly DMG, while also boosting Corruption DMG and the Disorder DMG triggered when Corruption is resolved.
ActivityBigCat_SelectAvatarDesc_1461: Seed is a DPS Agent capable of dealing Electric DMG. She can team up with other Attack specialty Agents to form a dual-Attack team, suppressing enemies with overwhelming firepower.

So... our lady of her word, even if you're out playing everybody's therapist — don't forget the promise you made me~
So... our man of his word, even if you're out playing everybody's therapist — don't forget the promise you made me~
Of course I haven't. I've been working on it this entire time... Wait, you came all the way over here just to remind me about that?
Besides, who knows... The promise between us might just bring Sigrid a rather capable helper~
Yuzuha, Alice! Did you have a fun trip? Wait... Why is Remie with you?
We didn't really have a plan, but we came across so many beautiful places, and had all sorts of fun adventures! I'll tell you all about them when we get the chance!
Weren't you supposed to be an "ordinary tourist" here on vacation? How did you end up on staff?
You have been helping out a lot lately. So, are you finally admitting you're staff?
What else was a girl to do... All my friends have been pouring their hearts into the resort and this bonfire party.
Wait, wait, wait. You're not lumping me in with your "friends," are you? I'll admit you've helped us a bit, but calling us friends... Hm...
*Sigh* Miss Lucy still refuses to accept me...
Oh, Remielle! What brings you here so early? Has one of our souvenirs caught your eye? I would be happy to introduce it to you...
Hmm, it's mainly because our oh-so-busy manager promised me a gift — and I just wanted to check in on how it's coming along. Absolutely not because I'm worried she'd forget or anything!
Hmm, it's mainly because our oh-so-busy manager promised me a gift — and I just wanted to check in on how it's coming along. Absolutely not because I'm worried he'd forget or anything!
Excellent! Then today, Remielle shall take charge of the beachcombing and the souvenir shop. I am certain she will achieve results no worse than I have!
...Sigrid, relax. Lucy was just joking — she's not actually gonna have Remie take over your job. Go enjoy fishing. I've got things covered here.
Ah... I see. Hahaha, so that was a joke. Hahaha.
Well... you mentioned somewhere high up in your message. Sailboat Drinks Stand is the highest spot near the shop...
There's no need to thank me. I don't make promises I can't keep! And when it comes to gift-giving, there's no better outcome than knowing the recipient genuinely likes it.
Honestly... I wasn't thinking too deeply while making it. I simply went with what looked best, so there isn't really any deeper meaning behind it.
But now that I've given it to you, I think its meaning is yours to decide.
Heh, perhaps I don't need an answer to that question after all. At least for now... New Eridu's proving to be a rather interesting place.
New Eridu or not, hearing that from you still feels a little funny to me. Alright, Miss Ridu Representative, perhaps it's time you found something interesting for yourself as well~
New Eridu or not, hearing that from you still feels a little funny to me. Alright, Mr. Ridu Representative, perhaps it's time you found something interesting for yourself as well~
You're in such a hurry...
You... really powered your way into landing a shark on your first fishing trip? I feel like all those anglers who usually come home empty-handed are about to burst into tears.
But why are you disappointed? If you keep at it, you'll catch plenty more big ones!
But why are you disappointed? If you keep at it, you'll catch plenty more big ones!
*Cough*... Ah, um... thank you for the praise, but that is not what troubles me.
Because I had not prepared a tank large enough in advance, I went back to the resort to get one. By the time I returned, the shark I had already caught was nowhere to be found.
You mean... while you were away getting a tank, the shark you caught simply disappeared?
Exactly. I have been looking for any trace of where it might have gone.

Why don't we stop by the aquarium? Maybe we can narrow down exactly what kind of shark you're looking for. I'm sure you're aware that there are a lot of different shark species out there, and the resort's full of shark-themed attractions.
I see... Hm, I am rather curious about these creatures myself. Very well, please lead the way.
While I was passing by a group of three girls earlier, one of them — I am not sure which — suddenly placed this in my hand.
They then looked at me with great anticipation... but I was not sure how to reciprocate such a gift, so I simply thanked them and left.
Look! I even bought the double-barreled kind, and I've still got one shot left~
Then... pew pew~
*Sigh*...
Or perhaps... every midsummer in New Eridu is like this?
For some reason, when I came here, I had a feeling I might be able to have a long conversation with you tonight. Looks like my intuition has not failed me.
I came to look for you.
After all that beach time and barbecue, I wanted to take a little breather.
After all that beach time and barbecue, I wanted to take a little breather.
Is that so? I have unnecessarily made you worry once more... I apologize.
When I am alone, looking out at the horizon feels quite pleasant. But with someone beside me... it feels a little strange somehow.
Then let's talk about whatever comes to mind. Oh, have you and Norma figured out the terms of the bet, yet? Or, rather, what Norma will owe you? As far as I'm concerned, you've already won.
...So that's what you were wondering about. My apologies. At some point, I seem to have put that matter entirely out of my mind. Norma does not appear particularly concerned about it either.
When we return, I will invite her out for tea. Or... if I won, perhaps she's supposed to be treating me?
If you're planning to treat Norma to tea in return, count me in too. We won the bet together, after all. Oh, and... now that you've spent a few days at the resort, how are you feeling?
If you're planning to treat Norma to tea in return, count me in too. We won the bet together, after all. Oh, and... now that you've spent a few days at the resort, how are you feeling?
Of course. You are welcome to seek me out whenever my schedule permits. As for how I'm feeling right now...
Of course. You are welcome to seek me out whenever my schedule permits. As for how I'm feeling right now...
But recently, our ties with Ridu have grown ever stronger... and I have witnessed firsthand a kind of liveliness and joy unlike anything I once knew.
Looking out from here, I still cannot see my home in the sky. My past remains far beyond my reach... and yet, with every beat, my heart feels more vivid than ever.
I will look forward to that next time. Even from far away, beneath those distant skies.
You're here. Thank you for the reminder last night. A bet is a bet. The bonfire party was a success, so now it is Norma's turn to uphold her end of the bargain.
You're here. Thank you for the reminder last night. A bet is a bet. The bonfire party was a success, so now it is Norma's turn to uphold her end of the bargain.
No, I am not nervous... I was simply considering something. What do you think of having Norma help me build a fishing rod? Something like your "Hey Fairy" fishing rod...
I would just say, "Hey Norma," and it would start fishing on its own. Though... Maybe that is a bit too simple. Perhaps I should ask for something else...
I don't think "too simple" is the issue here... I doubt Norma would agree to that so willingly. But wow, you've already started thinking about what you want?
I don't think "too simple" is the issue here... I doubt Norma would agree to that so easily. But wow, you've already started thinking about what you want?
Then let us not waste time. Time to give her a call.
Hey Velina. Thank you for the suggestion. I will be sure to try that next time!
Pay it no mind. I am merely getting an early taste of the leisurely life that awaits me once I have claimed my rightful winnings.

Hey, Velina!
I don't know why, but I really wanted to try saying it too.

Hey, Velina!
I don't know why, but I really wanted to try saying it too.
*Cough* Anyway... Velina, we tried calling Norma, but she didn't pick up. Could you help us track her down?
Ahem... So, we just called Norma, but she didn't answer. Could you help us get in touch with her?
*Sputtering*—?! Who just said that in Sigrid's voice?! Fairy, are you impersonating her?!
Hey, Fairy! Let's have the judge announce the winner already!
Hey, Fairy! Let's have the judge announce the winner.

This bet wasn't fair at all! Sigrid had way too many people helping her!
The manager is one thing, but how did Remielle end up getting involved too?!
It was only a friendly wager. There is no need to take it so seriously, Norma... I will bring you some New Eridu souvenirs when I come back.
The rod and its functions are exactly as I imagined... but I cannot shake the feeling there is a small discrepancy somewhere...

A minute before we called, Sigrid was saying she wanted a fishing rod exactly like that...
You two are so in sync. I guess that's what years of working together gets you.

BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_300702: She trusts logic and cause-and-effect over just following orders. Lucky for us, she's the type you can actually reason with — that's how Remielle and I managed to get her on board with our operation. And once she's locked onto the right path, she sees it through without hesitation. Rational and reliable, you couldn't ask for a better partner.
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_302402: The En-Nah Gang's "Revelation" turns out to be intelligence connected to the "Original Sunbringer." The En-Nah Gang's Bangboo treat the "Revelation" as a distress signal from Sunbringer, and believe the current three Sunbringers are all fakes. No wonder they're unhappy with both the current three Sunbringers and the Roscaelifer authorities.
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_302502: Remielle's hideout in Roscaelifer is the En-Nah Gang's turf. Thanks to her and the En-Nah Gang, we had room to turn things around after getting set up by Girtablullu. After we took down Girtablullu's scheme together, her Enchainer transformation deepened, and she tried to shoulder everything on her own. But she's not shaking me this time — we're "partners-in-crime" now.
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_3126: Yet another Sunbringer who's a complete departure from the rest. Compared to the impressions left by the other two, she's far more approachable — and far more headstrong. To make sure no one with ulterior motives could exploit the window of opportunity, she and Remielle quietly struck a deal in the shadows, keeping the truth behind the incidents that befell Dracaene and Truvia tightly under wraps.
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_3127: She's already excelling at her day job — Bangboo repair. But she wasn't content with just fixing them up. She kept pushing to develop gentler, more comprehensive care services, which is how The Fuzzy Wrench came to be. Safe to say, her love for Bangboo runs deep.
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_3128: A celebrated fashion icon among the Bangboo, who believes charm is the most important thing in the world. Under his philosophy, the Chic Bootique has become the ultimate Bangboo fashion destination in all of Roscaelifer. He has a passion for rating every customer's charm, and in the eyes of the Bangboo, Kahkiboo's score is the most authoritative measure of allure there is.
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_3129: A massive Bangboo that's been around since the first-generation Void Hunter era, packing computational power way beyond what your average Bangboo can handle. Rumored to be the Central Computing Hub's prototype in Norma's lab. Even the Gang Boss answers to this one — maybe it's the real kingpin of the En-Nah Gang.
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_3130: Spyboo's intelligence shack is located in an underground shop on Gear Street and claims it can "dig up any information." After checking it out through Eous's eyes, it turns out that's true. It has every kind of information, including fake information.
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_3131: Forboos runs his bottle cap stall out of a corner in Emerald Park. His goal is clear — collect as many bottle caps as possible and corner the bottle cap economy of Roscaelifer. Talk about ambition.
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_3132: Boodiac's Divination Parlor parlor is on the basement level of Amber Hall. Boodiac's divination methods are surprisingly scientific — less like reading fate and more like a personality assessment. Her apprentice, on the other hand, practices something that actually feels like real fortune-telling.
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_3133: Running into her again in Roscaelifer wasn't something I ever expected. But it came as no surprise that we both have such complicated feelings about the past. Unfortunately, Truvia was caught up in Girtablullu's scheme and ended up as one of its victims. Fortunately, her life isn't in danger, and I... I won't have to watch someone I know die before my eyes again.
BMW_CharacterKeyDesc_3134: The Porcelloy used for the treatment was all provided by her. Based on our brief encounter at the tea party and what others have said about her, she's sharp-tongued but surprisingly easy to get along with, unlike the impression the other Administrative Directors tend to give. If I ever get the chance to visit Vyrium, I'm sure we'll have more opportunities to talk.

BMW_EventContent_3130: Daily Shop Recommendation: Boodiac's Divination Parlor, basement of Amber Hall on Beckford Street. Owner Boodiac offers readings on your near-term fortune, and if any Bangboo are curious about their romantic prospects, the shop's apprentice is worth a visit too. I've tried it myself, and it's surprisingly accurate. Overall, I'd give it four stars. The one star it loses is because you have to book an appointment with the Bangboo dorm manager before you can enter the Amber Hall.
BMW_EventContent_3131: Has anyone else noticed that the bottle caps circulating in Clink Market have been way scarcer lately? And it's not just the quantity — the quality's taken a serious nosedive too. Used to be you could dig up some rare finds, but now it's all just the same boring, run-of-the-mill stuff you see everywhere... What's happening to our bottle cap market... where's it all headed...
BMW_EventContent_3132:
On a friend's recommendation, I tried The Fuzzy Wrench's automatic maintenance service, and it really was great!
The only downside is that the roller seemed to spin a little too fast. Is everyone else used to it? I felt like my gyroscope was wobbling after I came out of the roller. Is that normal?
BMW_EventContent_3133:
Accepting commissions for intelligence gathering and analysis. Physical storefront available.
Intelligence submissions welcome. Rewards paid in bottle caps.
Professional team you can trust. If you can think of it, we can do it.
BMW_EventContent_3134: One of the troupes at Spotlight Theater has gone missing today. Has anyone spotted our theater's Bangboo somewhere else?
BMW_EventContent_3135:
Don't ride it — it's not a Ferris wheel, it's a giant pendulum.
The kind that'll end you.
BMW_EventContent_3136: I'm disappointed in the En-Nah Gang. I thought the En-Nah Gang's Bangboo all had principles and stuck to their code, but their leader openly protected an outsider who broke the gang's rules right in front of everyone. The En-Nah Gang isn't the gang I believed in anymore.
BMW_EventContent_3137:
The Nimbus Ring Line — on time, convenient, and connected everywhere. But don't forget: even the best hover buses are driven by Bangboo! Every Bangboo has what it takes to drive a hover bus, and the next great driver could be YOU!
Ready to find out? Head to FastFly, get trained up, breeze through the exam, and become a proud bus driver!
BMW_EventContent_3138: You've heard of The Fuzzy Wrench's Bangboo face masks, right? Well, I've got some great news! I've completely cracked the formula, and now I can mass-produce them at a way lower price! Come to me whenever you need one!
BMW_EventContent_3139: While helping my new classmate clean their room, I accidentally knocked this dancing Bangboo figurine onto the floor — and it started glowing! It actually looks pretty cool. Let's call it a little surprise gift for my new classmate!
BMW_EventContent_3140: The rides on display at Evolution Motors are straight-up unroadworthy... why would the boss even modify them like that?

BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313003: Then I got hit by a large transport railcar, but I walked away without a scratch.
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313004: Not just lucky — it's absolutely, ridiculously lucky.
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313101: So I'm not the only one who feels this way…
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313102: Wait, so who's gonna cover the bottle caps I'm short on?
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313103: I know just the spot: There's a shop in Emerald Central Park that specializes in all kinds of rare bottle caps.
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313104: Word is, most of the rare bottle caps on the market end up there! I've already scored a ton myself!
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313201: Spin faster! The greater the centrifugal force, the quicker it dries. It's science.
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313202: That was way too fast. I thought the roller was about to launch into orbit!
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313203: You hit a glitch. It shouldn't spin that fast under normal conditions.

BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313303: Bro, you never told me where your shop is.

BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313401: A film crew just roaming around like that? The Spotlight Theater crew is way too laid-back.
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313402: I can't just be running around out there aimlessly! That's exactly why I need to find them!
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313403: I saw it! A few Bangboos from the theater said they needed to rehearse, so they bolted straight into the Hollow!
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313404: What? You actually went to a place that dangerous?
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313405: Oh, rehearsal? Well, nothing we can do about that — just let 'em go.
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313502: What was going through your mind the moment you stepped onto the Ferris wheel?
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313503: What's waiting on the other side of the Ferris wheel entrance...
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313601: Things changed a long time ago! Why are there still people out here thinking the En-Nah Gang is the same as it was over a decade ago?
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313602: Don't be talking trash about the En-Nah Gang! We might disband, but we'll never sell out!
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313701: Tap the link in the comments to sign up and score an exclusive limited-time deal!
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313702: Did you pass? Do you need to pay and retake it if you don't?
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313703: The standards for Bangboo licensing are no joke — anyone claiming you can fast-track it is straight-up false advertising.
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313704: Who do you think you are, acting like you know everything?
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313705: I drive the bus! Night shift!
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313801: Hey, the face mask is a freebie that comes with the care package. No charge.
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313802: No worries, you'll definitely end up choosing my face mask in the end!
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313803: Why? Are your face masks somehow better quality? And you definitely can't beat free of charge when it comes to price, right?
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313804: Because my face mask is "Bangboo Crafted"!
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313805: And that's literally the least of your mask's problems.
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313901: So where can I get my hands on these amazing ornaments?
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313902: Lowkey tempted. Drop a link and tell me where I can buy this.
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_313903: Honestly, I have no idea. That ornament's been sitting in Amber Hall for as long as I can remember...

BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_314002: Damn, you're so fine! They should put you on display in a store window!
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_314003: Exactly, he's so good-looking. He's basically a display model!
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_314101: Treasure Detection Clues? What kind of new treasure hunt event is this?
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_314102: Would a Bangboo really return something to its owner after finding it?
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_314103: Finders keepers, losers weepers — I found it, so it's mine!
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_314201: Isn't there a shop in Emerald Central Park that specializes in collecting bottle caps? They must've snagged them all already, right?
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_314202: Alright, pack it up. Can't compete with the pros.
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_314203: Friends, please don't use your own interests to challenge other Bangboo's work.
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_314204: If you're gonna spam the comments, at least switch up your accounts...
BMW_NetChatAnwserKey_314301: Here's a bit of a situation: This "Cap" search notice has zero info about the owner. How am I supposed to return the bottle cap I found?

BMW_TreasureDesc_05:
The Bangboo Prince encountered a fox who was an excellent hunter
Though, while hunting, he always breaks trees and branches along his way
He wasn't like a fox, more like a bear, The Bangboo Prince thought
Why not avoid those trees, asked the Bangboo Prince
Why should I avoid them, asked the fox
If you put too much effort in worrying over unrelated things, you won't be able to become a true hunter
If you want to defeat the Bangboo King, you need such decisiveness
Why are you always contemplating, my friend? The fox nudged the Bangboo Prince with his nose, confused
If you knew I were a Bangboo too, would you also cut me down with decisiveness
The Bangboo Prince thought to himself, but did not ask aloud
Because the fox felt so warm
BMW_TreasureDesc_06:
A long, long time ago, there lived a strange king
The king was greedy and cruel, selfish and arrogant
He guarded his treasure zealously, relentlessly
Terrified someone would come and steal it away
BMW_TreasureUnlockDesc_5:
Meridian Hall's secret has split in two: one hopped on a bus heading far away, the other slipped into a hidden pipe.
Find a fissure that leads to the bus stop, or track down a helper who can squeeze through the pipe. Either will take you to where the secret went.
BMW_TreasureUnlockDesc_6:
The En-Nah Gang may not grasp the meaning of secrets, but they know secrets need to be kept.
The Retroflux Zone is dark and treacherous, and the En-Nah Gang guards its secrets with great care. If you want to uncover where the story begins, harness the power of your mechanical allies, slip past the guardians' watchful eyes, and find the answers buried deep underground.

BigSceneMapDes_410010142:
[Meridian Hall]
A research facility built under the direction of Lady Sunbringer. It houses prototype units used to validate the Rosetta Data. Most of the facilities within are made of Porcelloy, making the emergency restoration device left behind by Lady Sunbringer essential for anyone wishing to navigate the area without hindrance.
BigSceneMapDes_410010174:
Suburbs Illusion
The southern area of Divine Maze: Papago Hollow, where illusions of suburban locations such as Blazewood, the Outer Ring Industrial Park, and Fantasy Resort intermingle. A strange fog hangs over the illusory sea to the north, making it impossible to see what lies on the opposite shore...
BigSceneMapDes_410010175:
Janus Illusion
The northern area of Divine Maze: Papago Hollow, where illusions of locations across Janus Quarter, including Sixth Street, Brant Street Construction Site, and Lumina Square, intermingle. A subway also appears to be running continuously underground.
BigSceneMapDes_410010176:
Omond Research Station
Located at the heart of the Papago Hollow, Omond Research Station was formerly operated by Helios Academy and is now administered by HAND. The project aims to establish surveillance and control over the Papago Hollow, using Omond Flint's Porcelloy technology and specially engineered energy waves to suppress Ether energy from within.

BossChallenge_Rule1:
<color=#FFFFFF>[Introduction]</color>
<color=#FFAF2C>Deadly Assault</color> is a high-risk enemy simulation training system provided by the HIA, designed specifically for Hollow Zero. It uses real-time data and simulation technology from various high-activity hostile entities within the great Hollows.

<color=#FFFFFF>[High-Risk Enemy Challenge]</color>
Deadly Assault is designed to simulate high-Ether activity combat scenarios, focusing on highly dangerous hostile entities. Each session of Deadly Assault features three high-risk entities, with their <color=#FFAF2C>weaknesses and resistances</color> revealed in the challenge details. Enemies grow stronger as their health decreases. Deploy Agents strategically based on the enemy's combat information.

<color=#FFFFFF>[Lineup Lock and Reset]</color>
During one session of Deadly Assault, the <color=#FFAF2C>Agents and Bangboo used cannot be repeated</color>. Once a challenge is completed, the squad Lineup is locked. To change your Lineup, use the reset feature after the Lineup is locked. Resetting will clear previously obtained battle scores but retain the highest total star record and rewards earned.

<color=#FFFFFF>[Selectable Buff Effects]</color>
To accommodate diverse combat scenarios, <color=#FFAF2C>you can select specific buffs for your squad when challenging enemies</color>. Choose the buffs that best complement your Lineup for an advantage in battle.

<color=#FFFFFF>[Best Total Score and Leaderboard]</color>
Your best total score is <color=#FFAF2C>the highest combat score obtained in the current season's Trial Mode</color>. Upon obtaining <color=#FFAF2C>9 stars</color>, the current season leaderboard will be unlocked. Resetting the lineup won't refresh your best total score or leaderboard placement.
BossChallenge_Rule2:
<color=#FFFFFF>[Unlock Conditions]</color> 
Obtain <color=#FFAF2C>9 stars</color> in this season's Trial Mode to unlock Adversity Mode. Resetting your challenge lineup will not reset your Adversity Mode unlock status.

<color=#FFFFFF>[Special Purge Directive]</color> 
The trekking traveler grips their blade, and the summit-scaling warrior is crowned in glory.
Here, face the most perilous foes and claim the victor's crown!
The Adversity Mode features only 1 High-Risk entity. Intel regarding the enemy's <color=#FFAF2C>weaknesses and resistances</color> is revealed in the challenge details. As the enemy's HP decreases, their strength will gradually increase. Please deploy your Agents strategically based on the enemy combat intel.

 <color=#FFFFFF>[Best Total Score and Leaderboard]</color>
Your best total score is <color=#FFAF2C>the highest combat score obtained in the current season's Adversity Mode</color>. Upon obtaining <color=#FFAF2C>3 stars</color>, the current season leaderboard will be unlocked. Resetting the lineup won't refresh your best total score or leaderboard placement.

 <color=#FFFFFF>[Exclusive Rewards]</color> 
In Adversity Mode, obtaining 2 stars/3 stars will <color=#FFAF2C>immediately grant time-limited namecard and dynamic avatar</color> rewards after the finalization. The validity period of these time-limited items is equal to the total duration of the current season of Deadly Assault. For example, if the current season of Deadly Assault lasts for 14 days, the obtained dynamic avatar will be valid for 14 days. If the item is obtained while it is still valid, its duration will be <color=#FFAF2C>extended</color> by 14 days.
BossChallenge_UnlockTip_Hard: Unlock Adversity Mode by obtaining 9 stars in the current season's Trial Mode

CardDesc_30052:
An Ethereal that returned from the Cinderglow Lake.
Once a Dead End Butcher defeated by the Overlord Pompey, it was cast into the Cinderglow Lake. Yet instead of being reduced to ash, its body became encased in crystals formed from the burning byproducts of Ether.
Within the flames, its outer shell melted away and reformed again, each time gathering new layers of crystal. After enduring an endless torment resembling the depths of hell, it emerged with an armor-like body and gained the ability to move freely through fire.
After a long wandering through a world that seemed to have forgotten it, the creature finally discovered a spatial fissure at the bottom of the fire lake and entered the Divine Maze, Papago Hollow.
But that place was nothing more than another hell.
It appears to have suffered a crushing defeat. Ever since, it has been driven by an unknown force, obsessively collecting the special Ether scattered throughout the labyrinth.
Yet it can no longer tell whether what lies within is salvation... or blasphemy.

"Every time that walking bonfire comes through, the temperature goes through the roof. I want hazard pay for this!"
CardDesc_30053:
A notorious Ethereal that prowls the Divine Maze of Papago Hollow.
If Papago Hollow's Hallucinogenic Soundscape is the trap that lures prey into the maze, then Ulidim is the hound that hunts down those unfortunate enough to become trapped inside it.
Ulidim's most terrifying ability is its power to emerge from any location or object within the Hollow's illusion, whether from a forgotten corner of the labyrinth or an old keepsake filled with a victim's cherished memories. The shock of its sudden appearance delivers a devastating blow to both body and mind, earning it the nickname "Hound of Old." Its true ability lies in ignoring the illusions woven by the Hallucinogenic Soundscape and moving freely through the Hollow itself.
Because of its terrifying nature and appearance, Ulidim is one of the most common and most feared threats encountered during Exploration Missions into Papago Hollow. Among the Bangboo stationed at Papago Outpost, even the mention of its name inspires fear, and frightening legends about Ulidim have spread from one Bangboo to another.
There are multiple Ulidim within the Hollow. Their routine task is to patrol designated areas and routes, maintaining the stability of the Hallucinogenic Soundscape. Should they detect an intruder interfering with the Hollow's stable expansion, they will immediately pursue and kill the offender.
"Within that labyrinth that has a beginning but no end, perhaps being devoured by the dreadful hound is a mercy in itself."
CardDesc_40008:
A beast standing at the edge of the abyss, its burning desire laid bare, sought to devour the seed of ultimate evil and ascend as the abyss's chosen Messenger.

The Enchainer larvae known as "Girtablullu" attempted to consume the "Karma Core" within Dracaene Sunbringer, but failed to complete its ascension. The "Stagnant Aberrant" was the result of that failed transformation. Its Ether-Sculpted body could no longer withstand the power of the "Karma Core," spiraling into uncontrollable mutation. Its grotesque form now lashes out with a malice born from twisted ambition and sheer greed.

"You can't just eat everything you see. It's not good for you."
CardDesc_40009:
A High-Risk simulation unit modeled from real combat data. Through deep reconstruction and overfitting of its original combat logic, certain units have surpassed standard performance limits, presenting an extremely high level of combat threat.

A highly dangerous scorpion-like Ethereal that fights with an ash-gray lance. Its powerful lower body and agile upper torso combine to create a combat machine that is both devastating and highly mobile. By burrowing through "wormholes," it traverses the Scamall Hollow in search of its next victim to fall into the nest. Unlike Ethereals transformed from corrupted wildlife or machinery, this creature was spawned by something far more terrifying, carrying an Ether signature unlike any other.

"There's no Insect Phobia Mode in the settings!"
CardQuote_30053: — "Rookie's Guide to the Hollow: Papago's Memoirs"
CardQuote_40008: — An Ethereal ecologist, whose latest research interest is maintaining a balanced diet
CardQuote_40009: — A Guard Squad member who is addicted to VR combat games and terrified of arthropods
CardSkillDesc_30039: In combat, Haytor uses Phantoms to deceive opponents and launch surprise attacks; after entering Miasmic Field, Haytor can summon even larger Phantoms to attack alongside him. During this time, successfully parrying the large Phantoms' attacks will weaken the <Term:2000002>Miasmic Shield</Term>.
CardSkillDesc_30050: During combat, the Metamorphosed - Scorpse conceals itself and attacks through its Mimics. Successfully triggering a Defensive Assist or Dodge Counter against a Mimic will knock the Metamorphosed - Scorpse down, leaving it staggered for a short time. Upon activating the <Term:2000001>Corruptive Barrier</Term>, it summons additional Mimics to attack in coordination with it. It can also spit venom filled with Blastcrawler egg sacs, causing multiple explosive hits.
CardSkillDesc_30052:
In combat, the Infernal Revenant unleashes powerful attacks with its weapon. After taking a certain amount of DMG, it enters the "Infernal State." While in the "Infernal State," some attacks can only be blocked by successfully performing a Chain Parry. The Infernal Revenant also summons a rain of fire that continuously damages Agents. Shattering each flint grants an "Infernal Shield" and restores Energy. Shattering all three flints will end the rain of fire.
Infernal Revenant no longer possesses weaknesses or resistances in Operation Bagel gameplay.
CardSkillDesc_30053:
In combat, Ulidim switches weapons as the battle unfolds and launches surprise attacks using teleportation. Dodge its thrown spears and perform a Chain Defensive against its relentless combos to gradually gain the upper hand.
Ulidim will no longer have attribute weaknesses or resistances in Operation Bagel.
CardSkillDesc_40008: During the combat, Girtablullu - Stagnant Aberrant will activate the Corruptive Barrier multiple times and wield a variety of weapons. During its first activation, it won't be Dazed, so break through and force it into a Stun state as quickly as possible. When the barrier is activated again, it will continuously charge, enhancing its Corruptive Barrier. Keep dealing massive damage to suppress its charge may give you the upper hand.
CardSkillDesc_40009: During the combat, Girtablullu will frequently create Ether wormholes to teleport around the field and lauch surprise attacks. It will also unleash various skills that require two Agents to guard together. Successfully performing Chain Parry will quickly weaken its Corruptive Barrier. The wings scorched by the blazing sun once fell to the pale earth, into a lightless chasm. Then fall... She will bear it all. The weight, the darkness, those defiant follies, those lives that slipped away...
In that long slumber forgotten by time, even sadness faded away. Pain and despair faded too... As did joy. As did memory. All withered away, for all is vanity.
A hundred years passed in the blink of an eye. Kingdoms upon the earth fell and rose anew, yet she never awoke.
But no matter how much unspeakable darkness lay buried within her heart, a bird cannot pretend not to see the coming of spring.

ElementIconText_Lumen:
Upon entering the battlefield, a <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Agent</color> undergoes <color=#D9A600>Attribute Flux</color> based on the Base attribute of the next Agent in the squad. After undergoing <color=#D9A600>Attribute Flux</color>, when the Agent deals <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>, it is treated as dealing attribute DMG of the attribute targeted by <color=#D9A600>Attribute Flux</color>.
When Agents deal <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>, they do not accumulate Anomaly Buildup. Some skills of <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux</color> Agents can directly apply <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> to enemies.
If an enemy has <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> and is about to enter an Anomaly state, that Anomaly state will be <color=#FFA9DD>Refringed</color>. After <color=#FFA9DD>Refringe</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly Effect Strength</color> of that Anomaly state will be enhanced based on the <color=#FFA9DD>Refringe Coefficient</color> of the <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> provider, increasing the total DMG dealt by that Anomaly state.

HCBoss_Desc_Normal_1:
[Special Challenge] Prevent Integrated - Primordial Nightmare from performing no more than 3 State Switches throughout the entire battle.

[Stage Overview]
At the start of combat and upon recovering from Stun, the Boss will have half its Daze gauge filled.
When <color=#FFAF2C>Swift Flying Sword</color> hits the Boss, it prevents them from performing a <color=#FFAF2C>State Switch</color> for a period of time.
Whenever the Boss's <color=#FFAF2C>accumulated Daze</color> or <color=#FFAF2C>reduced Miasmic Shield</color> reaches a certain threshold, it will attempt a <color=#FFAF2C>State Switch</color>. If it succeeds, the Boss's current <color=#FFAF2C>Daze</color> and <color=#FFAF2C>Miasmic Shield</color> values undergo a <color=#FFAF2C>proportional conversion</color>.
When Agents perform a Defensive Assist, Perfect Dodge, or Ultimate, or apply an Attribute Anomaly to the enemy, the cooldown of <color=#FFAF2C>Swift Flying Sword</color> is reduced.
While the Miasmic Shield is active, Agents <color=#FFAF2C>blocking the Boss's attacks will additionally reduce the Miasmic Shield value</color>.

Intro_100100004: Shepherd has returned with a special commission tied to the founding master of Proxies. You need to venture into the Papago Hollow and search for the Labyrinth Carrot left behind by Joyous.
Intro_100100005: Upon entering Papago, you encounter the familiar Janus Quarter. It turns out that the special Ether within Papago can extract the mental memories of those who enter and mimic the corresponding space.
Intro_100100006: Shortly upon retrieving the Labyrinth Carrot, HAND and White Star Institute operatives show up to intercept it. In the middle of the standoff, an Ether Activity detection device suddenly triggers an alarm.
Intro_100100007: Just as the Labyrinth Carrot is about to be taken away, HAND and White Star Institute operatives show up to intercept it. In the middle of the standoff, an Ether Activity detection device suddenly triggers an alarm.
Intro_100100008: While the group is attempting to escape the special Ethereal, Eous is unfortunately caught. The mysterious hound-like Ethereal grabs Eous and vanishes into the fissure behind it...
Intro_100100009: Eous being kidnapped and taken away is a hard pill to swallow. After taking a moment to collect themselves, the group agrees that the best move is to temporarily pull back from the Hollow through the fissure and figure out the next steps from there.
Intro_100100010: The fissure leads everyone to a mysterious research station, whose master control construct suggests it can try to restore the hub to search for Eous. Meanwhile, Nanson departs temporarily to seek assistance from HAND.
Intro_100100011: As you finish checking Boorilliant, Nanson arrives at the research station with Tsukishiro Yanagi. After deliberation, the group decides to first retrieve the storage unit from the Hollow and try to restore the hub's functions to locate Eous.
Intro_100100012: Entering the Papago Hollow once again, Nanson warns that HAND has previously discovered highly dangerous Ether sound waves within — the Cacophony, which corrupts the mind and alters the environment. It's crucial to avoid its influence.
Intro_100100013: Between their bickering, the two rescued Bangboo reveal that it was the Labyrinth Carrot inside Eous that attracted the Ethereals, and that they have spotted Eous in the aquarium area.
Intro_100100014: D. Ata searches the retrieval records and locates the keycard needed to unlock the aquarium. However, Ether Activity in that area is running high, so some combat upgrades from Ray are needed before it's safe to explore.
Intro_100100015: In the keycard retrieval area, the group also encounters numerous strange hematite crystals. Worried about high-risk Ethereals, the group presses on toward the aquarium area to rescue Eous.
Intro_100100016: At the aquarium, only torn remnants of Eous's scarf are found. In a panic, {M#Belle}{F#Wise} discovers Dennies on the ground, a clue that seems to have been left behind by Eous.
Intro_100100017: At the end of the energy flow, the group discovers a larger hematite crystal. Considering the connection between the clue left behind by Eous and the hematite, the group decides to collect some samples to bring back for analysis.
Intro_100100019: According to Eous's account, he wasn't harmed even after being taken by the fire Ethereal. It seems the Ethereal only wanted to listen to the strange sound waves emitted by the Labyrinth Carrot.
Intro_100100020: In the meeting footage played by D. Ata, the former Lady Sunbringer, Joyous, and a young man named Omond Flint are seen together, laughing and joking as they settle on the name "Operation Bagel."
Intro_100100021: In a special area, Penny, a criminal who once lured HAND into Papago, is on trial. When Nanson questions her for intel on Deryn Ata, she demands more in return before she'll talk.
Intro_105800001: With Remie, you watch "This Is How I Am," a retro documentary that holds a unique significance for many and stirs up memories of the past for Remie.
Intro_105800002: After helping Remie turn down an unwanted invitation from a suspicious investigator, you learn through a series of questions that she's been observing Hollow Zero and get a glimpse into the daily lives of the first-generation Void Hunters.
Intro_105800003: You pay a visit to Remie's place on a dreamy moonlit night, using a game as a bridge to try and untangle the knots in her heart. Sure, she turns the tables and messes with you, but in the end... you've definitely gotten to know her better.
Intro_105900001: You watch the film Oh~ Sweetie together with Sigrid. A movie date, a heartbeat that quietly quickens, warmth that creeps into the cheeks — the essential ingredients of an old-fashioned date.
Intro_105900002: The cyber crisis that has sent the Knight Commander into a full-blown panic... turns out to be nothing but a phishing scam?
Intro_105900003: The scar over Sigrid's left eye is one of Roscaelifer's legendary mysteries... when in reality, it was just an accidental wound from a training session she had as a kid. Make sure you keep this secret safe for Sigrid!
Intro_110600024: Yuzuha and Alice show up outside the video store with some good news — Fantasy Resort is gearing up to host a bonfire party. After a bit of convincing, {F#Belle and Wise}{M#Wise and Belle} decide to head out to the resort to help set things up and enjoy a little vacation while they're at it.
Intro_110600025: Sigrid claims she came to the resort because of a bet with Norma. After calling Velina and learning that Sigrid is the party's liaison officer, the siblings promise Velina to help Sigrid fulfill her end of the bet.
Intro_110600026: Sigrid meets Lucy outside the souvenir shop, gets the full rundown on running the shop and organizing the party, then tries her hand at making souvenirs, only to come up short. The group decides to split up the work, dividing tasks between crafting and selling the souvenirs.
Intro_110600028: Favco, the security company manager, claims the trouble in the beachcombing area stemmed from a Hollow and that the situation is urgent. Skeptical of his account, {F#Belle}{M#Wise} and the others decide to find another place to talk things over so as not to disrupt the resort's operations.
Intro_110600029: Remielle, encountered by chance, comes clean to Lucy about stealing the W-Engine during the Hollow Champion competition. After {F#Belle}{M#Wise} clears up the misunderstanding, a sudden downpour hits the resort, and the group reaches a consensus to venture into the Hollow together and see what is going on.
Intro_110600030: Back at the resort, you run into Therese, who has come to check on things after the sea calmed down. After a quick rundown of the situation, Therese makes the call on the spot — come dawn, she will terminate the contract with Typhos Security.
Intro_110600031: Before leaving, Remie asks for a special souvenir, and {F#Belle}{M#Wise} promises she will have it.
Intro_110600032: In front of the souvenir shop, Favco claims he will resolve the issue himself and accuses the resort of lacking integrity; {F#Belle}{M#Wise} seizes the opportunity to expose his facade, while Lucy and {F#Wise}{M#Belle} arrive with key evidence in hand.
Intro_110600033: {M#Wise}{F#Belle} uses the evidence at hand to expose every one of Favco's cover-ups in one fell swoop.
Intro_110600034: With no more ground to stand on, Favco and his partner throw out a few threats before retreating. After a quick discussion, the group agrees that running the shop and getting ready for the evening party are the top priorities for now, while dealing with Favco will have to wait until the Public Security Officer and the others arrive.
Intro_110600035: Recent business earnings have been more than enough to cover the key preparations for the bonfire night. The group decides to split up and handle different tasks. Remie shows up and offers to help {M#Wise}{F#Belle} scout a location and set up the bonfire.
Intro_110600036: Favco, dressed in a swimsuit and claiming to be a tourist, has his scheme seen through by the group, prompting him to slip away to a deserted beach; {F#Belle}{M#Wise} and the others see this as the perfect opportunity to settle things once and for all, and give chase.
Intro_110600037: Deliver the invitations to the summer bonfire party into the hands of your friends.
Intro_110600038: Sigrid shares some subtle thoughts about life in New Eridu. {F#Belle}{M#Wise} reassures her that there's no need to overthink it — she's already well-adapted to life in New Eridu.
Intro_110600039: Remie joins the conversation, raising the point that "Sigrid doesn't need to blend into New Eridu." After the two discuss the matter, Remie reminds {F#Belle}{M#Wise} not to forget the promise.
Intro_110600040: Yuzuha and Alice return from their trip and visit the souvenir shop with Remie. The two decide to make the most of their time before the evening party by exploring the resort's new attractions, while Remie expresses her desire to get involved in running the business.
Intro_110600041: {F#Belle}{M#Wise} finds Remie and presents her with a handmade keepsake. Remie expresses her delight and gratitude, then asks {F#Belle}{M#Wise} about the meaning behind the keepsake's design. {F#Belle}{M#Wise} responds that the meaning is Remie's to define.
Intro_110600042: Sigrid is a little distressed that the shark she caught while fishing alone has gone "missing." {F#Belle}{M#Wise} offers to help Sigrid track it down and suggests heading to the aquarium to check out what this shark actually looks like.
Intro_110600043: A bonfire blazes beneath the night sky as {F#Belle}{M#Wise} and the others enjoy this rare and special campfire gathering.
Intro_110600044: Sigrid opens up to {F#Belle}{M#Wise} about her thoughts on the recent series of events, laying out her duty in no uncertain terms. {F#Belle}{M#Wise} expresses {F#her}{M#his} hope to meet again in New Eridu someday.
Intro_110600045: The siblings meet up with Sigrid. {F#Belle}{M#Wise} asks for Sigrid's thoughts on the bet, and Sigrid wishes for a smart fishing rod that automatically casts whenever she shouts "Hey, Norma!" The three of them decide to call Norma.
Intro_110600046: Velina announces over the phone that Sigrid has won the bet, and the prize Norma puts up just happens to be the smart fishing rod Sigrid has her eye on.
Intro_122000001: Same as always, breakfast is shared over small talk with Cissia, Billy, and {F#Wise}{M#Belle}. After the others have headed out to run errands, {F#Belle}{M#Wise} waits alone for "that guy" to show up as promised...
Intro_122000002: After learning that the incident at the tea party was the work of the En-Nah Gang, you have a brief conversation with Lindverne, the third "Sunbringer" you haven't met before. She comes across as remarkably approachable...
Intro_122000005: Norma has finished restoring Bangboo Toby's memories and has invited Belle and Wise to review the footage... She seems to have found some clues pointing to the mastermind behind it all.
Intro_122000006: In the memory footage, Toby was shoved into some kind of machine by a suspicious man believed to be the real culprit. And at the location where this footage was recorded, there appear to be signs belonging to the En-Nah Gang...
Intro_122000007: After getting intel on the En-Nah Gang from Norma, the crew decides to head to Clink Market to gather more intel. With Cissia's help, they score the key item needed to move around Clink Market — bottle caps.
Intro_122000008: Masquerading as a Bangboo from the En-Nah Gang is no easy feat... Thanks to the intel gathered from Knowaboo, {F#Belle}{M#Wise} manages to pass the Guardboo's test without a hitch.
Intro_122000010: The "Great One" the Bangboo kept mentioning turns out to be Remielle! After you explain the reason for coming here, Remie offers to help, but in return, she needs you to assist with her investigation into Girtablullu.
Intro_122000011: Upon reaching the lower floors of the Retroflux Zone, {F#Belle}{M#Wise} assesses that the likelihood of encountering a Singularity Leakage is high and asks Remielle to follow orders. While she agrees, she always seems a little distracted.
Intro_122000012: {F#Belle}{M#Wise} begins extracting data from the downed strange Mech and stumbles upon something unexpected.
Intro_122000013: In one of the retrieved photos, Serpico's figure is spotted.
Intro_122000014: When rescued by Remielle, it seems to trigger a resonance — {F#Belle}{M#Wise} falls into darkness and catches glimpses of Remielle's memories. Remielle in high spirits at a medal ceremony, Remielle brimming with confidence as she entered an experiment... and Remielle saying goodbye to Beliora Vike.
Intro_122000017: Back at Amber Hall, you fill {F#Wise}{M#Belle} in on what has happened. {F#Wise}{M#Belle} suggests bringing it up with Truvia at the welcome banquet hosted by Lady Dracaene the night after next. As night falls, {F#Belle}{M#Wise} can't sleep and begins sorting through the data collected.
Intro_122000018: {F#Wise}{M#Belle} finds {F#Belle}{M#Wise} fast asleep in the room after working so hard, decides not to wake {F#her}{M#him}, and finishes the rest of the work alone.
Intro_122000019: {F#Belle}{M#Wise}, along with Cissia and Billy, traces the path of the Singularity Leakage further and further, only to find its destination is Lady Dracaene's office. Dracaene confirms that a Singularity Leakage has indeed occurred in her office and mentions that she has something important to reveal, but first, she dismisses Billy and Cissia.
Intro_122000023: Sigrid rushes to the CCD amid the alarms, only to be informed by "Dracaene" that {F#Belle}{M#Wise} has gravely wounded Truvia. Using this as leverage, "Dracaene" orders Sigrid to bring {F#Belle}{M#Wise} back to her.
Intro_122000025: Reeling from the sudden betrayal of "Dracaene" and the attack on Truvia, {F#Belle}{M#Wise} is confronted by Pyrois's sharp words and forced to face the hard truth that {F#she}{M#he} is powerless to resolve the crisis. Just when all hope seems lost, Remielle appears and brings the secretly wanted {F#Belle}{M#Wise} back to her hideout.
Intro_122000026: After returning to the hideout with Remielle, {F#Belle}{M#Wise} is deeply disheartened and has no desire to talk. Sensing this, Remielle takes the initiative and suggests that {F#Belle}{M#Wise} help clean her wings.
Intro_122000027: {F#Belle}{M#Wise} wipes Remielle's wings, feeling the warmth of her presence. In that moment, old memories begin to surface — recollections of her own past, and of the experimental program she had been part of alongside Colonel Beliora Vike.
Intro_122000028: Sigrid has shown up at the hideout. {F#Belle}{M#Wise} desperately tries to prove their innocence to her, and Remielle's words manage to give her pause — the Dracaene they've been seeing is actually Girtablullu in disguise.
Intro_122000029: Sigrid agrees to hear Remielle out in detail. Remielle and {F#Belle}{M#Wise} successfully sway her, and in the end, she agrees to lend partial support to the audacious counterattack plan — ambushing Girtablullu, disguised as Dracaene, at the banquet.
Intro_122000030: Early the next morning, Sigrid arrives at the En-Nah Gang's hideout with everything she needs to disguise herself for infiltrating Scamall Hollow. But something feels off about that crate...
Intro_122000031: Their advance is halted by Airspace Patrol soldiers stationed at the port outpost. Faced with questioning, Sigrid keeps a straight face and spins a web of nonsense, and somehow, the soldiers buy every word without a hint of suspicion. Suddenly, it all makes sense why Sigrid is the stuff of legend in Roscaelifer...
Intro_122000032: The trio arrives at Roswick — a town swallowed by the Hollow. Sigrid gains a new understanding of Remielle's character.
Intro_122000034: The Rosetta Data prototype is right in front of you. The next step is to boot it up and start decoding the data...
Intro_122000035: The prototype boots up without a hitch. Now it's the Proxy's time to shine. {F#Belle}{M#Wise} locks in and begins calculating the critical path.
Intro_122000036: Path Data processing complete. The next step is to head back to Roscaelifer and prepare the next move. But even as the plan unfolds, Remielle's mind is already brewing something new.
Intro_122000037: The action path and item preparations are complete. Faced with a request for assistance from {F#Belle}{M#Wise} and Remielle, Sigrid ultimately chooses to trust them and sees things through — the understanding they have built through working side by side finally gives her the confidence to believe that those before her are no villains.
Intro_122000041: The day after the ball incident, {F#Belle}{M#Wise}'s wanted status is lifted, and {F#she}{M#he} is welcomed back warmly by companions. Lindverne and Sigrid pay a visit to express their gratitude, explain the reasons behind concealing the plan from {F#Belle}{M#Wise}, and deliver Remielle's invitation to meet.
Intro_122000042: When {F#Belle}{M#Wise} meets Remielle again, she has recovered somewhat and is about to head to Vyrium with Dracaene for treatment. She tells {F#Belle}{M#Wise} more about the Sunbringer... yet when it comes to the true nature of the Sunbringer, she still seems to be holding something back.
Intro_122000043: The En-Nah Gang identifies the location shown in the image. Remielle offers to accompany {F#Belle}{M#Wise}, and Griff points out the passage humans use to enter and exit the Retroflux Zone. {F#Belle}{M#Wise} will need to come to the hideout in person.
Intro_122000044: Hidden inside the Mr. Roar mascot suit is none other than the very person you've been waiting for.
Intro_122000045: One unexpected visitor often brings another in their wake... After a brief chat with Remielle, picking up where she left off, Velina arrives unannounced, requesting that you join her for a tea party.
Intro_122000046: Sure, the heiress from the Flint Workshop might look like trouble at first glance, but as long as you know how to handle her, she's actually pretty easy to get along with...
Intro_122000047: Staring at that familiar face, {F#Belle}{M#Wise} feels a flood of bittersweet memories about Truvia wash over {F#her}{M#him}...
Intro_122000049: After arriving safely at the airship port, you wait with Sigrid for the passengers to disembark. Among those coming ashore, there seems to be a familiar face...
Intro_122000050: {F#Belle}{M#Wise} is somewhat displeased about Remielle accidentally wandering into the Singularity Leakage, and expresses a lack of confidence in {F#her}{M#his} own combat abilities. Remielle apologizes, then uses Joyous as an example to reassure {F#Belle}{M#Wise} not to feel pressured. {F#She}{M#He} just needs to focus on doing what a Proxy does best.
Intro_122000051: Despite Serpico's inexplicable appearance, {F#Belle}{M#Wise} can't bring {F#herself}{M#himself} to look away and begins doing everything {F#she}{M#he} could to restore the photo — even as the Mech is on the verge of exploding.
Intro_122000052: With Fairy's help, {F#Wise}{M#Belle} analyzes and deduces that the truly critical information is the time and location of the Singularity Leakage's emergence.
Intro_122000053: During the simulation, {F#Wise}{M#Belle} discovers that if Singularity Leakages appear at nearby locations simultaneously, they can overlap with each other. After having Fairy compile the times and locations where Singularity Leakages were closest to one another, {F#Wise}{M#Belle} finds the answer.
Intro_122000054: {F#Belle}{M#Wise} wakes up to learn that {F#Wise}{M#Belle} already knows the culprit's motive.
Intro_122000055: Remielle finally reveals the secret she has buried deepest within herself — that she killed her dearest friend Beliora and became a half-human, half-Enchainer monster. {F#Belle}{M#Wise} then shares {F#her}{M#his} own past with Serpico and Truvia.
Intro_122000056: {F#Belle}{M#Wise} recalls once more the moment of {F#her}{M#his} falling-out with Truvia when the old capital fell.
Intro_122000057: After tending to each other's wounds, Remielle seems to pick up on something from {F#Belle}{M#Wise}'s description. But just then, a sound comes from outside — someone is approaching.
Intro_122000058: Another group of guests arriving on the island were delayed by the storm and have only just docked. Velina asks {F#Belle}{M#Wise} to help escort the guests from the port alongside Sigrid.
Intro_122000059: At the elevator leading to the Retroflux Zone, you encounter a Bangboo being questioned by Sigrid. The Bangboo is rambling incoherently, but through some remarkable leap of logic, Sigrid mistakes it for a Spotlight Theater performer, and just like that, you make it into the Retroflux Zone without a hitch.
Intro_122000060: Three nights after the rescue of Toby, the Singularity Leakages begin overlapping with one another, forming a corridor stretching from the Scamall Hollow all the way to Booastrum City. The culprit may have used this route to move Girtablullu.
Intro_122000061: To uncover the culprit's motive for moving Girtablullu, {F#Belle}{M#Wise} decides to head out at dawn with Billy and Cissia to trace the trail of the Singularity Leakage.
Intro_122000063: You and Truvia catch each other up on what you've been up to, and you learn why she came to the island. But when the conversation turns to Helios, the rift between you two proves impossible to hide...
Intro_122000065: Just as both of you are trying to shake off the awkward tension, {F#Wise}{M#Belle} shows up and interrupts the conversation between you and Truvia. Before you can even turn to see Truvia leave, a message suddenly comes in from Norma...
Intro_122000068: After returning to Amber Hall and informing {F#Wise}{M#Belle} of the next move, {F#Belle}{M#Wise} sets out alone.
Intro_122000198: The banquet has begun, and the guests are about to take to the dance floor. To set the next move in motion, Remielle brings {F#Belle}{M#Wise} to the space directly above the venue.
Intro_122000199: After seeing {F#Belle}{M#Wise} off, Remielle's companion appears in her room. She knows a great deal about Phaethon and the Karma Core, having long foreseen that Remielle would form a resonance with Phaethon, and Remielle herself seems to sense that something significant is about to unfold.
Intro_222000001: Once the two are alone, "Dracaene" suddenly transforms and attacks {F#Belle}{M#Wise}, only to be intercepted by Pyrois. Just then, Truvia appears unexpectedly and is struck by "Dracaene." In the chaos, Pyrois grabs {F#Belle}{M#Wise} and makes a break for it through the window.
Intro_222000002: Watching {F#Belle}{M#Wise} focus on Hollow data, Remielle finds herself overlapping {F#Belle}{M#Wise}'s image with the Sunbringer of the past, her thoughts drifting back to those days. She once had companions, once had dreams... yet in the end, neither she nor the other Void Hunters ever reached the promised destination.
Intro_222000003: Somewhere in Booastrum, the mysterious "Serpico" who should have been dead, appears before a gravely wounded and unconscious Truvia. He seems to know exactly how everything has unfolded, and what's more... he is already brewing a brand-new scheme.

Item_Equipment_34141_des:
Little bird, little bird, where are you flying to?
The little bird just shakes its head with a smile.
I don't know.
I just want to go somewhere far away.
Item_Equipment_34142_des:
The little bird flies over mountains and rivers,
finding a quiet garden in full bloom.
Countless daisies smile up at her,
and the little bird falls in love with the sunshine, the morning dew, and the gentle fragrance.
Item_Equipment_34143_des:
But the garden is never truly at peace.
A sleeping bear lies within, and gray wolves prowl its edges.
The daisies sway gently,
begging the little bird to take flight once more.
Item_Equipment_34144_des:
The little bird gladly agrees, though she still doesn't know where to fly.
To the ends of the world, to the homeland of the bears and wolves!
The daisies sing in unison:
It's a land of peace, an ocean free of all sorrow.
Item_Equipment_34145_des:
The little bird flies through countless springs and countless winters.
She befriends migrating birds, and together they soar through the skies.
But over the course of the long journey, these companions drift away one by one, losing their way.
The little bird keeps flying, alone, toward places even farther away.
Item_Equipment_34146_des:
But there is no ocean at the world's end, only a blazing sun.
Fierce winds snap the little bird's wings, and the scorching sun burns away every feather.
The little bird falls from the heavens. As her consciousness begins to fade, she seems to catch the scent once more...
Of those daisies she once saw, at the very beginning of her journey.
Item_Equipment_34241_des:
The ancient rings of time stand silent as iron.
A silver coffin lies across the spine of the deep forest.
A nameless cry echoes from within.
What slumbers inside knocks upon the gates of the world.
Item_Equipment_34242_des:
A thorned rose rests beside the coffin,
its roots sunk deep in rotting earth, drinking in the mist and morning frost.
It knows the seal is about to break,
and a thousand petals bloom with ravenous hunger.
Item_Equipment_34243_des:
The refugees of the endless night come, guided by the crimson moon.
A crimson tide erupts through pale veins.
The blood-hungry bloom sips at the lingering warmth,
and the silent roots at last learn how to grow.
Item_Equipment_34244_des:
The rose rejoices in wild delight.
Awakened in an instant, the thorns engulf the silver coffin.
Every thorn's mark is a crimson vow,
and every tightening embrace buries another wail.
Item_Equipment_34245_des:
The refugees of the eternal night smile as they drift into sleep.
Their pale flesh and bones return to the soil.
The barren spring dreams again of a heartbeat,
and crimson streams rise from the depths of the earth.
Item_Equipment_34246_des:
When every last drop of blood has run dry,
the rose withers alongside the silver coffin.
At last, the blood-soaked vows bear fruit,
and the first silver stamen greets the dawn.

Item_Weapon_S_1581_Desc:
The wings scorched by the blazing sun once fell to the pale earth, into a lightless chasm.
Then fall... She will bear it all. The weight, the darkness, those defiant follies, those lives that slipped away...
In that long slumber forgotten by time, even sorrow faded away. Pain and despair faded too... As did joy. As did memory. All withered away, for all is vanity.
A hundred years passed in the blink of an eye. Kingdoms upon the earth fell and rose anew, yet she never awoke.
But no matter how much unspeakable darkness lay buried within her heart, a bird cannot pretend not to see the coming of spring.

"Spring flowers are winter's dream, and autumn clouds remember the summer breeze~"
—Beneath the quiet moonlit sky, a pink-haired girl softly hums an ancient nursery rhyme.
Item_Weapon_S_1581_ShortDesc: Drifting through the cracks of time in search of the light.
Item_Weapon_S_1591_Desc:
Every Deputy Administrative Director of the Airspace Patrol Department from House de L'Azur has had a custom W-Engine of their own. The badge and ode of the guardians of the skies are all forged into this elegant white emblem. To the children, the members of the Airspace Patrol Department who protect the City in the Sky are knights from a fairy tale. The peace and tranquility above the clouds are the quiet ode of their extolment.
"Every knight in a fairy tale has their own trusty steed. Which reminds me..."
—Lady Lindverne Sunbringer eyes her knight with unmistakable mischief.
Item_Weapon_S_1591_ShortDesc: Across the vast skies and seas of clouds, the extolment for the knights echoes in quiet reverence.

JaneDoe_Skill_Branch_Upgrade_Desc:
Entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state grants Jane one use of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color>.
When available, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Launches rapid consecutive attacks forward, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Hold the button during the consecutive attacks to greatly extend the skill duration. Release <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to trigger the Finishing Move early.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the consecutive attacks, and Jane takes 40% reduced DMG. Jane is invulnerable during the Finishing Move, which can also trigger a Perfect Dodge upon activation.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered, the Finishing Move restores more <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color> on hit.
Using and damaging an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state generates <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>.
JaneDoe_Skill_ExSpecial_New_Upgrade_Desc:
While in the Passion state and with enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Leaps into the air to launch multiple consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill, which also counts as a <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>.
JaneDoe_Skill_ExSpecial_Upgrade_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Leaps into the air to launch multiple consecutive kicks forward, then sweeps across, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill, which also counts as a <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>.
JaneDoe_Skill_Normal_Upgrade_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to six consecutive attacks ahead, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
The sixth <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> is also treated as a <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, and Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

MessageBottleOptionFinalText_501:
O great Wish Post Office, please grant my wish...
Let me wake up tomorrow to find my doorstep piled high with all kinds of batteries...
"Gazing at the Sky" flavor, "Black Pudding" flavor... and the timeless classic "Fish and Chips" flavor!
Those are the foods I've always dreamed of tasting — Bangboo shouldn't have to toil away, and batteries should rain down from the sky themselves!

Buildboo
MessageBottleOptionFinalText_502:
A cold, unfeeling Bangboo doesn't care one bit about how some cat treats them!
They ignore me, hiss at me, even leap up and take a swipe at me... None of that can hurt my Logic Core! If they think that's enough to get me frightened, they've got another thing coming!
That said, um... what are kitties' favorite snacks and toys... anyway?
N–N–N–No, I'm not thinking of buying any! Just a little curious...

Anonymous Bangboo
MessageBottleOptionFinalText_503:
Report! I have discovered the secret to Bangboo King Chess!
Whenever the battle turns against you, simply pause for a moment, then unleash the loudest roar possible!
Nothing but scolding and fierce provocation! And then! Victory shall come knocking!
Everything is in place — all that's missing is a megaphone!
White Strategist wants it! And White Strategist gets it!

White Strategist
MessageBottleOptionFinalText_504:
While dealing the last case, Crowe swore he'd "never play cards again"... but now he's gone off somewhere again...
With no one else to turn to, asking others or relying on myself aren't cutting it... That leaves me no choice but to pray — Oh Wish Post Office, please bless The Hobbling Crow Detective Agency with booming business, endless clients, and overflowing rewards every single day!
Give Crowe some motivation! No more obsessing over cards, sleeping, wandering around, and worst of all — picking fights with random people!
Even someone as exceptional as me, the agency president, can't handle any more headaches...

Hobble
MessageBottleOptionFinalText_505:
They say if you repeat something a thousand times, it becomes a habit...
I'm working hard to live by that rule! So far, I've mastered Lady Sigrid's tactical footwork, her tone of voice, and her alert stance — next, I just need to keep practicing her combat posture, and I'll have the whole routine down...
The next time the Ethereals come, I'm going to be just as brave, reliable, and fearless as Lady Sigrid!
I will fight hard, and protect Booastrum!

Combatboo
MessageBottleOptionFinalText_506:
A meaningful life for any Bangboo should be spent wandering the streets, islets, and parks — basking in sunshine, feeling the warm breeze, and finding pure joy in doing absolutely nothing! NOT — drifting hopelessly around a workstation, letting the same old days cycle on repeat!
At the very least, I deserve... all paid leave from now back till the Founding Day! Please make this wish come true!

Bureauboo
MessageBottleOptionFinalText_507:
Lately, my sous chef has been obsessed with some seriously weird dishes...
Before I know it... pudding sausage with rosemary, strawberry jam mixed with salted dried fish... all get tossed into the pot at once, boiled into some unspeakable mess! And the terrifying part? He insists these are authentic traditional delicacies, meticulously recreated after he researched some noble recipes from the founding era of Roscaelifer!
Wish Post Office — please restore him to normal! Otherwise, before his "innovative cuisine" ever sees success... the restaurant and any unsuspecting customers who wander in will be done for first...

Chefboo
MessageBottleOptionFinalText_508:
...I've got the tricks of the battery trade down cold!
No matter the type, just slap a "Lady Velina's Personal Pick" label on it, and the suckers come running — paying extra and lining up for it... Business has been absolutely booming lately!
There's just one tiny little problem that's been bugging me...
So, uh... is there any kind of miracle potion that makes you run really fast? I've been getting roughed up by customers a lot recently...
But even so, I won't give up that easy! Can't fight 'em, but I can sure try to outrun 'em!!!

Salesboo
MessageBottleOptionFinalText_509:
Norma asked me to drop off a letter, said to write down my wish...
What's my wish? Right now, I don't really have anything specific I want...
Ah! I've got it...
I hope New Eridu's Victor No. 2 becomes a super, super amazing ocean explorer! Traveling all over, going to so many places he's never seen before...
Or... maybe he doesn't have to become some super amazing boo — I just hope he meets great friends, be brave and always curious... and most importantly, that he's happy every single day — that's all!

Jake
MessageBottleOptionFinalText_510:
My Sincerest Wish:
May every Patrolboo's courage — except mine — shrink to one-tenth of what it once was.
That way, my superiors would never scold me for being scared of lightning or afraid of the dark! They'd all be standing there in the rain, their metal shells going ice-cold, too terrified to go on patrol, huddled together and shaking like leaves...
And then, in the entire CCD, there would be only one brave and fearless Bangboo left —
Everyone would admire me, praise me, respect me... and give me a badge! That's just how things should be!

Patrolboo
MessageBottleOptionFinalText_511:
Ugh... The test scores this time around were absolutely terrifying!
Missed questions, wrong names, calculation errors... someone even forgot to fill out their answer sheet — everything went wrong!
This makes no sense! We already got help from Lady Norma and improved the test system. How did things still end up like this?
It must be... hmm... because the timing of the exam was just bad, and the kids couldn't perform their best!
I hope we can be granted a "perfect" testing window — one where everyone can study properly and answer questions with full focus...

Mr. Goomy
MessageBottleOptionFinalText_512:
More sunshine! Less rain!
Or at least... let my colleagues take shifts in the rainy zones...
...I shouldn't be the only Weatherboo rusting away in the downpour!
This isn't fair — all I want is fairness! Fairness! Fairness!

Weatherboo
MessageBottleOptionFinalText_513:
Vaultwatch — on the rise and grinding hard!
Sniffing out every secret, digging up the exclusive truth... No rumor, no scoop, no whisper in the dark escapes our eagle eyes!
Go big! Go bold! Claim the top spot as Roscaelifer's number one reporter group — and make sure no competition ever dares to show up out of nowhere, whether they're Bangboo or human!

Reporterboo
MessageBottleOptionFinalText_514:
Dennies — fallen from the sky!
Pour down to my doorstep — scooped up by me!
No work! No grind! Living the sweet new life!

Clerkboo

MessageItem_4000212_title: "A Few Things You Must Know About the En-Nah Gang"
MessageItem_4000213_detail:
My dear {F#accomplice}{M#accomplice}, I wonder whether you'll find this letter I left behind. You probably will, right? After all, you and Sigrid are the only people who would ever come to this room. Still, Sigrid would know better than to pry, and I can't imagine you never setting foot in here again... You wouldn't be so heartless as to never miss me at all, would you?

Before leaving for Vyrium, I came back to this room to pack for the journey and suddenly felt the urge to write something to you. When I first came to Roscaelifer in search of answers, I stayed in this room for a short while. There was nothing here then. Whenever the agony of my Enchainer transformation woke me in the dead of night, I would look outside, and the moonlight seemed to beckon me into another world. After that night, I asked the Bangboo to track down a few arcade cabinets and gave my bed a proper makeover. Loneliness ate away at my heart like a shadow. This was the only way I could remind myself that I was still human.

In today's New Eridu, I am nothing more than an unwelcome outsider. I have no home, no ties, and no reason to become part of this world. At first, I truly thought that suited me. It meant I only had to focus on the mission I still needed to complete and spend the rest of my life atoning for my sins.

But after meeting you, I seem to have grown weak. Being "accomplices" is a curious sort of relationship... don't you think? We both once had pride and dreams. We both lost someone dear to us forever because of that very pride. We both fear losing control of our power again... We are so much alike that whenever we see a reflection of ourselves in the other's words and actions, we can't help responding with a hint of hostility. Yet you made me feel truly alive again. And when I tried to solve everything by taking all the blame upon myself, you chose to catch me as I fell.

Thank you for making sure no one but you saw me in the grip of my Enchainer transformation that day. Because of you, I have started to fear death and slowly grown attached to this new world. You should be proud. An S-Rank wanted criminal fell right into your hands. Because you're here, I think I'll try to take living seriously before the transformation becomes impossible to suppress. Something good is bound to happen, right?

Now it is my turn to ask a question. I hope to hear your answer the next time we meet. By now, you're surely saying, "When did I ever ask a question?" or "Who asked you?" But if even a single thought of how I might be doing has crossed your mind, I think that counts as a question, don't you? This letter is my answer to you. So, here is my question...

Live brilliantly and bravely. Never give up hope. And never forget that you will always have an accomplice willing to help you carry your doubts and your darkest moments. Will you accept every one of these little requests from me?
