For a long time, my delicious burger recipe has been coveted by rivals, which is why I resorted to this measure — placing the only written copy of the recipe in this bottle...
To you who seek this recipe, I hope you'll carry the spirit of our burgers far and wide, even in distant, unfamiliar lands.
I bet you're thinking, "There's no recipe in this bottle at all" — don't be so hasty. This so-called secret recipe isn't really all that mysterious — the truth is, when making a burger, you pour in the heartfelt love. That is the real secret.
MessageItem_4370128_detail:
This is a magical bottle, home to a genie who can grant your every wish...
Lucky one who has obtained the "Divine Bottle," you may make three wishes to the genie — whether it's an endless supply of Dennies, incredible powers to soar through the skies and vanish into the earth, or even... a chance to become the new Void Hunter. All of it can be yours.
But... if you're reading this, that means the bottle's already been opened, yeah? What a shame — the genie has already slipped out and is now gone.

NewbieGuideInfoContext:
<color=#FFFFFF>System Info</color>
The "Beginner Guide" for Proxies provides growth target guidance for new and returning Proxies. Complete the phase missions in the guide to earn <color=#D9A600>Polychromes</color>, <color=#D9A600>Master Tapes</color>, <color=#D9A600>Drive Disc sets</color>, and various upgrade materials.

<color=#FFFFFF>Mission Rules</color>
• The guide contains <color=#FFAF2C>10 phases</color> in total, each with a number of "Required Missions" and "Optional Missions."
• After completing all <color=#FFAF2C>Required Missions</color> in the current phase, you can claim the core rewards for that phase and unlock the next one.
• Optional Missions do not affect phase progression, but completing them grants bonus rewards such as <color=#D9A600>Polychromes</color> and <color=#D9A600>Inter-Knot EXP</color>.

<color=#FFFFFF>Enhancement Guidance</color>
• During the Version Giveaway Event, Proxies can obtain one <color=#D9A600>S-Rank Agent</color> and one <color=#D9A600>S-Rank W-Engine</color> for free.
• Based on your chosen Agent, the system will recommend a team composition and provide corresponding Upgrade target guidance.

<color=#FFFFFF>Growth Guidance</color>
• Earn EXP: Recommends the most efficient ways to obtain Inter-Knot EXP.
• Earn Polychromes: View gameplay suited to your current Inter-Knot level for efficiently earning Polychromes, and visit the Polychrome Guide for an overview of all free Polychromes available in the current version.

Norma_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> character, or shares the same Faction:
When Norma, her creations, or Combat Bangboo hit an enemy, they apply 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Tech Divide</color>. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Tech Divide</color> increases the target's Stun DMG Multiplier by 3%, stacking up to 10 times. This effect can stack once every 0.5s.
Enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Tech Divide</color> stacks have their Stun duration increased by 2s upon becoming Stunned. This Stun duration increase cannot stack with similar effects. When an enemy affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Tech Divide</color> recovers from Stun, the <color=#FFFFFF>Tech Divide</color> effect ends.
While <color=#FFFFFF><Term:1000012>En-Nah Barrage</Term></color> is active, Norma's ATK increases by 44. This effect scales with character level, increasing by 14 per level, up to a maximum increase of 870.
While <color=#FFFFFF>En-Nah Barrage</color> is active, DMG dealt by all squad members increases by <color=#FFFFFF>20%</color>.
Norma_MathSkill_Desc_Simple:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Rupture</color> character, or shares the same Faction:
When Norma or her creations hit enemies, they apply 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Tech Divide</color>, increasing the target's Stun DMG Multiplier and Stun duration when they become Stunned.
While <color=#FFFFFF><Term:1000012>En-Nah Barrage</Term></color> is active, Norma's ATK increases with her Level, and DMG dealt by all squad members increases.
Norma_Skill_Branch_Desc:
When Norma is the active character and is in combat, she gains 1.5% <color=#FFFFFF>Preheated Chamber</color> per second.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Top Hat Companion</color> is on her head, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
After firing, Norma throws out <color=#FFFFFF>Top Hat Companion</color>, ordering it to unleash a round of aerial fire, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> and storing the current <color=#FFFFFF>Preheated Chamber</color>.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the previous character's <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Once <color=#FFFFFF>Top Hat Companion</color> has been thrown out, it will accumulate and retain <color=#FFFFFF>Preheated Chamber</color> at the same speed on behalf of Norma. Norma does not need to stay on the field during this period.
After Norma retrieves the <color=#FFFFFF>Top Hat Companion</color>, she immediately gains the stored <color=#FFFFFF>Preheated Chamber</color>.
When holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Top Hat Companion</color> will accelerate toward Norma.
If retrieving the <color=#FFFFFF>Top Hat Companion</color> would raise <color=#FFFFFF>Preheated Chamber</color> to 80% or higher, the <color=#FFFFFF>Top Hat Companion</color> will automatically accelerate toward Norma.
When Norma switches from on field to off field while in combat, if <color=#FFFFFF>Preheated Chamber</color> is not full, <color=#FFFFFF>Top Hat Companion</color> automatically enters the battlefield.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Norma_Skill_ExQTE_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Calls in tactical artillery to bombard enemies ahead, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
Upon activation, immediately gains 30% <color=#FFFFFF><Term:1000011>Preheated Chamber</Term></color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Norma_Skill_ExQTE_Desc_Simple: When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate, dealing massive <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> and immediately gaining <color=#FFFFFF><Term:1000011>Preheated Chamber</Term></color>.
Norma_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Operates the turret to fire continuously and launch different types of missiles based on the target's state:
When the primary target is not Stunned, launches an Armor-Piercing Warhead, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> and inflicting a large amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Daze</color>.
When the primary target is Stunned, launches a High-Explosive Warhead, dealing greater <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color>.
After using this skill, Norma gains 16% <color=#FFFFFF><Term:1000011>Preheated Chamber</Term></color> and enters the <color=#FFFFFF>En-Nah Barrage</color> state for 32s. OmondHouse_Portal1_Desc:
While tracking Joyous's Labyrinth Carrot, HAND unexpectedly discovered the Omond Research Station, located at the heart of the Papago Hollow.
To restore the station's functions and recover the Labyrinth Carrot, HAND and key members of the White Star Institute moved in and began a systematic investigation into Papago Hollow, the so-called "Divine Maze."
OmondHouse_Portal2_Desc: The Depot Hub at Omond Research Station stores equipment materials, as well as various Hollow observation logs and product manufacturing data.
OmondHouse_Portal3_Desc: The recycling station at Omond Research Station allows investigators to use Gear Coins to purchase required materials and Gear. Promotional events are held from time to time. Since most items are recovered from the Hollow by Bangboo, unconditional returns are not supported.
OmondHouse_Portal4_Desc: The central hub of Omond Research Station. It utilizes Porcelloy's properties to suppress Ether Energy and create a safe zone with extremely low Ether concentration within the Hollow. As the central hub is upgraded, it can gradually connect with anchor points deployed throughout Papago, enabling scanning and activity monitoring.
OmondHouse_Portal5_Desc: The workshop area of Omond Research Station was originally used to manufacture Bangboo equipment. After being repurposed, it can now use collected materials and blueprint designs to produce Papago-exclusive gear and consumables for investigators.
OmondHouse_Portal6_Desc: The data analysis functional area of the Omond Research Station. By submitting key materials or samples, investigators can optimize and upgrade technologies related to the research station and Hollow exploration.

PartnerTalk_BubbleStory_PartnerRemielle_: Just stay with me a little longer...
Wait till my feathers get wet...
PartnerTalk_BubbleStory_PartnerSigrid_34: Let us keep working hard together!
Just a little further and you will see it.
We are here!
I hope we did not mess with the patrolling Bangboo's work.
Where's the bus...?
Afternoon tea snacks...
De L'Azur's doors are always open to you!
The more you fear something, the more you must face it head-on!
At least, that's what Lady Lindverne told me...
This place has an amazing view, right?
Courage is to face your fear!
Beckford Street is always busy...
Cuppa Moment is rather popular!
I can already smell the aroma of tea!
A rare afternoon...
Please rest assured, I'll wait for you.
I hope I am not moving too fast for you?
It seems our stride is not quite in sync.
Great work today, everyone!
It's our duty!
You too, Deputy Director!
Remember to keep it a secret!
You must be Lady de L'Azur!
Roar... Fresh pancakes!
How have you been doing lately?
Sorry for the trouble...
It really makes you reflect...
The cover of this film...
I shall take good care of it!
There was a time I wondered if the bread here was some kind of safety violation...
Start your day with Mr. Roar's pancakes!
I'm not cut out for politics... That's better left to Lady Lindverne.
It's usually nice and quiet here... unless Researcher Norma is busy "inventing."
Every blade of grass, every tree here, it is all part of the "Miracle" we protect.
PartnerTalk_ChatAudio_PartnerSigrid_3305: No matter how hectic life gets, do not forget to take a moment and enjoy a cup of hot tea.
Lady Lindverne taught me this philosophy, and I have come to appreciate it deeply.
To sit with what we have gained and lost, or simply let the warm afternoon sun wash over us—
It is nice. It almost feels like even the lingering risks of Hollow corruption can be soothed away.
Lady Lindverne is always telling me: "It is fine for me to act my age, but Sigrid, do not go around sounding like an ancient soul before your time!"
I am sure that is what people who know me at Airspace Patrol would say.
The only people who seem happy to accompany me no matter what we are doing are Lady Lindverne and you.
The only people who seem happy to accompany me no matter what we're doing are Lady Lindverne and you.
Airspace Patrol does not usually cover this neighborhood, so I do not come here very often myself.
I do not have many close Bangboo friends. Nor do I have a Bangboo companion like Eous.
Perhaps... Am I too serious? Could that be why I am not very popular with Bangboo...?
I suppose even if our respective agencies have very different responsibilities, there is always room to learn from one's colleagues.
As a member of Airspace Patrol, I cannot allow myself to grow too distant from the citizens I serve, whether they are human or Bangboo.
Since your household has so many Bangboo members, I am sure you have plenty of experience interacting with them, right?
I only know how to swing a spear, and Lady Lindverne is busy enough as it is. It seems I will have to rely on your guidance from now on.
You would not turn me down, would you, Wise?
You would not turn me down, would you, Belle?
Since your household has so many Bangboo members, I am sure you have plenty of experience interacting with them, right?
Even as someone born and raised in Roscaelifer, I am still moved every time I look out over this great city.
But when I was younger, that responsibility always felt distant. It was nothing more than a story passed down through family teachings and the words of my elders.
I know that even after seeing a city as remarkable as Roscaelifer, your journey will not end here. You will continue onward, walk farther roads, and leave behind even greater stories.
Farther than any road I have traveled. Greater than any tale I have ever heard.
"Knight of the Skies" sounds quite cool, does it not? But in truth, we are just a group of spear-swinging idiots.
The skies here are the only battlefield we have ever known. And this land is the only home we have ever had.
But you... Your story does not end here. Your steed is destined to carry you toward horizons far beyond my sight.
When that day comes... I wonder if you will still remember.
Beyond the clouds, above the skies you cannot see. In that great city of steel...
But you... Your story does not end here. Your steed is destined to carry you toward horizons far beyond my sight.
PartnerTalk_Chat_PartnerRemielle_3305800: Do stray cats count?
Of course it counts. Your place is always so lively. If it were packed with stray cats one day, I wouldn't even bat an eye.
I guess dandelions are drawn to warm, sunny sunflowers too. I'm a little jealous.
Sigh... maybe that's just the price a winged Thiren has to pay.

Despite her tough talk, she smiles as she covers her eyes and even starts counting down on her own.
She knows that as the final number approaches, even the most ordinary gift can turn into a radiant miracle.
Ten, nine, eight...
Hmm? Well, that's an unexpected bonus. What did I say?
I didn't catch it...
That's good.
You wouldn't want anyone knowing what you've been dreaming about either, right?
At the very least, I'll have to keep that dream I just had a secret from you.
But thank you all the same. I slept really well, and your pillow was so comfortable.
In that case, all I have to do is steal this star.
Steal fate? That's a fascinating idea. Maybe you'd make a better novelist than a Void Hunter.

Right? If I were writing the story... the next chapter would be this: To reclaim their fate, Phaethon chases the pink-haired phantom thief all the way to the ends of the earth... and all the way to the moon.
Why have you gone quiet? What happens next?
That's all I've got... The rest is up to the characters in the story. I'm not really a novelist, after all.
But I do know this: Maybe on every bright, starry night from now on, the pink-haired phantom thief will think back to that little patch of stars... and to that radiant Phaethon.
Why have you gone quiet? What happens next?
Steal fate? That's a fascinating idea. Maybe you'd make a better novelist than a Void Hunter.
I'd love for you to have it.
Whenever the stars disappear from the night sky, come here. I'll light this little piece of the stars for you...
A little piece of the stars, just for you. It may be small, but it belongs to you, and it'll shine just for you.
Hmm? Well, that's an unexpected bonus. What did I say?
I didn't catch it...
That's good.
At the very least, I'll have to keep that dream I just had a secret from you.
But thank you all the same. I slept really well, and your pillow was so comfortable.
Are you fond of places with this much hustle and bustle?
I do, actually.
With so many shops to choose from... doesn't it drive you crazy trying to pick one?
If you're indecisive, sometimes it's easiest to just follow the crowd.
Like those "Must-Eat" lists each year.
Hmm... I'll give that a try sometime. But not today. There's no need. I know any place recommended by {M#Mr. Know-It-All}{F#Ms. Know-It-All} won't disappoint.
You're giving me way too much credit.
Better not get your hopes up too much.
Maybe, but isn't it nicer to be excited about it?
We have clear broth, sweet broth, and spicy broth. Our signature spicy pot's been especially popular lately!
Better to get the signature dish, right?
I'd like a mild spicy soup base.
Why's that? I thought you liked hot pot? Why order it only mildly spicy?
It's your first time here...
I'd ease into it...
Don't worry so much. I'm sure I can handle it.
The signature spicy pot is rich, fragrant, and irresistibly spicy. Just looking at it makes your mouth water.
As for Remie... Wait, her cheeks look even redder than the broth in the pot.
The flush spreads from the tips of her ears all the way down her neck, impossible to hide. Beads of sweat glisten as they trail down her cheeks, and even her breathing has grown a little quicker.

She can't hide how much she's forcing herself through it.
It's probably best to stop here...
I knew I couldn't handle medium spicy.
You don't have to pretend. You were clearly loving it just a minute ago, weren't you?
I should've listened to you from the start...
I had no idea hot pot could be this intense... Has everyone else trained their taste buds to handle this?
Hmm... the chili oil's doing a whole dance in my stomach...
I know a little trick.
Hang on.
You buy her a cold yogurt. After finishing it, she starts to feel a little better...
Now I finally know why everyone always avoided hot pot when we ate out together.
Heh, who knows how much they've been quietly looking out for me behind the scenes...
I can hold it in.
Honestly, it's endearing.
Hey, I'm innocent!
I never thought you'd see me like this... No, I have to redeem myself.
Just wait. I'll figure out your weakness sooner or later, my partner-in-crime.
Hmm... but before that, I want... one more cup of yogurt.
That only makes you sound even more devious.
A Void Hunter... scared of spicy food...
I'll remember that.
I'm going to hold on to this embarrassment for a long, long time.
Still... I guess it was a new experience, in its own way.
Thanks for coming with me. After all, you don't get many chances to discover your own weaknesses.
I think I'll need a little time to build up my courage before I step back into Simmer.
It's so quiet... It's like there's no one else in the world but you and me.
When I was little, I always looked forward to the evenings. I hated having to go to bed at nine every night. Every time I climbed into my little bed, it felt like such a waste.
There was still so much I wanted to do, so much more I wanted to learn about the world... But then... "Just like that, the day's over."
Sounds silly, doesn't it? I didn't know any better. I was just terrified of things coming to an end. But if today never came to an end, how could tomorrow ever start?
But even now... maybe I still don't understand. I don't want today to end. I don't want to let go of the past. Maybe... I just don't want to start the journey again.
Hm... So that's how you see it.
But enough about that. What's important is the here and now.
The peaceful streets are waiting for us. Let's go. It'd be a shame to waste such a beautiful night.
Secret rendezvous, late-night confessions, good news from afar, a friend's final farewell... The night carries all kinds of stories.
It's where some lives take a different turn, and where some regrets begin... Isn't that interesting?
Here's a question. If a telephone line stretched all the way into the past, who would you call?
Another one of your little Q&A games?
You really never get tired of this, do you?
What's wrong with that? It suits us, doesn't it?
Come on, tell me! If it makes it fair, I'll let you ask me a few extra questions afterward.
Hang on, let me think for a second...
Ah! We're out of time, my partner-in-crime! I'll go hide. Make sure you cover for me!
Remie darts into the phone booth. Before you can make sense of what's going on, a flurry of hurried footsteps draws closer, and a Patrolboo appears before you.
En-nah, nhu-nah? (Hello. You've been standing here for quite a while. Is there something wrong with the phone booth?)
Nhu-nha, ehn. (It's alright. I'll take a look inside. There are other phone booths nearby if you'd like to try one of those.)
Don't go in there!
B—Because...
Nhu-ne, ehn nu? (You're awfully tongue-tied. Could there be something you're hiding?)
I—I'm confessing my sins to it!
The Patrolboo's eyes go wide. It doesn't seem to understand what you just said, but somehow reaches a conclusion anyway, looking at you with something close to pity.

Partner_ProfileDesc_1581:
Remielle Dan, one of the first-generation Void Hunters, was formerly a Lieutenant Colonel in the Guard of Staves and currently a member of the secret organization known as the Covenant of Dayat.
Records describe her as a prodigy from childhood, capable of rapidly acquiring knowledge and mastering skills in nearly any discipline.
She was selected to join the Guard of Staves at a remarkably young age, was promoted directly to Lieutenant Colonel, and inherited the Void Hunter weapon, "Thaumiel." Fighting alongside Colonel Vike and the leader of the Falkenhayn Mercenary Troupe, she helped drive back the Dark Wall, rose to fame through that decisive battle, and was formally awarded the title of Void Hunter.
During the classified operation later known as the Day of Silence, Remielle and Colonel Vike were both believed to have been killed in action following an unexpected incident. Yet as she's still alive, then the truth must be something else entirely.
Remielle comes and goes without a trace, yet always seems to appear at the most unexpected, pivotal moments, steering events in a new direction.
Around others, Remielle always wears a sweet, effortless smile. Calm under any circumstances and almost disarmingly friendly, she rarely gives people a reason to raise their guard.
She excels at closing the distance with lighthearted banter, yet instinctively maintains just the right amount of distance, making her difficult to read.
Note: Remielle has a habit of playfully teasing those around her. As for you, you seem to receive a particularly generous share of that "special treatment."
Partner_ProfileDesc_1581_1:
During the Day of Silence operation, Remielle and Colonel Vike took part in an experiment proposed by Arche and Sunbringer known as Project Sunseeker.
Project Sunseeker sought to fuse a Void Hunter with the Karma Core sealed within a Void Hunter weapon, artificially creating an Enchainer. Its goal was to eliminate the burden imposed on wielders by Void Hunter weapons, allowing Void Hunters to defend Eridu with even greater power.
The experiment ended in failure, and both Void Hunters were lost. Fortunately, under the influence of Thaumiel's power, Remielle did not fully transform into an Enchainer, instead falling into a slumber that lasted for over a century.
After awakening in the Pursenas Hollow, Remielle found that the era she had known had long since come to an end. She met members of the Covenant of Dayat and chose to join the organization.
However, Remielle's Enchainer transformation did not stop there. Worse still, excessive use of her Void Hunter weapon only accelerates the process.
Once the Corruption reaches its critical threshold, horrifying symptoms of Enchainer transformation begin to appear across her body, and she seems determined to keep anyone from seeing her in such a state.
Partner_ProfileDesc_1591:
Sigrid de L'Azur, the current Deputy Administrative Director of the Airspace Patrol Department, trusted adjutant to Lindverne Sunbringer, and heir apparent to House de L'Azur, one of Roscaelifer's most prestigious noble families.

Like all those legendary figures, Sigrid has a long, long string of titles attached to her name. Yet even now, after serving for years as the Airspace Patrol Department's Deputy Administrative Director and earning top annual performance honors time and again, she still finds herself wondering whether she's truly worthy of the legendary hero "Sigrid" spoken of throughout the streets of Roscaelifer.

You can't exactly blame Sigrid for lacking confidence. After all, when the stories claim she can "stand shoulder to shoulder with a Void Hunter," "smash a building apart with one hand," or "blast straight through a Hollow with a single stab of her spear," any honest and sensible warrior would question whether they could truly achieve such feats with the weapon in their hand.

There is, however, one legend Sigrid has never doubted: "So long as my spear remains unbroken, the miracle of the skies shall never end."
Partner_ProfileDesc_1591_1:
"The de L'Azur family has followed Lindverne for generations," Sigrid says, just as her mother did before her, as has every heir of House de L'Azur.

But Lindverne dislikes the word "follow." Her relationship with Sigrid, or with any member of House de L'Azur, has never been one of leader and follower. They're comrades who fight side by side, as well as trusted friends and mutual mentor and student. Every de L'Azur has regarded Lindverne as a teacher, and each has taught her a great deal in return.

Yet no matter how hard each generation of House de L'Azur strives, there's one thing they'll never surpass Lindverne in: lifespan. That's the subtle, roundabout way Lindverne chooses to conceal her unease. And so the de L'Azur oath never speaks a specific name, repeating instead the solemn vow to "follow for generations."

The ever-irresponsible Lady Lindverne praised the achievements of each new Deputy Director of the Airspace Patrol Department so extravagantly that everyone came to believe every de L'Azur surpassed the last. The de L'Azurs take great pride in that legacy, but to Lindverne, every de L'Azur is one of a kind. One day, just as she once came to have Sigrid by her side, she'll lose her too. That is the inescapable curse of being loved by the House de L'Azur.

But Sigrid will always have Lindverne. That is the blessing of being a de L'Azur.

The Bangboo in front of you seems to be reading the newspaper intently, but every two seconds or so, his eyes dart over in your direction.
Finally, he just can't help himself and speaks up...
PasserBy_Chat_Roscaelifer_30131068_02: Wuh-nah? (Yo, you the one they sent for the pickup?)
PasserBy_Chat_Roscaelifer_30131068_04: Wuh-nah... Wuh-nah? (Cut the chatter... What's the password?)
PasserBy_Chat_Roscaelifer_30131068_06: Wuh-nah! Wuh-nah-wuh-nah-eun! (Correct! The password of the En-Nah Gang... is that there is no password! You're totally one of us!)
PasserBy_Chat_Roscaelifer_30131068_07: Wuh-nah-nah-eun! (Now take this bottle cap and go carry out the glorious mission the Gang has entrusted to you!)
PasserBy_Chat_Roscaelifer_30131068_08: The Middleboo gives a quick salute, drops the bottle cap, and vanishes in a flash...
PasserBy_Chat_Roscaelifer_30131069_01: Ehn-ne-ne...? (C-Can you let me get down from this dumpster...?)
PasserBy_Chat_Roscaelifer_30131069_04: Ehn-ne-ne! Ehn-ne-ne... (I-I just came here to throw out the trash! But for some reason, that cat kept glaring at me like it wanted to start something...)
PasserBy_Chat_Roscaelifer_30131069_05: Ehn-ne! Ehn-ne? Ehn-ne... (I-I didn't bring any catnip! Can you please lure that cat away? Just get it away from me, please...)
PasserBy_Chat_Roscaelifer_30131069_07:

PopUp_Content_999680701_Zenkov:
Your Inventory/Safe has limited capacity.
When you reach the capacity limit inside the Hollow, you can use <color=#FFAF2C>Discard</color> to remove low-value Supplies from your Inventory/Safe and make room for more valuable Supplies.
When you return to Omond Outpost, you can <color=#FFAF2C>transfer Supplies to the Depot Hub</color>, or <color=#FFAF2C>Sell</color> some Supplies at the Depot Hub.

Of course, you can also increase your capacity through the following methods:
· Inventory: Obtain <color=#FFAF2C>higher-tier Inventory</color> from Smart Workshop or Boojee's Store.
· Safe: <color=#FFAF2C>Unlock research plans</color> at R&D Center, or purchase <color=#FFAF2C>Safe Expansion Plug-Ins</color> from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.
· Storage: <color=#FFAF2C>Upgrade the Depot Hub level</color> at Control Hub, or <color=#FFAF2C>unlock research plans</color> at R&D Center.
PopUp_Content_999700101:
Welcome to the Omond Research Station. Here, you can check your current seasonal and weekly commission progress for Enigma of the Labyrinth and dive into Hollow exploration missions. Visit the <color=#FFAF2C>Porcelloy Hub</color> to manage and upgrade your function modules, gradually improving your combat capabilities within the Enigma of the Labyrinth.
In Enigma of the Labyrinth, <color=#FFAF2C>some Agents' abilities will be adjusted to better suit the gameplay</color>.
PopUp_Content_999700102:
In addition to Investigation Commissions, Enigma of the Labyrinth also offers <color=#FFAF2C>Season Commissions</color> and <color=#FFAF2C>Weekly Commissions</color>.
- Season Commissions: Complete these commissions to earn the season-exclusive currency <color=#FFAF2C>Season Coins</color>. New commissions unlock as the season progresses. <color=#FFAF2C>Season Commission progress and Season Coins reset each season.</color> Check the upper-right corner for your current <color=#FFAF2C>Season Commission Progress</color> and <color=#FFAF2C>Season Coin Acquisition Progress</color>.
- Weekly Commissions: These refresh each week. Complete Weekly Commissions to claim <color=#FFAF2C>Bounty Rewards</color>. A notification appears at the deployment entrance when a commission is available to complete or a reward is available to claim.
PopUp_Content_999700103: The Hollow is filled with supplies, including <color=#FFAF2C>stronger Agent Gear, Squad Equipment, Tactical Items</color>, and even priceless valuables if you're lucky. <color=#FFAF2C>Find and extract as many high-value supplies as you can</color>, and make your fortune in the labyrinth!
PopUp_Content_999700104:
Use the supplies you collect to build and upgrade <color=#FFAF2C>facility modules</color> at Omond Research Station:
- Upgrade the <color=#FFAF2C>Porcelloy Hub</color> to raise the <color=#FFAF2C>maximum construction level</color> of the Smart Workshop, Boojee's Store, and Depot Hub, and to directly upgrade the <color=#FFAF2C>R&D Center</color>.
- Upgrade the <color=#FFAF2C>Smart Workshop</color> to unlock more craftable Agent Gear, Squad Equipment, and <color=#FFAF2C>Tactical Items</color>.
- Upgrade <color=#FFAF2C>Boojee's Store</color> to unlock more combat supplies for purchase and <color=#FFAF2C>unlock rewards such as Agent Focus: Pyrois and Twilight Afterimage</color>.
- Upgrade the <color=#FFAF2C>R&D Center</color> to unlock more <color=#FFAF2C>R&D Projects</color> that improve your Hollow exploration capabilities.
PopUp_Content_999700201:
In Enigma of the Labyrinth, an Agent's <color=#FFAF2C>Cinema Level</color> and <color=#FFAF2C>W-Engine Effects</color> will be retained. However, the Agent's Level, W-Engine Level, and Skill Levels will be determined entirely by the equipped <color=#FFAF2C>Agent Gear</color>. The higher the level of the Agent Gear, the higher the Agent's Level, W-Engine Level, and Skill Levels will be. Agent Gear also provides powerful additional effects!
Agent Gear has <color=#FFAF2C>Durability</color>, which is reduced at the end of each investigation based on the equipped Gear: 1 point per investigation on Easy and Normal difficulties, 2 points on Hard difficulty, and 3 points on High-Risk difficulty.
PopUp_Content_999700202:
Squad Equipment comes in three types: <color=#FFAF2C>Blade of the Other, Anti-Corruption Device, and Inventory</color>.
- The Blade of the Other grants additional <color=#FFAF2C>exploration and combat abilities</color> in the Hollow: Perfect Block, Phase Dash, and Powerful Slash.
- The Anti-Corruption Device improves <color=#FFAF2C>survivability</color> in the Hollow by reducing DMG taken by Agents and slowing Corruption buildup.
- The Inventory provides additional <color=#FFAF2C>carrying capacity for supplies</color>.
The Blade of the Other and Anti-Corruption Device also have Durability.
PopUp_Content_999700203:
Tactical Items include <color=#FFAF2C>Etheric Phantoms</color> and <color=#FFAF2C>Medicine</color>.
- Etheric Phantoms are special equipment that record enemy data and let you use their abilities.
- Medicine can recover HP and restore lost Max HP.
PopUp_Content_999700204:
Each investigation difficulty has a different <color=#FFAF2C>Recommended Combat Readiness</color>. Combat Readiness is determined by your equipped <color=#FFAF2C>Agent Gear, Squad Equipment, and Tactical Items</color>. If your Combat Readiness is below the recommended value, the investigation will be extremely difficult.
Craft higher-level equipment at the <color=#FFAF2C>Smart Workshop</color> or purchase items from <color=#FFAF2C>Boojee's Store</color> to increase your Combat Readiness.
PopUp_Content_999700301:
In the Porcelloy Hub, you can <color=#FFAF2C>construct functional modules and upgrade them</color>.
Upgrading the <color=#FFAF2C>Porcelloy Hub</color> unlocks the <color=#FFAF2C>construction level cap</color> for the Smart Workshop, Boojee's Store, and the Depot Hub, while also directly <color=#FFAF2C>upgrading the R&D Center</color>.
Upgrading the Porcelloy Hub also restores more functions of the Omond Research Station — it's recommended to prioritize upgrading the Porcelloy Hub!
PopUp_Content_999700302:
The Smart Workshop, Boojee's Store, and the R&D Center can also be leveled up here:
· Leveling up the <color=#FFAF2C>Smart Workshop</color> unlocks more craftable <color=#FFAF2C>Agent Gear, Squad Equipment, and Tactical Items</color>.
· Leveling up <color=#FFAF2C>Boojee's Store</color> unlocks more combat Supplies available for purchase, and can also <color=#FFAF2C>unlock rewards such as Agent Focus: Pyrois and Twilight Afterimage</color>.
· Leveling up the <color=#FFAF2C>R&D Center</color> unlocks more <color=#FFAF2C>R&D Projects</color> to boost your Hollow exploration capabilities.
PopUp_Content_999700401: Select an unlocked blueprint in the Smart Workshop and <color=#FFAF2C>consume materials from your Inventory and Depot Hub</color> to begin crafting. Switch between tabs to craft Squad Equipment, Agent Gear, and Tactical Items. <color=#FFAF2C>Once crafting is complete, the items can be claimed from the Depot Hub</color>.
PopUp_Content_999700402: Some crafting recipes <color=#FFAF2C>require a corresponding blueprint</color>. Obtain and use the blueprint to <color=#FFAF2C>unlock the recipe</color>, then craft that type of equipment or item at the Smart Workshop.
PopUp_Content_999700403: When Quick Restock is enabled, materials available in the Store count toward crafting requirements. If you are missing materials sold by the Store, the button changes to <color=#FFAF2C>Restock & Craft</color>. Confirm to <color=#FFAF2C>purchase the missing materials</color> and begin crafting.
PopUp_Content_999700501: At Boojee's Store, you can use <color=#FFAF2C>Gear Coins and Season Coins</color> to purchase Equipment, materials, and items, as well as valuable rewards. More products are <color=#FFAF2C>gradually unlocked based on product type, Season Level, and Store Level</color>. Purchased and equipped items can increase your combat power and can also be used for blueprint crafting and Facility Module upgrades.
PopUp_Content_999700502: Equipment and materials purchased from the Store can be used at the Smart Workshop. <color=#FFAF2C>Materials are used in recipes</color>, and <color=#FFAF2C>Restock & Craft can automatically purchase</color> any missing materials before crafting.
PopUp_Content_999700601: Complete commissions during the season to earn <color=#FFAF2C>Supplies and Season Coins</color>. New commissions <color=#FFAF2C>unlock as the season progresses</color>, so don't forget to complete them.
PopUp_Content_999700701: At the R&D Center, <color=#FFAF2C>spend Supplies to complete research projects</color>, <color=#FFAF2C>permanently improving combat, exploration, and resource-gathering capabilities within the Enigma of the Labyrinth</color>.
PopUp_Content_999700801: The Database allows you to <color=#FFAF2C>view collected badges and information on various Supplies</color>. <color=#FFAF2C>Meet the required conditions to claim generous rewards</color>.
PopUp_Content_999700901: To ensure the safety of investigators within the Enigma of the Labyrinth, HAND and HIA conduct a Battle Prep Review before deployment. The review is based on the total Supply Value of three categories of deployed equipment: <color=#FFAF2C>Agent Gear</color>, <color=#FFAF2C>Squad Equipment</color>, and <color=#FFAF2C>Tactical Items</color>. PopUp_Content_999760101:
<color=#FFAF2C>An Enchainer is The Creator's most powerful servant and representative</color>, the true ruler of the great Hollows, and the apex of evolution among Ethereals and creations of the Hollows. They possess <color=#FFAF2C>formidable abilities to alter the rules within a Hollow</color>, demonstrate high-level intelligence, and even have the capacity to move freely outside of Hollows. This overwhelming power, beyond humanity's ability to match, <color=#FFAF2C>originates from the Creator's authority within them: the Karma Cores</color>.

The Karma Cores are unique Ether cores created by "The Creator," with one corresponding to each of the great Hollows. No matter how powerful an Ethereal evolves to become,<color=#FFAF2C> without obtaining and fusing with a Karma Core, it can never truly become an Enchainer</color>. At the same time, <color=#FFAF2C>a Karma Core is also the heart of a Void Hunter weapon</color>. Void Hunters use and control their Void Hunter weapons to suppress the Karma Core, while bearing the cost that comes with doing so.

<color=#FFAF2C>An ultra-High-Risk Ethereal that stands just one step away from becoming an Enchainer is known as an Enchainer larvae</color>. They cannot leave the Hollows, are capable of simple thought, but for the most part still act on pure instinct. driven by that instinct, <color=#FFAF2C>they will stop at nothing to seek out and attempt to devour a Karma Core</color>.

To date, we have had no formal contact with any Enchainer. The only known Enchainer was <color=#FFAF2C>first-generation Void Hunter Beliora Vike</color>, who fell completely after fusing with a Karma Core, and was hunted down by Remielle Dan a century ago. However, we have had direct confrontations with several Enchainer larvae, namely: <color=#FFAF2C>Girtablullu, Bashmu, and the Primordial Nightmare</color>.
PopUp_Content_999760201:
<color=#FFAF2C>Rosetta Data is the cornerstone of humanity's exploration of the Hollows</color> — a <color=#FFAF2C>one-of-a-kind master dataset</color>. Roscaelifer, the Celestial Nexus, possesses a special technology capable of <color=#FFAF2C>observing the Hollows in real time, calculating routes, and outputting them as Rosetta Data</color>. Any Carrot that has been calibrated and cross-referenced against the Rosetta Data can <color=#FFAF2C>eliminate the drift that accumulates in Hollow pathways over time</color>, ensuring that people can safely explore the Hollows under the guidance of an accurate Carrot.

The Rosetta Data was <color=#FFAF2C>first created over a century ago by Lady Sunbringer</color>. To conduct early development and preliminary validation of the Rosetta Data's computational model, she built <color=#FFAF2C>a town called Roswick</color> and, within a <color=#FFAF2C>research institution known as Meridian Hall</color>, carried out studies alongside a large team of staff. As a result, <color=#FFAF2C>the prototype machine used to solve the Rosetta Data a hundred years ago</color> still remains inside Meridian Hall — now long sunken into the Scamall Hollow.

Recently, Mosseint, the head of High Ambitions Corp., attended a charity gala held in the Janus Quarter. The event was organized by Odeum High Ambitions Entertainment (hereafter referred to as Odeum HAE), with the aim of rallying continued attention and support for families affected by the fall of the Old Capital.
As the founder of High Ambitions, Mosseint has been deeply rooted in the fields of finance, entertainment, and Hollow science since the Eridu era, building High Ambitions from the ground up into a commercial empire of considerable scale, even by TOPS Alliance standards. Notably, he has always kept a low profile and rarely attends events of this nature.
Pictured here is Mosseint during an interview with reporters. He appeared to be in good spirits, chatting with reporters at length on a wide range of topics.

In Booastrum, the clear skies might let you down. A Bangboo might even get the wrong idea.
But berries never will.
Strawberries, raspberries, and blueberries, whether sweet, tangy, or delightfully sour, will always sweeten your Cream Party.
Profile_3202017_des:
An avatar reward for the limited-time event "Marcel Anniversary Gift."
Limited-time reward.
Profile_3202017_story:
"Ehn... Ehn-ne? (So... what should we get Master for a celebration gift?)"
"Ehn, ne, ehn... (Something cute, something sparkly, and most importantly... something Master would love...)"
"Ehn-ne ehn-ne ehn-ne-ne—! (Ah!... I've got it! Let's wrap ourselves up as a gift and give ourselves to Master!)"
Profile_3202018_des: Earn a 2-Star rating in "Deadly Assault: Adversity Mode" to automatically unlock the limited-time avatar reward.
Profile_3202018_story: Sharp blades cut through thorns, while glory tempers the crown.
Pyrois_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Performs a forward thrust attack, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After using the skill and with 30 or more <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Pyrois_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Launches a series of attacks against the target, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After using the skill and with 30 or more <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Pyrois_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Performs a forward spinning slash, dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After using the skill and with 30 or more <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Pyrois_Skill_ExQTE_01_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at or above <color=#FFFFFF>Blasting</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> and select the upper branch to activate:
After charging, performs a downward slash, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After using the skill and with 30 or more <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Pyrois_Skill_ExQTE_02_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at or above <color=#FFFFFF>Blasting</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> and select the lower branch to activate:
Releases an energy burst in the surrounding area, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After using the skill and with 30 or more <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Pyrois_Skill_ExQTE_03_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at or above <color=#FFFFFF>Blasting</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> and select the left branch to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks forward, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After using the skill and with 30 or more <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Pyrois_Skill_ExQTE_04_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at or above <color=#FFFFFF>Blasting</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> and select the right branch to activate:
Gathers energy ahead before unleashing a Finishing Move, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After using the skill and with 30 or more <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Pyrois_Skill_ExSpecial_01_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Quickly charges forward and performs a series of consecutive attacks, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If hit by an enemy attack during the charge, triggers a Perfect Block effect, nullifying the damage and increasing the move's Interrupt Level to that of a Heavy Defensive Assist.
After using the skill and with 30 or more <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Pyrois_Skill_Normal_Enhance_Desc:
With 30 or more <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks forward, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
If another character is switched in during the 3rd hit, Pyrois automatically performs the 4th hit off-field.
Each hit consumes a certain amount of Solar Prominence.
Character is invulnerable during the 3rd and 4th hits.
Pyrois_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Performs a coordinated attack with Phaethon, dealing massive <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.
After using the skill and with 30 or more <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>, press or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Pyrois_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
Upon entering battle, Pyrois gains 30 <Term:1000018>Solar Prominence</Term>. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. Landing different attacks on enemies grants a certain amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Solar Prominence</color>, and Pyrois also gains 0.5 <color=#FFFFFF>Solar Prominence</color> every second while in-combat, up to a max of 60.
When Pyrois uses different Ultimates, they gain the following effects:
Upper Branch - Ultimate: Total Annihilation: Gains 30 Solar Prominence and enters the <Term:1000019>Mirage</Term> state. While in the Mirage state, Pyrois' Ultimate deals 40% increased CRIT DMG against Stunned enemies, and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light. This effect lasts 21s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Lower Branch - Ultimate: Triumphant Return: Enters the <Term:1000020>Sunflare</Term> state. While in the Sunflare state, Energy Generation Rate increases by 15%, DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>, and triggering a Perfect Block with an EX Special Attack grants 10 Solar Prominence. This effect lasts 200s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Left Branch - Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm: When this skill's heavy attack hits an enemy in the Contamination state, it deals <color=#2BAD00>450%</color> of ATK as additional DMG.
Right Branch - Ultimate: Eternal Imprisonment: When this skill's heavy attack hits a Stunned enemy, the <Term:1000021>Totalize</Term> effect is triggered, dealing <color=#2BAD00>1,125%</color> of ATK as additional DMG. Upon activating this skill, the Stun duration of all currently Stunned enemies is extended by 3s. After landing the finishing move, the enemy's Stunned state ends.

QuestDesc_1205580701: Meet up with Remielle at Beckford Street and take a stroll through the streets at night.
QuestDesc_1205580901: Getting out and about is good for the body and soul — perfect weather for it today, too. Remielle probably had the same idea.
QuestDesc_1205580902: Head to HAND Headquarters and meet up with Remielle.
QuestDesc_1205580903: Head to Suibian Temple and meet up with Remielle.
QuestDesc_1205580904: Head back to Roscaelifer and fill Remielle in on the day's events.
QuestDesc_1205581001: It looks like something happened to Remielle while she was on her own... Best go see what happened.
QuestDesc_1205590701: Meet up with Sigrid at the corner of Beckford Street and take in the buzzing streets of Booastrum together.
QuestDesc_1205590801: Meet up with Sigrid at the entrance to Gear Street and explore the block that belongs to the Bangboos.
QuestDesc_1205590901: Sigrid's sent you an invite to check out the overlook. Don't keep her waiting—show up on time.
QuestDesc_1205591001: Meet up with Sigrid at the corner of Beckford Street and share some afternoon tea together.
QuestDesc_1205591101: What's got Sigrid all stressed out? Go chat her up and find out what's going on.
QuestDesc_1205591201: As our names drift through the river of time, may the ripples they leave reflect a life of no regrets.
QuestDesc_1205591202: The old lady Sigrid bumped into seems to be an old acquaintance of hers… At Sigrid's request, go grab some of Mr. Roar's muffins for her!
QuestDesc_1205591203: A fresh, piping-hot Howling Pine Muffin is tucked in your arms — get it back to Sigrid, pronto!
QuestDesc_1205591204: Through years that blur together, the once-clumsy Young Lady has grown into a Knight who stands on her own two feet.
QuestDesc_1205591301: Sigrid, Deputy Director of the Airspace Patrol, has wrapped up today's training schedule. Go give her your regards.
QuestDesc_1205591401: Sigrid has sent a DM. Let's see what she wants.
QuestDesc_1205591402: Sigrid arrived at Amber Hall right on time. Let's watch the videotape together.
QuestDesc_231010601: Retrieve the Fragile Carrot from the Carrot Carrier.
QuestDesc_231010602: Deliver the Fragile Carrot to the target Decoder Stabilizer.
QuestDesc_231010603: Activate the target Decoder Stabilizer and submit the Fragile Carrot to begin stable decoding.
QuestDesc_231010604: The Decoder Stabilizer has attracted enemies. Defend it and defeat the incoming enemies!
QuestDesc_231010605: Once decoding is complete, activate the Decoder Stabilizer again to claim the rewards.
QuestDesc_231010801: Complete 2 safe extractions on Normal difficulty
QuestDesc_231010901: After using Heretic Jester's Ether Reverb to go invisible, deal DMG to Elite enemies from behind 5 times within 5 seconds (cumulative across Precincts)
QuestDesc_231011001: Complete an evacuation on Normal difficulty while extracting Supplies worth 400,000
QuestDesc_231011101: Use Scorched Horizon's Ether Reverb to Daze Elite enemies 5 times (cumulative across Precincts)
QuestDesc_2310112: Complete 1 successful extraction on High-Risk difficulty.
QuestDesc_231011201: Complete an evacuation on any map in High-Risk difficulty
QuestDesc_2310113: Collect 1M Gear Coins worth of Supplies and successfully extract in an investigation on High-Risk difficulty.
QuestDesc_231011301: Collect 1M Gear Coins worth of Supplies and successfully extract in an investigation on High-Risk difficulty.
QuestDesc_231011501: Defeat a strong enemy on the Dove Street Construction Site, Janus Illusion, during a single investigation on Hard or higher difficulty.
QuestDesc_231011601: Defeat a strong enemy at Lumina Central, Janus Illusion, during a single investigation on Hard or higher difficulty.
QuestDesc_231011701: The research station urgently needs specific supplies for research. Collect and submit Unknown Medicinal Powder x5.
QuestDesc_231011801: Use Etheric Phantom tactical items 3 times.
QuestDesc_231011901: The research station urgently needs specific supplies for research. Collect and submit Composite Fuel x10.
QuestDesc_231012001: The research station urgently needs specific supplies for research. Collect and submit Stable Crystal x10.
QuestDesc_231012101: Open at least 20 containers and successfully extract in a single investigation.
QuestDesc_231012201: Collect 500K Gear Coins worth of Supplies in a single investigation and successfully extract.
QuestDesc_231012601: On an otherwise ordinary day, Shepherd appeared near the video store, apparently with a commission. Go see what he needs.
QuestDesc_231012602: Shepherd has brought in a special commission—track down the legendary device Labyrinth Carrot left behind by former Void Hunter Joyous. Rumor has it that it is hidden somewhere within the Papago Hollow. {F#Wise}{M#Belle} has already reached out to available Agents, and everything's set. Check the HDD System and head into the Hollow.
QuestDesc_231012603: With preparations complete, you entered the Papago Hollow through the HDD system. The Hollow's special Etheric Matter is said to draw out visitors' memories and recreate familiar places. Proceed with caution.
QuestDesc_231012604: Soon after entering the Hollow, you encountered a group of Hollow Raiders. See what they're talking about.
QuestDesc_231012605: These Hollow Raiders are looking for trouble. Take them out.
QuestDesc_231012606: After defeating the Hollow Raiders, you discover a special remnant. Open it and see if it contains the Labyrinth Carrot.
QuestDesc_231012607: The Labyrinth Carrot was not inside. Check the containers the Hollow Raiders had just searched.
QuestDesc_231012608: A strange Porcelloy artifact, Blade of the Other, was found inside the container. Try using the Blade of the Other to activate Pyrois's special skill and defeat the enemies.
QuestDesc_231012609: More enemies have appeared. Defeat them and keep moving.
QuestDesc_231012610: The fissure led everyone to a mysterious research station. Its master control construct, D. Ata, said restoring the core could help locate Eous. Talk to her.
QuestDesc_231012611: After speaking with D. Ata, you learned that the core cannot be activated until Boorilliant is repaired. Check on Boorilliant and the core.
QuestDesc_231012612: The battle is over. Continue along the path and search for the Labyrinth Carrot.
QuestDesc_231012613: There is a newsstand nearby. Search it for any useful clues.
QuestDesc_231012614: According to Shepherd's intel, the Labyrinth Carrot should be hidden in the video store area. Go there and investigate.
QuestDesc_231012615: You have entered the video store. Search it thoroughly for the Labyrinth Carrot.
QuestDesc_231012616: You have found a locked room on the second floor of the video store. Find a way inside and search it.
QuestDesc_231012617: Just as you were about to leave with the Labyrinth Carrot, you encountered Nanson from HAND and Ray from the White Star Institute. Talk to them and see if you can work something out.
QuestDesc_231012618: An Ether Activity detector suddenly sounds an alarm. A strange, hound-like Ethereal has appeared. Reach the fissure and escape the Hollow as quickly as possible.
QuestDesc_231012619: Eous has been captured by the Ethereal... Once you've had a moment to collect yourself, withdraw through the fissure and leave the Hollow for now.
QuestDesc_231012701: After checking battle readiness with Collectie, everything's good to go. Head back into the Papago Hollow and track down the Special Storage Unit needed to fix Boorilliant.
QuestDesc_231012702: You returned to the Papago Hollow. Nanson warned that HAND had detected a highly dangerous Ether sound wave there called Cacophony. It can corrupt the mind and alter the environment. Avoid its effects and locate the Special Storage Unit in the marked area.
QuestDesc_231012704: Defeat the monsters in front of you
QuestDesc_231012705: You have obtained the Special Storage Unit. Find the Bangboo waiting for you, then evacuate and bring the unit safely back to the research station.
QuestDesc_231012706: Safely returned to the research station. Give the storage unit to D. Ata, then restart the core to activate its search function for Eous.
QuestDesc_231012707: The Porcelloy Hub has been successfully restarted, bringing several expansion modules online. D. Ata then led everyone to the R&D Center and explained its functions. Talk to D. Ata when you're ready to resume the search for Eous.
QuestDesc_231012708: D. Ata has detected signals from two Bangboo inside the Hollow. One is Boojee, the research station's recovery Bangboo, while the other remains unidentified. Since it could be Eous, everyone is preparing to enter the Hollow again and investigate. Nanson has also gone to inspect the newly restarted Depot Hub. Talk to him.
QuestDesc_231012709: After inspecting the Depot Hub, Collectie prompts that D. Ata should have already located Boojee and the unidentified Bangboo. Go talk to D. Ata.
QuestDesc_231012710: After inspecting Boorilliant's condition, Nanson and Tsukishiro Yanagi arrived at the research station. Restoring the Hub's search function requires retrieving the storage unit from the Hollow to complete the repairs. Just as everyone was about to set out, a peculiar little Bangboo called out. Go see what it wants.
QuestDesc_231012901: Everything is ready. Head to the Bangboo signal area in the Papago Hollow, determine whether the unidentified Bangboo is Eous, and bring Boojee back.
QuestDesc_231012902: You have entered the Papago Hollow. Head to the search area marked by D. Ata and investigate.
QuestDesc_231012903: At the source of the signal, you found Boorave and Boojee arguing, but there was still no sign of Eous. D. Ata has marked an Evacuation Anchor. Escort the two Bangboos there and extract.
QuestDesc_231012904: You have brought the two Bangboos safely back to the research station. Talk to them.
QuestDesc_231012905: The two Bangboos said they had seen Eous near the aquarium. With Boojee back, you may be able to purchase supplies again. Talk to him.
QuestDesc_231012906: Boojee's Store is now open, and Boojee is eager to explain how it works. Talk to him.
QuestDesc_231012911: The designated area has been reached, but precise positioning requires manually collecting and activating the Signal Transmitters scattered throughout the area. No time to waste—begin collection.
QuestDesc_231012912: The source of the Bangboo signal has been located. Confirm whether Eous is there.
QuestDesc_231012914: Nanson and Tsukishiro Yanagi appear to have information about the next mission. Talk to them.
QuestDesc_231012915: Before deployment, Tsukishiro Yanagi mentioned that Ray may have discovered several combat facilities at the research station that could enhance the team's capabilities. Talk to Ray.
QuestDesc_231013101: HAND considers the Lower Level dangerous and recommends preparing at the Smart Workshop before deployment. Talk to Ray, activate the workshop, and obtain an access card for the Lower Level.
QuestDesc_231013104: Successfully entered the Papago Hollow. Go to the elevator area and hand Boorigitte the Lower-Level elevator access card to prepare for the investigation.
QuestDesc_231013105: A special Ethereal target has been detected ahead. Eliminate it first.
QuestDesc_231013106: A strange object has appeared where the Ethereal was defeated, surrounded by eerie dark-red crystals. Search it for the aquarium access card.
QuestDesc_231013108: Everything is ready. Head to the Lower Level, recover the aquarium access card Boojee lost, and rescue Eous from the aquarium.
QuestDesc_231013109: The elevator has been activated. Take the elevator to the Lower Level.
QuestDesc_231013111: The Smart Workshop is now active. Ray appears ready to explain how it works. Talk to her.
QuestDesc_231013201: Successfully recovered the access card. Take the elevator to the aquarium and search for Eous.
QuestDesc_231013202: You have reached the aquarium. Use the access card to enter.
QuestDesc_231013203: First, upgrade Depot Hub to Lv. 1
QuestDesc_231013204: You have successfully returned to the research station. Many questions remain about the Fire Ethereal and the Hematite Crystals mentioned in Eous's records. Talk to D. Ata about what you've learned so far.
QuestDesc_231013205: You have located the Hematite Crystal Eous mentioned. To reach it, upgrade the Porcelloy Hub to provide enough power to connect to the fissure. Gather supplies and begin the upgrade.
QuestDesc_231013206: The Porcelloy Hub has been upgraded. Talk to D. Ata and see whether it can establish a connection to the fissure leading to the new area.
QuestDesc_231013207: The fissure near the Hematite Crystal is now connected. Prepare for deployment, then investigate the crystal Eous mentioned.
QuestDesc_231013210: The Evacuation Anchor lies across the mimetic sea and can only be reached by boat. Reach the dock and return to the research station.
QuestDesc_231013301: You have entered the Six Dusk Street area of Janus Illusion. Search for and examine the remaining Hematite Crystals.
QuestDesc_231013302: To locate the remaining Hematite Crystals, find the Signal Detectors scattered throughout the area and use them to pinpoint their coordinates. No time to waste. Start searching!
QuestDesc_231013303: After examining a Hematite Crystal, D. Ata recommends breaking it apart to collect shard samples. The research station can use those samples to search for similar energy sources. Break the crystal and bring the samples back.
QuestDesc_231013304: No trace of Eous was found in the area where the Fire Ethereal was located. When the battle ended, everything felt like waking from a dream, and everyone had returned to the research station. Talk to Boorave and the others to find out what happened.
QuestDesc_231013305: Breaking the crystal exposed everyone to Corruption, causing a hallucination of a battle against the Fire Ethereal: Infernal Revenant. Nanson explained that a hallucination can only exist when there is a mental subject sustaining it. The one capable of recreating the Fire Ethereal's appearance and surrounding environment was most likely Eous. Using the lava-filled area from the hallucination as a reference, D. Ata has begun screening high-temperature zones. Talk to her about the results.
QuestDesc_231013306: D. Ata has detected a spatial fissure in the lava zone where Eous is located, which connects to the Janus Illusion. However, pinpointing the fissure's exact location requires upgrading the Porcelloy Hub to Level 3 to meet the scan's power requirements. Collect materials and upgrade the Porcelloy Hub.
QuestDesc_231013307: When the crystal shattered, it revealed a strange spatial fissure. Since this fissure may lead to Eous's location, there is no choice but to enter and investigate. However, the terrifying Ether Energy surging from within and the eerie hematite crystals surrounding it are clear signs of the danger that awaits.
QuestDesc_231013308: D. Ata wants to unlock the Porcelloy Hub upgrade program, but first, all function modules must be upgraded to their current maximum level. Upgrade Boojee's Store, Smart Workshop, and Depot Hub to Lv. 2.
QuestDesc_231013309: Function modules upgrade complete. D. Ata mentioned that Ray seems to be preparing some powerful Gear loadouts. To ensure the safety of future investigations, go talk to Ray.
QuestDesc_231013310: Ray says the crafting program is complete. Try crafting 1 High-Grade Gear (S-Rank) and 1 Advanced Anti-Corruption Device (B-Rank).
QuestDesc_231013401: The Porcelloy Hub upgrade is complete. The research station has restored all basic functions, and the hematite core is finally fully charged. Everything is ready. Enter the Hollow, restart the fissure, and rescue Eous.
QuestDesc_231013402: D. Ata has pinpointed the location. The collapsed fissure is on Floor B1 of Lumina Central. Break through any obstacles and reach it.
QuestDesc_231013403: Enter the fissure leading to Eous's location, face the Fire Ethereal: Infernal Revenant, and bring Eous back!
QuestDesc_231013404: Eous appears shaken, but otherwise unharmed. Bring him back to the research station.
QuestDesc_231013405: Eous has been brought back safely, but only he can explain how he ended up wandering into the lava zone and why he was dancing before the Fire Ethereal. Talk to him.
QuestDesc_231013406: The high-intensity crystal has been returned to the research station, but the current power supply is insufficient to charge it. D. Ata says the research station must be upgraded to Level 4 to provide enough power. Talk to Boorilliant and upgrade the Porcelloy Hub.
QuestDesc_231013407: Near the collapsed fissure, {F#Wise}{M#Belle} has found a suitable location to place the hematite core and reopen the fissure. Place the hematite core there to rescue Eous.
QuestDesc_231013408: Eous has finally been rescued. Check on him.
QuestDesc_231013409: The Porcelloy Hub upgrade is complete, but unexpectedly, the spatial fissure we located has already collapsed. To restore the fissure, we need to collect high-intensity hematite crystals and manually recharge it. D. Ata has tracked down and pinpointed an enemy carrying high-intensity hematite crystals. Move out and take it down.
QuestDesc_231013410: You have returned to the Papago Hollow to restore the collapsed spatial fissure. Defeat the target enemy and recover a usable high-energy Hematite Crystal.
QuestDesc_231013501: Eous explained that the Labyrinth Carrot inside his body seemed to have attracted the Fire Ethereal - Infernal Revenant, and that the special sound waves emitted by the Labyrinth Carrot during his dance were what calmed it down. D. Ata figured it was similar to matching a walkie-talkie frequency; those unique sound waves just happened to stabilize the Fire Ethereal. With everything settled, once the Labyrinth Carrot is removed from Eous, it seems Boorilliant still has a commission to hand off. Go have one last chat with him before wrapping up.
QuestDesc_231013502: Just finished watching the early meeting footage from Omond Research Station. {F#Belle}{M#Wise} says the Shepherd had stopped to ask about the commission's progress. Head back to the video store with Eous and catch up with {F#Belle}{M#Wise} and the Shepherd.

QuestDesc_231040102:
No idea what kind of record could make an entire area "feel freezing cold" just by playing it... but if it's Xiao'Zhao's treasured collectibles, it's worth finding.
Head to the Suburbs Illusion and search the trash cans along Windworn Highway to recover the lost record!
QuestDesc_231040103: Music that sends chills down your spine comes from a trash can? For Xiao'Zhao's sakem open it and take a look.
QuestDesc_231040104: Damian and his leader, the petite "Krampus Unbeaten Legend," are discussing something at the research station. Return the recovered record to them.
QuestDesc_231040201: Yuzuha and Alice seem to be talking about the strange events they encountered in the Hollow. Since it's such a spooky topic... why not sneak closer and scare Alice a little?
QuestDesc_231040202:
A TV that produces terrifying sounds... It sounds like it's playing something unusual. But if it can scare Alice this badly, it must be worth investigating...
Head to the Janus Illusion and search the Lumina Central area for the noisy television!
QuestDesc_231040203: Turns out the terrifying sounds are from a half-finished promotional video for Victoria Housekeeping. Rina says she'll be returning to the research station. Go find her and talk about what happened.
QuestDesc_231040301: Harumasa seems to have been assigned to the research station. Go ask him about the overtime duties.
QuestDesc_231040302:
The clues regarding the important equipment have been gathered. Harumasa can go rescue the investigator...
Now head to the Janus Illusion and search near the Dove Street Construction Site for clues about the equipment.
QuestDesc_231040303: You didn't find the equipment, but you did uncover something useful... Return to the research station and see if anyone can provide more information.
QuestDesc_231040304: You are halfway through a conversation with Ceta when Harumasa suddenly appears. Ceta says some strange things... Let's see what the two of them have to say.
QuestDesc_231040305:
Ceta is in bad shape and needs to leave the Hollow as soon as possible. Harumasa takes her away first, but they leave behind some additional information.
Now head to the Janus Illusion and seach near the Dove Street Construction Site for the equipment.
QuestDesc_231040306: The computer's startup password, mentioned by Ceta, was lost probably due to previous damage. Luckily, there are some files nearby. Check them for clues.
QuestDesc_231040307: What a unique password. Now that you've found it, enter the code to Ceta's computer and help delete the files she mentioned...
QuestDesc_231040308: Deleting the files isn't going as expected. Meanwhile, Hoshimi Miyabi seems to have appeared at the research station as well... What kind of important data requires even this Void Hunter's involvement?! Go back and check it out.
