QuestDesc_42201: The curtain slowly rises, and the actors take the stage one by one. People from the surface have found their seats at a table high above the sky. Old sins from a distant past drag in memories best left buried. Now what will happen?
QuestDesc_4220101: {F#Wise}{M#Belle}, Cissia, and Billy are already waiting to have breakfast with you. Join them and talk about what's happened lately.
QuestDesc_4220102: Someone just showed up at Amber Hall. Head to the entrance and check out who it is.
QuestDesc_4220103: Velina has invited us to welcome the island's newest visitors. Head over to Cuppa Moment with her and join the welcoming tea party.
QuestDesc_4220104: A new group of visitors is about to arrive at the port. Velina and Lindverne can't step away, so head over and help Sigrid welcome them.
QuestDesc_4220105: Among the guests is Truvia, an old classmate from the past. At Sigrid's suggestion, join her for a stroll through a nearby park to catch up.
QuestDesc_4220106: After Truvia leaves, Norma sends word that there's been progress on the investigation with Toby. Head back to the academy with {F#Wise}{M#Belle} and find Norma.
QuestDesc_4220109: Lindverne wants us to mingle with the guests, and specifically suggested we go say hi to Claret, the Administrative Director of Flint Workshop.
QuestDesc_4220110: Truvia noticed a wishing fountain up ahead. Go check it out with her.
QuestDesc_4220111: Truvia's interested in the chessboard-like structure up ahead. Go check it out with her.
QuestDesc_4220201: The En-Nah Gang's mark appeared in Toby's visuals. Norma tells us we can find their Bangboo at Clink Market on Gear Street. Head over and see what you can find from the boo there.
QuestDesc_4220202: Found the market entrance, but the Bangboo guarding the gate won't let us through.
QuestDesc_4220203: There's a Bangboo at the market who looks like they're in the know. They might have some intel on the En-Nah Gang. Go talk with them.
QuestDesc_4220204: Learned the En-Nah Gang's passcode. Now it's time to talk your way past the Bangboo at the door and slip into their hideout.
QuestDesc_4220205: You earned the trust of the Guardboo. Head through the door ahead to reach the En-Nah Gang territory, the Retroflux Zone.
QuestDesc_4220207: Only Bangboo can enter the market. Head back and use Eous to get in.
QuestDesc_42203: Maybe you've heard a story like this before... A mysterious princess among dwarves, and a cursed princess waiting for someone to save her from the abyss.
QuestDesc_4220301: According to Guardboo, we need to find the elevator that can take us down first.
QuestDesc_4220303: A few Bangboo are gathered near the elevator. Looks like something's up. Go ask them.
QuestDesc_4220304: The elevator's broken. Better figure out what's wrong and see if there's any way to fix it.
QuestDesc_4220305: There are some robots nearby. Try hacking into them so we can use them to scout the area and find out what's causing the elevator to malfunction.
QuestDesc_4220307: Looks like the elevator's out because the circuit box is fried. Let's try fixing it.
QuestDesc_4220308: After taking the elevator down to the lower levels, we're almost at the En-Nah Gang's turf. Team up with the Bangboo tagging along and figure out how to reach the hideout.
QuestDesc_4220310: Use the robot to find the cause of the elevator malfunction.
QuestDesc_4220311: There's a long path ahead. We might be able to roll straight to the bottom with the robot.
QuestDesc_4220312: Use the robot to find the cause of the elevator malfunction.
QuestDesc_4220313: Use the robot to find the cause of the elevator malfunction.
QuestDesc_4220314: There's a weird sparking sound nearby. Could be why the elevator's busted. Let's go check it out.
QuestDesc_4220401: Finally made it to the En-Nah Gang's hideout, but we can't move around freely just yet. Ask the other Bangboo what's next.
QuestDesc_4220402: Griff, the boss of the En-Nah Gang, welcomes us and makes it clear that to officially join the En-Nah Gang, we'd need the approval of a large Databoo known as Prophetboo. Time to meet this Prophetboo.
QuestDesc_4220403: Having failed the test, we've been brought to the door of a mysterious "Great One." Whatever happens next is entirely up to them.
QuestDesc_4220501: The legendary "Great One" turned out to be none other than Remielle. She pitched the idea of teaming up again and has the En-Nah Gang dig up intel on the location from Toby's memories. With Griff rallying the crew, they soon find something.
QuestDesc_4220502: Griff told us that there's a regular-sized elevator on Beckford Street that humans can use to access the En-Nah Gang. After heading back to Amber Hall and returning to my own body, get ready to head to the En-Nah Gang once more.
QuestDesc_4220503: Griff told us that there's a regular-sized elevator on Beckford Street that humans can use to access the En-Nah Gang. After heading back to Amber Hall and returning to my own body, get ready to head to the En-Nah Gang once more.
QuestDesc_4220504: Re-enter the Retroflux Zone to head to the crime scene with Remielle.
QuestDesc_4220505: Re-enter the Retroflux Zone to head to the crime scene with Remielle.
QuestDesc_42206: A wanted criminal and a lost soul, similar yet not the best at working together, we kick off our duo dance. Just be careful to not step on each other's toes.
QuestDesc_4220601: Ahead of Griff is the elevator to the bottom of the Retroflux Zone. Get ready, and let's move out.
QuestDesc_4220602: Ahead of Griff is the elevator to the bottom of the Retroflux Zone. Get ready, and let's move out.
QuestDesc_4220603: Singularity Leakages may be present on the lower floors of the Retroflux Zone. Avoid them and work with Remielle to find a path to the crime scene.
QuestDesc_4220604: Rogue abandoned mechs affected by the Singularity Leakage have appeared nearby. Defeat them and push forward.
QuestDesc_4220605: The enemies just keep coming. Gotta clear them out before we can push forward.
QuestDesc_4220606: Remielle's stumbled into a Singularity Leakage. New enemies have appeared. Gotta defeat them before we look for a way out.
QuestDesc_4220607: The crime scene isn't far. Navigate through the Singularity Leakage and keep moving toward your destination.
QuestDesc_4220608: Eliminate enemies in the Singularity Leakage and push forward.
QuestDesc_4220609: Eliminate enemies in the Singularity Leakage and push forward.
QuestDesc_4220610: This is the location from Toby's memories. An anomalous mech has appeared. Take it down and continue investigating.
QuestDesc_4220613: This is the location from Toby's memories. An anomalous mech has appeared. Take it down and continue investigating.
QuestDesc_4220701: Woke up in Remielle's room. Those visions from when I was out... I can't just pretend they never happened. Maybe she'd want to talk about it too.
QuestDesc_4220703: Woke up in Remielle's room. Those visions from when I was out... I can't just pretend they never happened. Maybe she'd want to talk about it too.
QuestDesc_4220801: Headed back to Amber Hall. {F#Wise}{M#Belle} has been waiting for news. Fill {F#him}{M#her} in on everything that happened.
QuestDesc_42209: Those wings, once heavy with pain and solitude, now wrap around a lost dance partner with such tender warmth. We're taking in and understanding each other's regrets and broken pieces.
QuestDesc_4220901: {F#Wise}{M#Belle} already filled Billy and Cissia in on the investigation results. Head over now and start looking into the truth behind the mastermind using the clues from yesterday.
QuestDesc_4220902: {F#Wise}{M#Belle} already filled Billy and Cissia in on the investigation results. Head over now and start looking into the truth behind the mastermind using the clues from yesterday.
QuestDesc_4221006: Remielle brought me back to her place. Though we're not really in the mood to talk, she's showing her concern. Hear her out.
QuestDesc_4221007: Something's making a racket outside. Go check it out.
QuestDesc_4221008: The situation is complicated. Let's head back to Remielle's room and talk with Sigrid.
QuestDesc_42211: That was her golden age. Miracles dotted the sky like stars, and the future was within reach. Now, ruins abandoned for a century whisper of what once was, and she has long since become a stranger with nowhere to call home.
QuestDesc_4221101: Get the soldier to stand down and enter the Scamall Hollow.
QuestDesc_4221102: Get the soldier to stand down and enter the Scamall Hollow.
QuestDesc_4221103: Now that we're at Roswick, ask Remielle about the situation, and confirm the mission target.
QuestDesc_4221104: We'll need the equipment at Meridian Hall to get the data. Head there first.
QuestDesc_4221105: Defeat the enemies blocking your path and obtain the glowing item in front of Meridian Hall.
QuestDesc_4221106: Place the first key component into the device
QuestDesc_4221111: Search the nearby area for the second key component Remielle mentioned.
QuestDesc_4221112: Found the key component, but the path ahead is blocked. Try using the nearby robots to clear the way.
QuestDesc_4221113: Following the path cleared, take down the enemies blocking the way, and obtain the second key component.
QuestDesc_4221114: Place the second key component into the device to unlock the door to Meridian Hall.
QuestDesc_4221117: Enter Meridian Hall and find a device capable of accessing Hollow observation data.
QuestDesc_4221119: Wipe out the enemies in Meridian Hall and push forward to where the equipment is.
QuestDesc_4221120: Boot up the prototype and run the Rosetta Data decryption.
QuestDesc_4221122: Boot up the prototype and run the Rosetta Data decryption.
QuestDesc_42212: A play born of a curse, two actors shouldering notoriety. The curtain is about to fall, dear partner in crime. In this still, fading finale, only you and I remain in this world.
QuestDesc_4221201: Arriving at the banquet hall balcony, Sigrid steps inside first.
QuestDesc_4221202: Tap into the cameras above the banquet hall and scope out the situation.
QuestDesc_4221203: Tap into the cameras above the banquet hall and scope out the situation.
QuestDesc_4221204: Girtablullu has formed a "cocoon" in an attempt to forcibly merge with the Karma Core. It's been making Ether growths to funnel Ether into itself. Destroy those growths to stop the cocoon's growth. Remielle has already pinpointed the two most critical "main arteries." Move fast and sever them.
QuestDesc_4221205: The situation with the cocoon has suddenly changed mid-operation. Periodic explosions have started triggering.
QuestDesc_4221206: Dodge the cocoon's periodic explosions and close in on the first main artery.
QuestDesc_4221207: Head to the target's location and destroy the main artery while Remielle keeps the enemies busy.
QuestDesc_4221208: Destroying the first one worked! Better move fast and head to the second main artery.
QuestDesc_4221209: Dodge the cocoon's periodic explosions and close in on the second main artery.
QuestDesc_4221210: Dodge the cocoon's periodic explosions and close in on the second main artery.
QuestDesc_4221211: Head to the target's location and destroy the second main artery with Remielle's help.
QuestDesc_4221212: We've severed the Ether supple! Now let's go smash the cocoon Girtablullu spun for itself.
QuestDesc_4221213: We've severed the Ether supple! Now let's go smash the cocoon Girtablullu spun for itself.
QuestDesc_4221214: Girtablullu has absorbed the power of the Karma Core and burst from its cocoon. Time to take it down.
QuestDesc_4221215: Cornered, Girtablullu tries to make a run for it, but Remielle is in hot pursuit.
QuestDesc_4221216: Girtablullu's been defeated, but a massive Ethereal devoured it and fled. Good thing we managed to save Dracaene, yet that's when Lindverne shows up with her people...
QuestDesc_4221217: Girtablullu's been defeated, but a massive Ethereal devoured it and fled. Good thing we managed to save Dracaene, yet that's when Lindverne shows up with her people...
QuestDesc_4221301: Now that I played her partner in crime and pulled Remielle away from the scene before she went completely out of control, it's time to have a proper talk.
QuestDesc_4221302: Now that the dust is settled, we're back to Amber Hall. Everyone's concerned about me. Time to sit down and catch everyone up on everything that's happened.
QuestDesc_4221303: Lindverne says Remielle's already waiting at the "usual spot." Go find her now.
QuestDesc_4221304: Lindverne says Remielle's already waiting at the "usual spot." Go find her now.
QuestDesc_4221401: That's the plan for tomorrow. Tonight, let's just rest on the couch.
QuestDesc_4221402: Sigrid's here. Go meet up with her.
QuestDesc_4221403: Sigrid's here. Go meet up with her.
QuestDesc_4221404: Sigrid has a plan to sneak into Roswick, but... anyway, check in with her before we head out.
QuestDesc_4221405: Work with Sigrid to negotiate with the soldiers at the outpost and earn their trust.
QuestDesc_4221501: Head back to the En-Nah Gang hideout, finish building the device to trigger the Singularity Leakage, then confirm the plan one last time with Remielle and Sigrid.
QuestDesc_4221502: When you're ready, head on over to the banquet.
QuestDesc_4221505: When you're ready, head on over to the banquet.
QuestDesc_4222501: Things are quiet again. Let's wait for the right opportunity to continue the investigation.

Remielle_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character or shares the same faction:
When there are 1/2/3 <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> characters in the squad, upon entering the battlefield, all squad members gain an ATK increase equal to 6%/12%/40% of Remielle's initial ATK, up to a maximum increase of 1,600 ATK. Remielle's Daze dealt while in the <Term:1000035></Term> state increases by 6%/12%/35%.
When applying <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> to an enemy, Remielle also applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Prismatic</color> effect: All squad members' attacks against enemies with the <color=#FFFFFF>Prismatic</color> effect have 15% increased Anomaly Buildup Rate. <color=#FFFFFF>Prismatic</color> is removed when the enemy no longer has <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color>. After <color=#FFFFFF>Prismatic</color> is removed, the Anomaly Buildup Rate increase persists for an additional 8s.
Remielle_MathSkill_Desc_Simple:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character or shares the same faction:
Upon entering the battlefield, Remielle grants all squad members an ATK increase based on the number of <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> characters in the squad, and increases her own Daze dealt while in the <Term:1000035></Term> state. 
She also applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Prismatic</color> effect whenever <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> is inflicted on an enemy: All squad members' attacks against <color=#FFFFFF>Prismatic</color> enemies have increased Anomaly Buildup Rate.
Remielle_NounPrompts_01_Des:
When applying Attribute Anomaly Buildup to an enemy, each attack's ATK, PEN, Anomaly Proficiency, DMG Bonus, and other effects proportionally increase the resulting <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly Effect Strength</color> based on that attack's contribution to the total Attribute Anomaly Buildup.
PEN effects: Includes PEN and PEN Ratio
DMG Bonus: Includes both non-Attribute DMG Bonus and Attribute DMG Bonus
Remielle_NounPrompts_02_Des: If an enemy has <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color>, when they're about to be inflicted with an Anomaly, that Anomaly is <color=#FFA9DD>Refringed</color>. After being <color=#FFA9DD>Refringed</color>, the Anomaly's <Term:1000023></Term> is enhanced based on the provider's <color=#FFA9DD>Refringe Coefficient</color>, increasing the total DMG that Anomaly can deal.
Remielle_NounPrompts_03_Des:
Remielle can gain <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> through <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color>.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> reaches its maximum of 120, Remielle can enter the <Term:1000035></Term> state.
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> is consumed over time. When <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> is fully consumed, Remielle exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state.
Remielle_NounPrompts_04_Des: When a squad member triggers Remielle's <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux</color> <Term:1000031></Term> reaction, Remielle generates <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflare</color> based on the enhanced <Term:1000023></Term> of that Attribute Anomaly after it has been <color=#FFA9DD>Refringed</color>. Up to the 3 most recently generated <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflares</color> can be stored.
Remielle_NounPrompts_05_Des: Deals Attribute Anomaly DMG to enemies using the skill's DMG Multiplier, based on the <Term:1000023></Term> of all stored <Term:1000033></Term>.
Remielle_NounPrompts_06_Des: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, Remielle acts autonomously to assist in combat. During this, some attacks can also apply <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> to the target. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, <Term:1000032></Term> is consumed over time. When <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> is fully depleted, she exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state. Before exiting the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, she cannot be actively switched in except through <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color>.

Remielle_SkillText: After slipping back into Mr. Roar's costume, Remielle successfully transforms into the video store's brand ambassador. Thanks to Mr. Roar's massive popularity and the fresh buzz from the unexpected promo angle, visitor traffic is seeing a serious boost.
Remielle_Skill_AssaultAid_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> to activate:
Unleashes a series of slashes against the target, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Remielle_Skill_BeHitAid_Desc:
When the active character is launched, press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> to activate:
Unleashes a slash at the target, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Remielle_Skill_Counter_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at the target, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Remielle_Skill_ExQTE_02_Desc:
When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:
Launches an attack across a large area in front, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
If the skill hits, the <Term:1000034></Term> effect can be triggered after the skill ends with a multiplier of <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:210+AvatarSkillLevel(3)*10.5,1,2}%</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Remielle_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
Upon entering the battlefield, if Remielle has less than 60 Energy, her Energy is recovered to 60. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful attack across a large area ahead, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
After the skill ends, apply 2 <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> to all enemies hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Remielle_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc_Simple:
With enough energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate , dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>, and applying 2 <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> to enemies hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Remielle_Skill_ExSpecial_Title: EX Special Attack: Ode to Dawn
Remielle_Skill_FinishEx_Desc:
Enters the battlefield and unleashes an attack in a large area, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
Consumes 40 <Term:1000032></Term> upon activation. With 90 or fewer <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> remaining upon activation, this <color=#FFFFFF>Assist: Flower & Feather Dance</color> does not consume <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color>. Remielle also enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Luminous Reflection</color> state, and the next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Rainbow's End</color> is upgraded to <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace</color>.
When this skill hits a Stunned enemy, their Stun duration is extended by 3s. Each enemy can be affected by this effect only once per Stun window. This Stun duration increase cannot stack with other effects of the same type.
If this skill lands a hit, the <Term:1000034></Term> effect can be triggered after the skill ends with a multiplier of <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:200+AvatarSkillLevel(6)*10,1,2}%</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Remielle_Skill_Normal_02_Desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs a slash in an area ahead, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
If it hits a target, gains <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> after the skill ends.
Remielle_Skill_Normal_02_Desc_Simple: Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch a slash in an area and gain <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color>.
Remielle_Skill_Normal_03_Desc:
When Remielle has stored <Term:1000033></Term>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful attack across a large area ahead, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
Grants a large amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> when the skill ends.
If the attack hits a target, triggers the <Term:1000034></Term> effect after the skill ends with a <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:100+AvatarSkillLevel(0)*5,1,2}%</color> multiplier.
Consumes all stored <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflare</color> upon use.
Remielle_Skill_Normal_03_Desc_Simple: With <Term:1000033></Term>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to unleash a large area attack, triggering <Term:1000034></Term> and gaining <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color>.
Remielle_Skill_Normal_04_Desc:
When Remielle has stored <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflare</color> and is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Luminous Reflection</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful attack across a large area ahead, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
Grants a large amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> when the skill ends.
If the attack hits a target, triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Luminize</color> effect after the skill ends with a <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:200+AvatarSkillLevel(0)*10,1,2}%</color> multiplier.
Consumes all stored <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflare</color> upon use.
Remielle_Skill_Normal_04_Desc_Simple: With <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflare</color>, and while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Luminous Reflection</color> state, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to unleash a large area attack, trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Luminize</color>, and gain <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color>.
Remielle_Skill_Normal_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Performs up to four attacks ahead, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
If the Basic Attack hits the target, gains <Term:1000032></Term> after the skill ends.
After the 4th hit of the Basic Attack ends, 1 <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> is applied to enemies hit.
Remielle_Skill_Normal_Desc_Simple: Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch up to four attacks, granting <Term:1000032></Term>. The 4th hit of the Basic Attack applies <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> to enemies.
Remielle_Skill_QTE_Desc:
When a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches multiple attacks ahead in a large area, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
Enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Luminous Reflection</color> state upon activation. The next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Rainbow's End</color> is upgraded to <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace</color>.
After the skill ends, apply 2 <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> to enemies hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Remielle_Skill_Rush_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during a dodge to activate:
Launches a quick attack ahead, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
Remielle_Skill_Special_01_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Launches a ranged attack ahead, dealing <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux DMG</color>.
Remielle_Skill_Special_02_Desc:
When Remielle is in combat and her <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> reaches its maximum of 120, hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> after a <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> to enter <color=#FFFFFF>Stance Shift</color>. Switching characters while in <color=#FFFFFF>Stance Shift</color> causes Remielle to enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state:
While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, Remielle acts autonomously to assist in combat. In this state, <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> is consumed over time, and some of her attacks apply <color=#FFA9DD>Lumiflux Buildup</color> to the target. When <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> is fully depleted or upon leaving combat, Remielle exits the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state. Before exiting the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, Remielle cannot be actively switched in except via a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>.
If Remielle triggers 3 <Term:1000031></Term> reactions in one <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, or has at least 1 stored <Term:1000033></Term> when <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> is fully depleted, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist: Flower & Feather Dance</color> becomes available, and her normal switch-in is unlocked. <color=#FFFFFF>Assist: Flower & Feather Dance</color> is automatically used on Remielle's next normal switch-in.
Upon entering the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, Remielle increases all squad members's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>{CAL:0+AvatarSkillLevel(1)*1.5,1,2}%</color> for 60s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When Remielle's <color=#FFFFFF>Floating Radiance</color> has reached its maximum of 120 and her <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits a Stunned enemy, she can also enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state by switching characters during the <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>.
If no character is switched in after entering <color=#FFFFFF>Stance Shift</color>, Remielle uses a downward attack to return to the ground instead.
Remielle_Skill_Special_02_Desc_Simple: Hold <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate. Enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, and increases all squad members' DMG dealt. If 3 <Term:1000031></Term> reactions are triggered in one <color=#FFFFFF>Phase Flow</color> state, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist: Flower & Feather Dance</color> is automatically activated on the next normal switch-in.
Remielle_Skill_Special_02_Title: Special Attack: Ode to Dawn - Radiant Turn
Remielle_Talent_01_Desc_01: Upon entering the battlefield, Remielle gains 3 special <Term:1000033></Term>s. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. When Remielle triggers <Term:1000034></Term> to deal DMG, she ignores 50% of the target's All-Attribute RES. When using <color=#FFFFFF>Assist: Flower & Feather Dance</color>, she gains 200 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 18s. While Remielle is in the <Term:1000035></Term> state, other squad members' Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by 10%.
Remielle_Talent_01_Desc_01_Realign:
Upon entering the battlefield, Remielle gains 3 special <Term:1000033></Term>s. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When Remielle triggers <Term:1000034></Term> to deal DMG, she ignores 50% of the target's All-Attribute RES.
When using <color=#FFFFFF>Assist: Flower & Feather Dance</color>, she gains 200 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
While Remielle is in the <Term:1000035></Term> state, other squad members' Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by 10%.
Remielle_Talent_01_Desc_02:
"We can put an end to evil and split the heavens. We can walk out of the fog and step closer to the truth..."
"This is our nation, forever standing tall, and with the power to accomplish miracles."
"..."
The pink-haired girl finally can't hold it in anymore. Lowering the brim of her hat, she quietly grumbles to the figure at the front of the line:
"Beli... This oath is way too long. We're not going to have to recite it all the time, are we?"
"Just wait. It'll only get longer."
Even the ever-composed figure can't help but smile wryly.

Remielle_Talent_02_Desc_02:
It was a grand ball.
The city was captivated. Even the full moon paled beside it.
Crowds gathered in celebration, calling out the heroes' names, laughing and singing as though the night would never end.
Those of unparalleled achievement stood together, gazing upon the jubilant crowd as they made a humble vow. "This is where miracles begin."
And so, Eridu's journey was about to begin.
A great adventure to reclaim the world.
"Come on, the ball's almost over, and you still haven't found a partner? Well... I suppose I can spare you a dance."
Remielle_Talent_03_Desc_02:
The girl wrote her name among the Sunseekers, driven by an ideal that burned brighter than the blazing sun.
She believed every wound could be healed. She believed every sacrifice could one day come to an end. And so, she turned and walked into the secret garden.
She did not yet know that, deep within that garden, time forever diverged, leading to countless futures.
Some led to glory. Some led to hope...
Others led to the shadow cast by the sun, to a long night that no one would remember.
"I know, I know. But someone's gotta do it, right?"

Remielle_Talent_04_Desc_02:
She awakens to a pale, desolate world
A hundred years is a dream too long. Long enough for the mists to swallow the remnants of a bygone age. Long enough for pale silence to smother the lingering warmth in her memory.
A hundred years is a dream too short. Short enough that the smile before parting still reflects in her eyes. Short enough that her fingertips still reach for a fleeting dance.
Then she remembers a summer night. The star-filled sky they once gazed upon together. So she begins to dance alone, just as she always has.
Turn. Pause. Reach. Fall into empty air.
To an old friend. To a bygone age.
May this lament serve as the farewell that has waited a hundred years to be spoken.
"Hey... Care to share a dance with me?"
Remielle_Talent_05_Desc_02:
Dusk spills over the rooftops of the world, and lights flicker on one by one. Behind every window glows the warmth of home.
Her thin clothes do little to keep out the wind and rain. The girl once called a hero fusses over her disheveled wings.
She drains a cup brimming with forgetfulness, yet searing memories still burn her throat as moonlight flows across her lowered gaze.
"Be careful... The ghosts of the old world just might come knocking at your window."

Remielle_Talent_06_Desc_02:
The end of one journey is simply the beginning of another. Beyond every sky of stars lies yet another.
So, once more... just once more, spread your wings and soar.
Silent, fallen feathers will touch the sky again,
crossing scars that have yet to heal, crossing the shattered yesterdays,
toward a tomorrow still waiting to be written.
"My story ends here. I believe it's your turn now, dear partner-in-crime."

Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after an <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color> to activate:
Commands Drusilla and Anastella to continuously advance while generating a vortex of electricity, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

When Decibel Rating is at <color=#FFFFFF>Maximum</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_UltimateReady> to activate:

Upon activating this skill, other squad members recover 10 Energy. The next character to switch in recovers an additional 20 Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered.
Rina_Skill_ExSpecial_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is triggered.
Rina_Skill_FollowAttack_ExNormal_Desc: When <color=#FFFFFF><Term:1000026></Term></color> reaches 6 stacks, the next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Morning Cleanup</color> performed by Drusilla or Anastella consumes all <color=#FFFFFF>Fright</color> stacks and is replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Midnight Cleanup</color>, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. Rina_Skill_FollowAttack_Normal_Desc: After Rina uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Spotless</color> state for 13s. During this time, Drusilla or Anastella attacks an enemy once every 2.5s, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>, and grants 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Fright</color>, up to a maximum of 6 stacks. After using the skill, Drusilla and Anastella's exit timer resets.

Side_GalGame_ZenkovS1_100100012_008: Yes. You can think of the Cacophony as a form of <color=#FFAF2C>high-frequency Ether noise</color>. Similar to Miasma, the special liquid Ether found in Lemnian Hollow, Cacophony contains unique energy capable of influencing the mind...

Side_GalGame_ZenkovS1_100100019_003: Ehn-ne, ehn-ne-ne... (It took me and a lot of crystals through the mist and into a fissure in an underground place that looked a lot like Lumina Square, which led to its fiery lair.)
Side_GalGame_ZenkovS1_100100019_006: But why were you dancing when we found you?
Side_GalGame_ZenkovS1_100100019_008: Ehn-ne, ehn-ne-ne! (Ugh... It was too hot so I entered emergency hibernation, and I think I heard master's voice... When I woke back up, the fire Ethereal was still moving me around!)
Side_GalGame_ZenkovS1_100100019_009: Ehn-ne, ehn-ne-ne. (It put my limbs in a weird pose, and it was like the Labyrinth Carrot inside me got activated, suddenly making a strange sound.)
Side_GalGame_ZenkovS1_100100019_010: Ehn-ne-ne, ehn-ne... (But the fire Ethereal seemed to calm down when hearing it. So I tried to run, but the sound stopped too, and the fire Ethereal got angry again...)
Side_GalGame_ZenkovS1_100100019_011: Ehn-ne, ehn-ne-ne... (I could only try twisting into all kinds of poses to see if I could make the Labyrinth Carrot make that sound again.)

Side_GalGame_ZenkovS1_100100020_009: As the designer of the research station, Omond Flint has earned the right to name this operation. Therefore, it shall officially be called Operation Bagel!

Sigrid_SkillText: The current Deputy Director of the Airspace Patrol Department has long been known throughout the sky island for her strict and methodical command style — and now she's bringing that same no-nonsense professionalism to New Eridu's entertainment scene. Sigrid will meticulously hand-pick the perfect videotapes for every customer... as long as she can resist making them stand at attention first.

If Sigrid is attacked while charging the 1st or 2nd stage of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>, she blocks with her shield. On a successful block, the attack's DMG is negated, the next <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color> deals 100% more Daze, the <Term:1000030></Term> state is refreshed, and she gains one use of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>. Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after a successful block to perform the corresponding stage of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color> performed after <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear</color> retains the current stage of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear</color>.
DMG taken is reduced by 60% during this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Character is invulnerable during the third stage of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>.

Sigrid_Talent_01_Desc_02:
Long, long ago, Lady Sunbringer lifted the very first handful of soil that would become this sky island...
Alright, alright. The children have already heard the story of Lady Sunbringer creating Roscaelifer's first island a thousand times over.
Today, we're telling the story of the warrior who stood at Lady Sunbringer's side. Clad in moon-bright silver armor, she looked just like an ancient knight from a fairy tale...
Sigrid_Talent_02_Desc_01: PEN Ratio of <color=#FFFFFF>Unbridled Spear</color> attacks and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color> increases by <color=#FFFFFF>24%</color>. The duration of <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color> is extended by 2s. Sigrid's Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10%.

PEN Ratio of <color=#FFFFFF>Unbridled Spear</color> attacks and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color> increases by <color=#FFFFFF>24%</color>.
The duration of <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color> is extended by 2s. Sigrid's Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10%.
Sigrid_Talent_02_Desc_02:
She was Roscaelifer's first soldier, its first spear. She stood on the first front line against the Hollows and led the very first charge.
She was the first wing to follow Lady Sunbringer, and with her own hands, she raised Roscaelifer's very first wall.
She was Roscaelifer's first blade broken. Her family name was de L'Azur.
Like her legend, her descendants burn eternally in the night sky above Roscaelifer.
Sigrid_Talent_03_Desc_02:
Roscaelifer is the miracle of the skies, and the title of those who protect that miracle has never belonged to only a select few.
Yet someone must lead those guardians. That was originally Lady Lindverne's duty, but with her bright and carefree nature, she was hardly suited to be a commanding general.
Fortunately, she had a dashing deputy. More accurately, she had one after another.
Sigrid_Talent_04_Desc_01: Each time upon gaining <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color>, DMG dealt increases by <color=#FFFFFF>18%</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s. Repeated triggers extend the duration by <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s, up to a maximum of <color=#FFFFFF>40</color>s.
Sigrid_Talent_04_Desc_01_Realign: Each time upon gaining <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color>, DMG dealt increases by <color=#FFFFFF>18%</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s. Repeated triggers extend the duration by <color=#FFFFFF>8</color>s, up to a maximum of <color=#FFFFFF>40</color>s.
Sigrid_Talent_04_Desc_02:
The soldiers and civilians couldn't help comparing the newly appointed Deputy Administrative Director to her predecessor. Who can blame them? After all, according to Lady Lindverne Sunbringer, every head of House de L'Azur was a legendary figure.
Because of that, everyone expected the young de L'Azur to surpass the last, proving worthy of the legendary guardian family's name.
And so Lindverne continued weaving new, even more groundbreaking legends for Sigrid.
Sigrid_Talent_05_Desc_02:
Today, Lady Sunbringer commands countless followers through her reputation as a Void Hunter alone. But every renowned leader once stood with no one behind them.
To follow that young leader into the skies and build a miracle city that should never have been possible required either a brute's courage or a fool's innocence.
And each time a new de L'Azur recites that oath to conquer the skies, those two qualities shine brilliantly once more.
Sigrid_Talent_06_Desc_01: When <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>'s 1st/2nd/3rd stage's final hit lands, it deals an additional <color=#FFFFFF>80%</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>90%</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>100%</color> ATK as <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>. There is no more limit on the number of times Sigrid can enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Formation Breaker</color> state upon hitting a Stunned enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Formation Breaker</color> state's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color> will activate faster.

There is no more limit on the number of times Sigrid can enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Formation Breaker</color> state upon hitting a Stunned enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice</color>.
<color=#FFFFFF>Formation Breaker</color> state's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color> will activate faster.
Sigrid_Talent_06_Desc_02:
Ancient legends tell of a Knight of the Lake.
In the ballads of the distant future, a frostbound spear will also pierce the skies across time and space.
"Until this spear is broken, the miracle of the skies shall never end."

SummerTideTreasure_BeachStagePageTip_Des:
<color=#FFFFFF>[Introduction]</color>
· Those who journey from the skies to the open sea shall receive a gift from the waves—
  An extraordinary encounter lit by firelight... and an unforgettable summer in full bloom.
· Once the event begins, the Proxy can vacation at Fantasy Resort alongside <color=#D9A600>Remielle, Sigrid, Lucy</color>, and other Characters, while <color=#D9A600>running a brand-new souvenir store</color> together.
· Participate in "Seaside Beachcombing" and "Treasure Trading" gameplay to <color=#D9A600>earn store revenue</color> and <color=#D9A600>throw an epic bonfire party</color>!

<color=#FFFFFF>[Store Revenue]</color>
· During the event, the event mission "Summer Waves Roll In" and event gameplay "Seaside Beachcombing" and "Treasure Trading" will <color=#D9A600>unlock gradually over time</color>, and the <color=#D9A600>revenue</color> cap for the souvenir store will also <color=#D9A600>increase gradually over time</color>. Participating in "Seaside Beachcombing" and "Treasure Trading" will earn you <color=#D9A600>"Store Revenue"</color>
· Reaching the corresponding Store Revenue milestone lets you claim the matching rewards from the event homepage.

<color=#FFFFFF>[Seaside Beachcombing]</color>
· Choose the beachcombing tools carried by different Agents and head out for a unique beach haul. Within the <color=#D9A600>limited stage time</color>, use your specially crafted tools to <color=#D9A600>gather as many Sea Materials as possible</color>.

<color=#FFFFFF>[Treasure Trading]</color>
· Run your souvenir store and <color=#D9A600>craft souvenirs using the Sea Materials harvested in "Seaside Beachcombing"</color> to fulfill customer orders. Completing orders not only earns you <color=#D9A600>revenue</color> but also grants <color=#D9A600>buffs</color> that make <color=#D9A600>completing future orders even easier</color>. Keep stacking those buffs and knock out orders to <color=#D9A600>rake in massive revenue</color>.

<color=#FFFFFF>[Sea Materials]</color>
· During the event, special marine items like conch shells and starfish will appear on the beach. Picking them up yields raw Sea Materials needed for "Treasure Trading" — and you might just stumble upon some unexpected surprises too.

SummerTideTreasure_CollectPageTip_Desc:
<color=#FFFFFF>[Introduction]</color>
· Those who journey from the skies to the open sea shall receive a gift from the waves—
  An extraordinary encounter lit by firelight... and an unforgettable summer in full bloom.
· Once the event begins, the Proxy can vacation at Fantasy Resort alongside <color=#D9A600>Remielle, Sigrid, Lucy</color>, and other Characters, while <color=#D9A600>running a brand-new souvenir store</color> together.
· Participate in "Seaside Beachcombing" and "Treasure Trading" gameplay to <color=#D9A600>earn store revenue</color> and <color=#D9A600>throw an epic bonfire party</color>!

<color=#FFFFFF>[Store Revenue]</color>
· During the event, the event mission "Summer Waves Roll In" and event gameplay "Seaside Beachcombing" and "Treasure Trading" will <color=#D9A600>unlock gradually over time</color>, and the <color=#D9A600>revenue</color> cap for the souvenir store will also <color=#D9A600>increase gradually over time</color>. Participating in "Seaside Beachcombing" and "Treasure Trading" will earn you <color=#D9A600>"Store Revenue"</color>
· Reaching the corresponding Store Revenue milestone lets you claim the matching rewards from the event homepage.

<color=#FFFFFF>[Seaside Beachcombing]</color>
· Choose the beachcombing tools carried by different Agents and head out for a unique beach haul. Within the <color=#D9A600>limited stage time</color>, use your specially crafted tools to <color=#D9A600>gather as many Sea Materials as possible</color>.

<color=#FFFFFF>[Treasure Trading]</color>
· Run your souvenir store and <color=#D9A600>craft souvenirs using the Sea Materials harvested in "Seaside Beachcombing"</color> to fulfill customer orders. Completing orders not only earns you <color=#D9A600>revenue</color> but also grants <color=#D9A600>buffs</color> that make <color=#D9A600>completing future orders even easier</color>. Keep stacking those buffs and knock out orders to <color=#D9A600>rake in massive revenue</color>.

<color=#FFFFFF>[Sea Materials]</color>
· During the event, special marine items like conch shells and starfish will appear on the beach. Picking them up yields raw Sea Materials needed for "Treasure Trading" — and you might just stumble upon some unexpected surprises too.

TL_C31_ChatPlus_01_03: (Did she already know Wise and I are here? No, she probably doesn't... Right, they just introduced her as 'the daughter of the High Ambitions Corp.'...)
TL_C31_ChatPlus_01_04: (Did she already know Belle and I are here? No, she probably didn't... Right, they just introduced her as 'the heir of the head of High Ambitions Corp.'...)
TL_C31_ChatPlus_01_06: (Should I pretend I don't know her? Or... no, she seems to have noticed me too... Should I go say hi? No... never mind, when it comes down to it...)
TL_C31_ChatPlus_01_30: Unlike an old man such as myself. At my age, there are hardly any classmates left to reunite with...
TL_C31_ChatPlus_01_33: (That Professor Salvi certainly knows how to put people on the spot... What do I do? Am I really going to spend the next few hours feeling this awkward? Somebody help...)
TL_C31_ChatPlus_01_37: Sorry, Miss Truvia, that was our oversight. We did not account for a situation like this.
TL_C31_ChatPlus_01_38: Today's tea party is just a casual welcome we have put together for you all. You do not need to worry about a thing. We will be hosting a proper formal reception for everyone down the line.
TL_C31_ChatPlus_01_39: If you are feeling a bit under the weather... how about having Miss Belle accompany you for a stroll in the nearby park so you can rest.
TL_C31_ChatPlus_01_40: If you are feeling a bit under the weather... how about having Mr. Wise accompany you for a stroll in the nearby park so you can rest.
TL_C31_ChatPlus_01_43: (Miss Truvia politely declined the tea party. She probably wants to catch up with her old classmate who she has not seen in ages!)
TL_C31_ChatPlus_01_45: (Mr. Wise, too... He seems to have a lot to say to Miss Truvia... Yes, that must be it! Then allow me... to lend you all a helping hand!)
TL_C31_ChatPlus_09_01: "Now, let us follow the music and dance with our partners! May we all have a wonderful evening!"
TL_C31_ChatPlus_09_08: Remielle, stay down! What if someone sees you?
TL_C31_ChatPlus_09_12: No matter how we frame it... what we're about to do could be considered an assassination.
TL_C31_ChatPlus_09_13: No matter how we frame it... what we're about to do could be considered an assassination.
TL_C31_ChatPlus_09_18: Huh? Dancing? Right here? Right now?
TL_C31_ChatPlus_09_23: For the record, I've never really danced before... If I step on your foot, don't blame me.
TL_C31_ChatPlus_10_13: So... why didn't you tell me sooner? About your plan with Sigrid... and Lady Lindverne?
TL_C31_ChatPlus_10_21: You really are impossibly headstrong, Remielle.
TL_C31_ChatPlus_10_23: You're the one who called me your "partner-in-crime." You're the one who held me together on that rainy night. And now you're leaving me behind?
TL_C31_ChatPlus_10_25: Did you forget you're over a hundred years old already... How long are you going to keep acting like a cranky child?
TL_C31_ChatPlus_10_28: I get it. Sometimes... someone's has step up and do what must be done.
TL_C31_ChatPlus_10_32: But that doesn't mean you have to shoulder the burden all alone.
TL_C31_ChatPlus_12_05: (I don't understand the situation yet, but... I need to explain this to her.)
TL_C31_ChatPlus_12_14: (Remielle... Why does it feel like you expected this? What are you trying to pull?)
TL_C31_ChatPlus_12_17: The former Void Hunter, Remielle Dan... I never imagined a legendary figure like her could still be alive! But... Why would she be the one to attempt to assassinate Lady Sunbringer?!

Tsubaki_MathSkill_Enhance_Desc:
When another character in your squad is a Support character, or shares the same attribute or Faction:
After Nekomata uses <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Disappearing Tail</color>, or after any squad member inflicts <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> on an enemy, Nekomata's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> deal 35% more DMG on hit. This effect stacks up to 2 times and lasts 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Tsubaki_NounPrompts_01_Des:
Nekomata gains 40 Purr Energy upon entering the battlefield. She recovers 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Purr Energy</color> every second, and different skills restore different amounts of Purr Energy on hit.
When Purr Energy is at least 40, press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> after triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> to consume 30 Purr Energy and activate Dodge: Disappearing Tail.
When Purr Energy is at least 40, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 40 Purr Energy and directly activate Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw.
Tsubaki_NounPrompts_02_Des:
Nekomata enters Pawpad Ambush state for 40s after using Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While Pawpad Ambush is active, all of Nekomata's attacks count as hitting from behind and trigger Super Mean Pawprint, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> equal to 30% of Nekomata's ATK. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
Tsubaki_SkillList_13_Content: <IconMap:Icon_Normal> (After activating Dodge: Disappearing Tail) or <IconMap:Icon_Normal> (Hold) (With sufficient Purr Energy)
Tsubaki_Skill_EvadeSpecial_Desc:
With at least 40 <Term:1000024></Term> and after triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> and consume 30 Purr Energy to activate:
Nekomata enters Vital View and swiftly moves behind the enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. This skill does not consume dodge uses.
Tsubaki_Skill_ExSpecial_Enhance_Desc:
With enough Energy, press <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful falling slash, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
This skill's pursuit effect is enhanced.
Tsubaki_Skill_ExSpecial_EvadeSpecialBran:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> after using <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge: Disappearing Tail</color>, or hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> with at least 40 <Term:1000024></Term> to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Tsubaki_Skill_Normal_Branch_Enhance_Desc:
Hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> during the first three hits of Nekomata's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> to activate:
Slashes enemies in front and passes through them, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
If this skill hits a Stunned enemy, it repeats three additional times.
Tsubaki_Skill_Normal_Enhance_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate:
Unleashes up to five slashes, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
When the final slash lands on a Stunned enemy, it repeats three additional times.
Tsubaki_Skill_Special_Enhance_Desc:
Press <IconMap:Icon_Special> to activate:
Unleashes a downward strike, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color>.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
This skill's pursuit effect is enhanced.
Tsubaki_UniqueSkill_01_Enhance_Desc:
When Nekomata's <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> hits an enemy, her DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Nekomata gains 40 <Term:1000024></Term> upon entering the battlefield. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
While Nekomata is in combat, she gains 1 Purr Energy every second, up to a maximum of 60. Different skills restore different amounts of Purr Energy when they hit an enemy.
When Nekomata has at least 40 Purr Energy and after triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Evade> to consume 30 Purr Energy and activate Dodge: Disappearing Tail. Then press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to perform Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw once without consuming Purr Energy.
When Nekomata has at least 40 Purr Energy, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to consume 40 Purr Energy and activate Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw.
When using Dodge Counter: Fluffy Piercing Claw, Nekomata enters the <Term:1000025></Term> state for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While Pawpad Ambush is active, all of Nekomata's attacks count as hitting from behind.
While Pawpad Ambush is active, Nekomata's attacks trigger Super Mean Pawprint, dealing an additional instance of <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> equal to 30% of her ATK. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
Nekomata restores 20 additional Purr Energy when using her Ultimate, 10 when using her Chain Attack, and 5 when using her EX Special Attack.

Velina_MathSkill_Desc:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character or shares the same attribute:
Velina's <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> DMG increases by 10%. When the heavy attack from an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> hits an enemy suffering a <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Attribute Anomaly</color>, it triggers an instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG against the target: resolves one additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG, fixed at <color=#A6C5FD>680%</color> of <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Attribute Anomaly DMG</color>.
For <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Breeze in Bloom</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Attribute Anomaly Buildup RES</color> reduction from <Term:1000016></Term> is further increased by 7%, while Daze inflicted increases by 30%, and accumulated Attribute Anomaly Buildup increases by 15%.
Velina_MathSkill_Desc_Simple:
When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character or shares the same attribute:
Velina's <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> DMG increases. An <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> heavy attack triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> once against enemies suffering a <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Attribute Anomaly</color>.
For <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Breeze in Bloom</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Attribute Anomaly Buildup RES</color> reduction from <Term:1000016></Term> is further increased, while Daze inflicted and accumulated Attribute Anomaly Buildup increase as well.
Velina_NounPrompts_04_Des: When Velina uses <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Eye of the Storm</color> or triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> while consuming 2 points of <Term:1000014>Windbite</Term>, she summons a <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> to continuously deal <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color> that is capable of triggering the <Term:1000017>Chromatic Tint</Term> effect. When <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> attacks hit enemies, the enemy's <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly Buildup RES</color> and the corresponding <color=#FFFFFF>Attribute Anomaly Buildup RES</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Chromatic Tint</color> are reduced. When <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> dissipates, it triggers an explosion. If the explosion hits an enemy suffering a <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it deals one instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG.
Velina_NounPrompts_05_Des: When <Term:1000016>Sweeping Cyclone</Term> hits an enemy afflicted with <color=#FFFFFF>Contamination</color> for the first time, it triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Chromatic Tint</color> effect, converting into a <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> of the corresponding attribute and dealing the corresponding attribute's DMG.

Velina_UniqueSkill_01_Desc:
When Velina's initial Energy Regen exceeds 1.2, every additional 0.01 increases DMG dealt by 0.21%, up to a maximum increase of 35%, and increases Anomaly Mastery by 0.5, up to a maximum increase of 84.
When Velina enters the battlefield, she gains 45 <Term:1000008>Windbloom</Term>. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. Using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Purifying Rise</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Triple Deathblow</color> grants 45 <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>, up to a maximum of 135 <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>. 
When Velina triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, she gains 1 point of <Term:1000014>Windbite</Term> and summons a <Term:1000015>Condensed Cyclone</Term>, dealing <color=#A6C5FD>Wind DMG</color>. This effect can trigger once every 3s. When Velina has 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>, the next time she triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>, 2 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color> are consumed to increase that <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color>'s DMG Multiplier by <color=#2BAD00>90%</color>. In addition, a <Term:1000016>Sweeping Cyclone</Term> is summoned instead of a <color=#FFFFFF>Condensed Cyclone</color>, which does not grant <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>.
When Velina's summoned <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> hits an enemy suffering <color=#FFFFFF>Contamination</color> for the first time, it triggers <Term:1000017>Chromatic Tint</Term>, converting it into a <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> of the corresponding attribute, dealing the corresponding attribute's DMG. When <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> hits an enemy, the enemy's <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly Buildup RES</color> is reduced by 7% for 35s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. If a <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> enhanced by <color=#FFFFFF>Chromatic Tint</color> hits an enemy, the enemy's corresponding <color=#FFFFFF>Attribute Anomaly Buildup RES</color> is also reduced by 7% for 35s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When an enemy affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> is defeated, the duration of that <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> is extended by 5s. This effect can only trigger once for the same <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color>, and only one <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> can exist at a time.
<color=#FFFFFF>Condensed Cyclone</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> trigger an explosion when they dissipate. If this explosion hits an enemy suffering a <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color>, it triggers one instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> DMG against the target: resolves an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG, dealing a fixed <color=#2BAD00>85%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>135%</color> multiplier <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly DMG</color> respectively.

Velina's initial Energy Regen increases her Anomaly Mastery and DMG dealt.
When Velina enters the battlefield, she gains <Term:1000008>Windbloom</Term>. Upon using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Purifying Rise</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Wind Shear - Triple Deathblow</color>, she obtains <color=#FFFFFF>Windbloom</color>.

VoidHunter_Des_Remielle:
In the ancient capital beneath the Moon's gaze, six souls once committed the folly of overreach.
They slew Their Messenger and seized the authority They had bestowed.
Some say they forged it into an eternal mark of glory.
Some say they branded it into a sacrificial seal.
...
Rumors swirl, but the truth has long since faded from memory.
Perhaps it is for this very reason that she has returned from a stillness stretching a hundred years.
Perhaps what she seeks is the answer from a century past... the answer no one knows.

ZKEvent_10200801_Desc:
<color=#FFAF2C>Limited-Time Advanced Event: Find the Fragile Carrot Fragment, transport it across the map to the Decoder, and win the positional battle to earn the Z-Rank collectible "Stable Carrot Fragment"</color>

Pickup:
Players must reach the destination before the countdown expires and stash the "Fragile Carrot Fragment" in their Inventory;

Transport:
Cross the map and deliver the Fragile Carrot Fragment to the "Decoder" location;

Break:
Once the fragment is inserted into the Decoder, the breaking process begins—clear all enemy waves to complete the break;

Reward:
After breaking is complete, the Decoder produces the <color=#FFAF2C>"Stable Carrot Fragment"</color>—a Z-Rank collectible. Grab it and cash in.

<color=#FFAF2C>Intermediate Event:</color>

- <color=#FFAF2C>Blazewood Train:</color> A <color=#FFAF2C>"Blazewood Station Key"</color> can be found in the Precinct to board the train and head directly to the resort;
-<color=#FFAF2C> Speedboat Extraction:</color> A <color=#FFAF2C>"Speedboat Key"</color> can be found in the Precinct to complete the extraction via speedboat.

ZKItem_4320276_Desc: <color=#FFAF2C>Gear-Defense Z 1</color> is a Legendary-quality Defense Expertise Equipment. The ultimate piece crafted for top-tier Defense Characters.
ZKItem_4320277_Desc: <color=#FFAF2C>Attack Gear-Z 2</color> is the ultimate form of legendary Expertise Equipment for the Attack type. Those who wield it are blessed with earth-shattering ATK that can level anything in its path.
ZKItem_4320278_Desc: <color=#FFAF2C>Gear-Anomaly Z 2</color> is the ultimate form of Anomaly-type Legendary Expertise Equipment. The otherworldly power sealed within is strong enough to warp the very laws of reality.
ZKItem_4320279_Desc: <color=#FFAF2C>Support Gear Z 2</color> is the ultimate form of legendary Support Expertise Equipment. Its protective power borders on the divine, keeping the team standing no matter what.
ZKItem_4321001_Desc: After using Etheric Phantom: Primordial Nightmare, the incoming Agent's Chain Attack is replaced with their Ultimate. After entering Enlightened Mind, the first use of Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum <color=#2BAD00>grants 3 Qingming Sword Force</color> and <color=#2BAD00>ignores 45% of the enemy's Physical RES</color> for 15s.
ZKItem_4321002_Desc: After Hoshimi Miyabi executes a Powerful Slash on an enemy, she immediately restores 1 Fallen Frost point. Enemies afflicted with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> <color=#2BAD00>take <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color> equal to 260% of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK per second</color>. Upon triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi can bypass the restrictions of <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> and <color=#2BAD00>immediately reapply <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to enemies</color>.
ZKItem_4321003_Desc: When triggering a Perfect Block, Yixuan immediately recovers 60 Adrenaline. While charging for EX Special Attack: Ink Manifestation, Perfect Block can be triggered, after which additionally restores 15 Technique Points and gains <color=#2BAD00>18% DMG boost</color> that lasts for 15s. Each Perfect Block against an enemy increases the next Ultimate <color=#2BAD00>DMG by an additional 20%</color>, stacking up to 3 times.
ZKItem_4321003_Name: [Fragile][Yixuan] Gold Talisman of Mystic Feathers - Lv.50
ZKItem_4321004_Desc: Nangong Yu's Precise Charging deals 20% more Daze. If your Inventory contains a Valuable, Etheric Phantom: Scorched Horizon increases the Stun DMG Multiplier of enemies it hits by 30%. When Nangong Yu triggers Precise Charging, all squad members <color=#2BAD00>recover 4 Energy</color>. Whenever any squad member uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, all squad members recover 120 Decibels.
ZKItem_4321005_Desc: When dealing DMG to enemies using Etheric Phantom, applies a certain amount of Daze. If <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> drop below 90, immediately <color=#2BAD00>restores 60 Positive Reviews</color> and <color=#2BAD00>restores squad members' Decibels by 750</color>. This effect can be triggered once every 30s.
ZKItem_4321006_Desc:
When using Etheric Phantom, the squad's Corruption value is greatly reduced. When Lucia upgrades a skill or uses an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, she gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Surge</color>, stacking up to 4 times;
Upon exiting the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, all <color=#FFFFFF>Surge</color> stacks will be consumed, where each consumed stack <color=#2BAD00>regenerates 10 Energy for herself</color>.
ZKItem_4321007_Desc: When Etheric Phantom is used, Sunna immediately recovers 60 Energy. When Sunna's Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise is active, all squad members <color=#2BAD00>deal 80% more DMG</color> with their Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Dodge Counter, Special Attack, and EX Special Attack.
ZKItem_4321008_Desc: Medicine takes effect immediately. During the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, characters with <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> specialty gain <color=#2BAD00>30% increased CRIT DMG</color>, characters with <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> specialty gain <color=#2BAD00>60 increased Anomaly Proficiency</color>, and characters with Rupture specialty deal <color=#2BAD00>15% increased Sheer DMG</color>. When the active character hits enemies with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#2BAD00>Astra Yao will regenerates 4 Energy</color> and <color=#2BAD00>perform an additional attack with <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color></color>. The Energy Generation effect can be triggered once per second.
ZKItem_4321009_Desc: Using Etheric Phantom: Unfathomable deals additional Abloom DMG. While <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> is on the field, all squad members' <color=#2BAD00>Energy Generation Rate increases by 40% and Decibel Generation Rate by 30%</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> <color=#2BAD00>lasts 3s longer</color>.
ZKItem_4321010_Desc: Remielle's exclusive Tactical Prism. When an Agent in the team takes fatal damage, if there are other Agents available to switch to, they can be revived once per run. When Remielle is the active character, she <color=#2BAD00>restores1.6 Energy per second</color>. When triggering <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#2BAD00>gains 3</color> special <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflare</color>. After Remiel uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Rainbow's End</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace</color>, damage taken is reduced by 80% for 3 seconds.
ZKItem_4321011_Desc: Sigrid's exclusive Tactical Prism. All squad members gain 40% Cacophony Shield reduction efficiency.The duration of the Stunned state inflicted on The Hound - Ulidim when any squad member attacks it and causes it to become Stunned is increased by 12s. DMG dealt by all squad members to The Hound - Ulidim is increased by 30%. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color> state, the Energy Cost of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> is reduced to <color=#FFFFFF>40</color>; when hit by an enemy attack while using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Sigrid will block with her shield. If the block is successful, the incoming attack DMG is negated, her own attacks ignore <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> of the target's DEF for <color=#FFFFFF>30</color>s, the <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color> state is refreshed, and she gains one use of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>; after a successful block, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to trigger the corresponding stage of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>.
ZKItem_4321012_Desc:
Etheric Phantom: Scorpse deals 50% more DMG. When another squad member uses an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Norma <color=#2BAD00>immediately gains 100% Preheated Chamber</color>. This effect can trigger once every 40s.
When any Agent uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, that Agent's <color=#2BAD00>Decibel Generation Rate increases by 25%</color> for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
ZKItem_4321013_Desc: The map will mark the locations of some unopened eletric strongboxes. Upon triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color> with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Pyrois <color=#2BAD00>recovers 10 Energy and 20 Solar Prominence</color>.
ZKItem_4321014_Desc: While Cacophony Soundscape is active, Promeia's DMG increases by 15%. When Promeia triggers <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>restores 15 additional</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>, and when triggering <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>recovers 15 additional</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>. When triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>Abloom DMG increases by 6%</color>, stacking up to 10 times, lasting 60s.
ZKItem_4321015_Desc: When using Etheric Phantom to enter stealth, stealth duration is extended by 3s. After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Viper Strike</color> effect: When any Non-<color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> attack hits an enemy, it <color=#2BAD00>triggers a free special <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color></color> that cannot inflict Daze. This effect can be triggered once every 1s and lasts for 6s.
ZKItem_4321016_Desc: When Etheric Phantom is used, Aria immediately recovers 800 Decibels. After Aria completes her EX Special Attack, the <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> generated on the field <color=#2BAD00>increases by 1</color>, and EX Special Attack: Instantly Hooked does not consume Energy.
ZKItem_4321017_Desc: When the Etheric Phantom: Sobek effect ends, each squad member recovers HP equal to 10% of their remaining Shield from that effect. When Yuzuha uses her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Mastery increases by 40</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When either attack hits an enemy, it reduces the target's <color=#2BAD00>DEF by 18%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>All-Attribute RES by 15%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
ZKItem_4321018_Desc: After opening an Electronic Strongbox, all squad members gain a Shield equal to 15% of their Max HP for 60s. This effect does not stack, and the same Strongbox cannot trigger it more than once. After Ju Fufu uses <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron</color>, if she is not the active character, she launches one <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color>, circling the enemy and performing the fourth hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>. The skill's DMG is considered <color=#2BAD00>Aftershock DMG</color>. <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt increases by 75%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Daze dealt increases by 45%</color>.
ZKItem_4321018_Name: [Fragile][Ju Fufu] Mountain King Banishes Evil - Lv.50
ZKItem_4321019_Desc: After using Phase Dash, Evelyn recovers 1 Burning Tether Point. When any squad member's <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color> hits enemies, Evelyn restores <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>. When Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Points</color> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>, it will be replaced by <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Entanglement</color>, significantly reducing skill duration. When Evelyn's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits enemies, <color=#2BAD00>the skill's DMG increases by 80%</color>.
ZKItem_4321020_Desc: When Etheric Phantom is used, Jane immediately recovers 100 points of Passion Stream. {AWAKEN_1261#<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep</color> will be enhanced to <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Onslaught</color>, greatly increasing its DMG Multiplier and Anomaly Buildup.} {NOAWAKEN_1261#<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep</color> will be enhanced to <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Onslaught</color>}. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
ZKItem_4321021_Desc: While Roaming is active, the Cacophony Soundscape's Corruption is reduced to 70% of its original value. When triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>Abloom DMG increases by 6%</color>, stacking up to 10 times, lasting 60s.

This blueprint can be used to unlock the crafting of Cissia's exclusive Tactical Prism at the Smart Workshop. Purchase them from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.

After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Viper Strike</color> effect: When any Non-<color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> attack hits an enemy, it <color=#2BAD00>triggers a free special <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color></color> that cannot inflict Daze. This effect can be triggered once every 1s and lasts for 6s.
ZKItem_4350516_Desc:
This blueprint can be used to unlock the crafting of Aria's exclusive Tactical Prism at the Smart Workshop. Purchase them from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.

ZKItem_4350517_Desc:
This blueprint can be used to unlock the crafting of Yuzuha's exclusive Tactical Prism at the Smart Workshop. Purchase them from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.

Repeated triggers reset the duration. When either attack hits an enemy, it reduces the target's <color=#2BAD00>DEF by 18%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>All-Attribute RES by 15%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
ZKItem_4350518_Desc:
This blueprint can be used to unlock the crafting of Ju Fufu's exclusive Tactical Prism at the Smart Workshop. Purchase them from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.

After Ju Fufu uses <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron</color>, if she is not the active character, she launches one <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color>, circling the enemy and performing the 4th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>. The skill's DMG is considered <color=#2BAD00>Aftershock DMG</color>, and the <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt increases by 75%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Daze dealt increases by 45%</color>.

ZKItem_4350519_Desc:

When any squad member's <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color> hits enemies, Evelyn restores <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>. When Evelyn's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits enemies, <color=#2BAD00>the skill's DMG increases by 80%</color>.
ZKItem_4350520_Desc:
This blueprint can be used to unlock the crafting of Jane's exclusive Tactical Prism at the Smart Workshop. Purchase them from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.

This blueprint can be used to unlock the crafting of Ellen's exclusive Tactical Prism at the Smart Workshop. Purchase them from Boojee's Store - Season Limited.

Agents inside <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color> gain <color=#2BAD00>increased Anti-Interrupt Level</color> and take <color=#2BAD00>30% less DMG</color>. These effects persist for 5s after leaving <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>.
