ZKItem_4360001_Desc: A special crystal infused with Ether energy. Its black-and-russet surface resembles hematite. It feels warm to the touch, as though it could explode at any moment...
ZKItem_4360002_Desc: A stable voltage divider manufactured by Useful Works. Widely used in civilian and industrial systems, it automatically regulates current to keep output voltage within a safe range.
ZKItem_4360003_Desc: A ring made from Porcelume and certified by Buyan as a cultural specialty of the Waifei Peninsula. Rumor has it that wearing ten at once will earn you a special nickname among the locals: "Moneybags!"
ZKItem_4360004_Desc: A circuit core produced by the Marcel Group and widely used in Bangboo manufacturing and other devices. Tiny, yet surprisingly durable!
ZKItem_4360005_Desc: A storage unit produced by the Marcel Group and widely used in Bangboo manufacturing and other devices. Available in multiple capacities, including 128 GB and 256 GB.
ZKItem_4360006_Desc: A specialized HIA detector capable of tuning itself to track different signal types. Its only flaw is that users can never seem to decide whether to look through the eyepiece or at the screen.
ZKItem_4360007_Desc: HIA's Zenless Limit Meter is an essential device for monitoring Hollow activity. Hollows may have limits, but an investigator's journey never ends!
ZKItem_4360008_Desc: A classified data terminal recovered from the Hollow. It appears to have belonged to a Defense Force unit. Unauthorized access is prohibited. But if you absolutely must peek, make it quick!
ZKItem_4360009_Desc: A tactical computer issued by the Defense Force. Shockproof, waterproof, and dustproof, it is capable of handling all kinds of operations. But whatever you do, do NOT press the red button!
ZKItem_4360010_Desc: HIA's Hollow Observation Data Orb functions much like an Observation Data Pile. It's easier to carry, but its battery drains much faster, so recovering it often requires additional personnel.
ZKItem_4360011_Desc: A videotape of Starlight Knight: Collector's Edition. This special commemorative edition from the Starlight Knights' planet of origin features exclusive combat highlights of the three knights battling "Black Hole," along with a professional breakdown of the Starlight Knight flying kick. The ultimate dream collectible for every Starlight Knight fan!
ZKItem_4360012_Desc: A one-of-a-kind piece by a mysterious artist. Delicate brushwork recasts Dullahan as an elegant noblewoman, while rich layers of color convey both grace and strength. Anyone who sees it can only wonder: "What the hell is this?"
ZKItem_4360013_Desc: A collection of classic tearjerkers from Fugue Music. Maybe Ether Corruption got to the record, because these songs go beyond sadness. They're chilling enough to leave you craving hotpot just to warm up.
ZKItem_4360014_Desc: A custom Chan Accessory, certified by Buyan as authentic Waifei Peninsula jewelry. What does the Chan symbolize? Ask around. Traditionalists claim it wards off disaster and evil, while younger buyers prefer the idea of wealth sticking to its wearer.
ZKItem_4360015_Desc: An old Signal Search TV from an unknown brand. Its signal is highly unstable, but the aging picture tube gives the image a unique texture beloved by many art-loving Bangboos.
ZKItem_4360016_Desc: A home console jointly produced by Godfinger. It supports classics like Bizarre Brigade, Soul Hounds III, and Snake Duel, making it a favorite among the Bangboos at the research station.
ZKItem_4360017_Desc: A solid-gold figurine by a mysterious artist. The little Bangboo sits with its eyes covered, having abandoned its search for the meaning of boo-life and chosen instead to hide from reality...
ZKItem_4360018_Desc: A solid-gold figurine by a mysterious artist. The seated Bangboo begins to ponder the meaning of boo-life, only to find its strength slowly drained by pressure from Dennies, its master, friends, and family...
ZKItem_4360019_Desc: A solid-gold figurine by a mysterious artist. Beneath its smooth curves lies the boundless lust for gold shared by humans, Bangboos, and all living things. Slurp...
ZKItem_4360020_Desc: Proof of being the strongest hunter in the Divine Maze!
ZKItem_4360021_Desc: A visitor from another world! The Lordly Trashcan!
ZKItem_4360022_Desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. A tiny little cabbage, the palest in the patch and the greenest of the bunch.
ZKItem_4360023_Desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. Potatoboo and Pepperboo are his eldest and second-eldest brothers.
ZKItem_4360024_Desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. What can this little Boonip do for you?
ZKItem_4360025_Desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. You're the one who looks like a durian! Your whole family looks like durians!
ZKItem_4360026_Desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. Going coco-loco!
ZKItem_4360027_Desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. This melon comes with a ripeness guarantee.
ZKItem_4360028_Desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. Art is broccoli!
ZKItem_4360029_Desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. Have you seen my good friend, Eggboo?
ZKItem_4360030_Desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. Rumor has it that holding it over an open flame might turn it into Popcornboo.
ZKItem_4360031_Desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. Fill Nitro-Fuel with fizz, take a sip and feel the zip!
ZKItem_4360032_Desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. I've got fried dumplings on my head and scallions on my face!
ZKItem_4360033_Desc: A Bangboo figurine from Sān-Z STUDIO. Hot pot makes you hiss and huff; custard pudding cools you off!
ZKItem_4360034_Desc: A desk alarm clock from Sān-Z STUDIO. Its midnight-black finish and the soothing "Ehn-ne-ne" white noise make for the perfect end to the day.
ZKItem_4360035_Desc: A desk alarm clock from Sān-Z STUDIO. Its sunrise-orange finish and the cheerful "Ehn-ne, ehn-ne" alarm mark the perfect start to the day.
ZKItem_4360036_Desc: A long-range radio phone from Sān-Z STUDIO. Making a call? Make it on a Boo-rick Phone! Whether it's gossip, complaints, or whispered secrets, it'll blow you away!
ZKItem_4360037_Desc: A long-range radio phone from Sān-Z STUDIO. Making a call? Make it on a Boo-rick Phone! Whether it's gossip, complaints, or whispered secrets, it'll blow you away!
ZKItem_4360038_Desc:
Appears in <color=#FFAF2C>Cacophony Soundscape's corrupted containers</color>.
Dangerous and scary fangs with hypnotic and eccentric eyes... (It cannot be used as a bottle opener.) Can be used for plan development.
ZKItem_4360039_Desc: The Tyrfing Card ranks at the bottom in power, but using enough copies at once may produce unexpected results.
ZKItem_4360040_Desc: Questions about the maze? Ask the Mystic Conch!
ZKItem_4360041_Desc: A large ring fashioned from ruby. A Buyan-certified Eridu antique. Slip it on, and labels like "old money" and "noble" practically appear over your head.
ZKItem_4360042_Desc: A custom Blood Cicada pendant certified by Buyan as Waifei-style jewelry. Where cicadas usually represent good fortune, the Blood Cicada warns its wearer to protect their legacy and home.
ZKItem_4360043_Desc: A desk clock from Sān-Z STUDIO, finished in a white reminiscent of dawn in early winter. It chimes "Ehn-ne-ne" on the hour, making it the perfect way to mark a full year of hard work.
ZKItem_4360044_Desc: A long-range radio phone from Sān-Z STUDIO. Making a call? Make it a Boo-rick Phone! Whether you're ranting, chatting, or whispering secrets, it'll blow you away!
ZKItem_4360045_Desc: An old closed-circuit television from an unknown brand. The label says it requires a signal cable to output video, yet there is no signal input port anywhere on the set...
ZKItem_4360046_Desc:
Appears in containers after making a <color=#FFAF2C>Tycoon Investor investment in a High-Risk Investigation</color>.
A shard of a crystal containing special Ether energy. Its surface resembles a red-hot chunk of coal, radiating intense heat and danger. Can be used for plan development.
ZKItem_4360087_Desc: A specially made detector from the HIA, now locked onto the Ether signal connected to hematite...
ZKItem_4360088_Desc: A radar tuned to a special search frequency that seems to lead people toward high-value areas in the Divine Maze.
ZKItem_4360089_Desc: A Fugue production — the anniversary edition of a classic tearjerker ballad. Due to Ether interference, it's bizarrely developed a refrigerating effect. Just one bar of the melody is enough to chill you to the bone and send you sneezing non-stop...
ZKItem_4360090_Desc: A TV stuck on loop, blasting some seriously creepy audio.
ZKItem_4360091_Desc: Besides the classified HAND documents, there seem to be some... literary works in there that'll make you blush, your heart race, and maybe even leave you with a look of utter confusion.
ZKItem_4360092_Desc: A specially made detector from the HIA, now locked onto the Ether signal connected to hematite...
ZKItem_4360093_Desc: An access card scratched from a scratch card at a newsstand in the illusion. Perhaps the prize is hidden somewhere within the area it grants access to?
ZKItem_4360094_Desc: A shard of Labyrinth Carrot, a special device once carried by Joyous. Rumor has it that this remarkable invention can chart routes through the Papago Hollow without relying on Rosetta Data.
ZKItem_4360095_Desc: A signal transmitter used to pinpoint an Unknown Bangboo's signal. Once activated, it periodically emits scanning signals. Activate multiple transmitters to obtain a precise location signal of the target.
ZKItem_4360096_Desc: （This line seems to have been cut）
ZKItem_4360097_Desc: A Blasting storage unit specially made for repairing Boorilliant. Looks identical to any standard storage unit, except the connector is some outdated spec that was retired decades ago… (For the love of all things holy, just standardize every single connector already!)
ZKItem_4360098_Desc: A special crystal used to unlock spatial fissures in the lava zone. Scorching hot and dangerous — keep away from children and pets...
ZKItem_4360099_Desc: Opens the large elevator to the Lower Level of Suburbs Illusion. The back of the card appears to list the booking hotline for Bunless Bae Town's logistics company, Hops and Skips...
ZKItem_4363501_Desc: A Carrot chip created from Hollow observation data. Without protective encapsulation, exposure to Ether fluctuations — such as those encountered while passing through long-distance spatial fissures — may cause packet loss or complete failure.
ZKItem_4363502_Desc: A fully encapsulated and locked Carrot chip capable of safely leaving the Hollow through a spatial fissure.
ZKItem_4363503_Desc: Research station logistics records indicate that a valuable item was stored here, but its details can no longer be verified...

ZKItem_Desc_YiTi_Charge_A:
When equipped, this item grants three Alter Skills: Perfect Block, Phase Dash, and Powerful Slash.

[Perfect Block Enhancement]
Enhancement I: When Powerful Slash hits a normal/elite/boss enemy, it reduces squad Corruption by <color=#2BAD00>10%/30%/60%</color> and restores <color=#2BAD00>2.5%/3.5%/5%</color> HP to all squad members, respectively.

Enhancement II: Perfect Block triggers a Dodge even if the block fails.

Against enemies at <color=#CF4029>Lv. 60 or higher</color>, <color=#CF4029>Powerslash</color> deals <color=#CF4029>50%</color> less DMG.

ZKItem_Desc_YiTi_Dash_A:
When equipped, this item grants three Alter Skills: Perfect Block, Phase Dash, and Powerful Slash.

[Phase Dash Enhancement] 
Enhancement I: If the target has an enhanced Cacophony Shield, the Shield is reduced by an additional <color=#2BAD00>100%/50%/30%</color> for normal/elite/boss enemies, respectively. Powerful Slash increases Daze buildup against normal/elite/boss enemies that have not entered combat by an additional <color=#2BAD00>100%/30%/15%</color>, respectively.

Enhancement II: Defeating a boss enemy restores 1 use of Blade of the Other.

Against enemies at <color=#CF4029>Lv. 60 or higher</color>, <color=#CF4029>Powerful Slash</color> deals <color=#CF4029>50%</color> less DMG.

ZKRelic_13700110_des: Ellen's exclusive Tactical Prism. While Roaming is active, the Cacophony Soundscape's Corruption is reduced to 70% of its original value. When Ellen uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>leaves Icy Mist on the ground</color>, dealing continuous <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> for 15s. Agents inside <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color> gain <color=#2BAD00>increased Anti-Interrupt Level</color> and take <color=#2BAD00>30% less DMG</color>. These effects persist for 5s after leaving <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>. When Ellen hits an enemy inside <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color> deals one additional instance of DMG.
ZKRelic_13700210_des: Jane's exclusive Tactical Prism. When Etheric Phantom is used, Jane immediately recovers 100 points of Passion Stream. {AWAKEN_1261#<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep</color> will be enhanced to <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Onslaught</color>, greatly increasing its DMG Multiplier and Anomaly Buildup.} {NOAWAKEN_1261#<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep</color> will be enhanced to <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Onslaught</color>}. When this skill hits an enemy, it inflicts <color=#FFFFFF>Wound</color>. This state causes the affected target to take <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> equal to 60% of Jane's ATK every second and accumulate <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup</color>, lasting 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
ZKRelic_13700310_des: Hoshimi Miyabi's exclusive Tactical Prism. After Hoshimi Miyabi executes a Powerful Slash on an enemy, she immediately restores 1 Fallen Frost point. Enemies afflicted with <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> <color=#2BAD00>take <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color> equal to 260% of Hoshimi Miyabi's ATK per second</color>. Upon triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn - Break</color>, Hoshimi Miyabi can bypass the restrictions of <color=#FFFFFF>Frostburn</color> and <color=#2BAD00>immediately reapply <color=#FFFFFF>Icefire</color> to enemies</color>.
ZKRelic_13700410_des: Evelyn's exclusive Tactical Prism. After using Phase Dash, Evelyn recovers 1 Burning Tether Point. When any squad member's <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color> hits enemies, Evelyn restores <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>. When Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Points</color> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>, it will be replaced by <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Entanglement</color>, significantly reducing skill duration. When Evelyn's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits enemies, <color=#2BAD00>the skill's DMG increases by 80%</color>.
ZKRelic_13700510_des: Astra Yao's exclusive Tactical Prism. Medicine takes effect immediately. During the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, characters with <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> specialty gain <color=#2BAD00>30% increased CRIT DMG</color>, characters with <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> specialty gain <color=#2BAD00>60 increased Anomaly Proficiency</color>, and characters with Rupture specialty deal <color=#2BAD00>15% increased Sheer DMG</color>. When the active character hits enemies with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#2BAD00>Astra Yao will regenerates 4 Energy</color> and <color=#2BAD00>perform an additional attack with <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color></color>. The Energy Generation effect can be triggered once per second.
ZKRelic_13700610_des: Ju Fufu's exclusive Tactical Prism. After opening an Electronic Strongbox, all squad members gain a Shield equal to 15% of their Max HP for 60s. This effect does not stack, and the same Strongbox cannot trigger it more than once. After Ju Fufu uses <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron</color>, if she is not the active character, she launches one <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color>, circling the enemy and performing the 4th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>. The skill's DMG is considered <color=#2BAD00>Aftershock DMG</color>, and the <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt increases by 75%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Daze dealt increases by 45%</color>.
ZKRelic_13700710_des: Yixuan's exclusive Tactical Prism. When triggering a Perfect Block, Yixuan immediately recovers 60 Adrenaline. While charging for EX Special Attack: Ink Manifestation, Perfect Block can be triggered, after which additionally restores 15 Technique Points and gains <color=#2BAD00>18% DMG boost</color> that lasts for 15s. Each Perfect Block against an enemy increases the next Ultimate <color=#2BAD00>DMG by an additional 20%</color>, stacking up to 3 times.
ZKRelic_13700810_des: Yuzuha's exclusive Tactical Prism. When the Etheric Phantom: Sobek effect ends, each squad member recovers HP equal to 10% of their remaining Shield from that effect. When Yuzuha uses her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Mastery increases by 40</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When either attack hits an enemy, it reduces the target's <color=#2BAD00>DEF by 18%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>All-Attribute RES by 15%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
ZKRelic_13700910_des:
Lucia's exclusive Tactical Prism. When using Etheric Phantom, the squad's Corruption value is greatly reduced. When Lucia upgrades a skill or uses an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, she gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Surge</color>, stacking up to 4 times.
Upon exiting the <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, all <color=#FFFFFF>Surge</color> stacks will be consumed, where each consumed stack <color=#2BAD00>regenerates 10 Energy for herself</color>.
ZKRelic_13701010_des: Dialyn's exclusive Tactical Prism. When dealing DMG to enemies using Etheric Phantom, applies a certain amount of Daze. If <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> drop below 90, immediately <color=#2BAD00>restores 60 Positive Reviews</color> and <color=#2BAD00>restores squad members' Decibels by 750</color>. This effect can be triggered once every 30s.
ZKRelic_13701110_des: Ye Shunguang's exclusive Tactical Prism. After using Etheric Phantom: Primordial Nightmare, the incoming Agent's Chain Attack is replaced with their Ultimate. After entering Enlightened Mind, the first use of Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum <color=#2BAD00>grants 3 Qingming Sword Force</color> and <color=#2BAD00>ignores 45% of the enemy's Physical RES</color> for 15s.
ZKRelic_13701210_des: Aria's exclusive Tactical Prism. When Etheric Phantom is used, Aria immediately recovers 800 Decibels. After Aria completes her EX Special Attack, the <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> generated on the field <color=#2BAD00>increases by 1</color>, and EX Special Attack: Instantly Hooked does not consume Energy.
ZKRelic_13701310_des: Sunna's exclusive Tactical Prism. When Etheric Phantom is used, Sunna immediately recovers 60 Energy. When Sunna's Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise is active, all squad members <color=#2BAD00>deal 80% more DMG</color> with their Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Dodge Counter, Special Attack, and EX Special Attack.
ZKRelic_13701410_des: Cissia's exclusive Tactical Prism. When using Etheric Phantom to enter Stealth, Stealth duration is extended by 3s. After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, gains the <color=#FFFFFF>Viper Strike</color> effect: When any Non-<color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> attack hits an enemy, it <color=#2BAD00>triggers a free special <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color></color> that cannot inflict Daze. This effect can be triggered once every 1s and lasts for 6s.
ZKRelic_13701510_des: Nangong Yu's exclusive Tactical Prism. Nangong Yu's precise charging deals 20% more Daze. If your Inventory contains a Valuable, Etheric Phantom: Scorched Horizon increases the Stun DMG Multiplier of enemies it hits by 30%. When Nangong Yu triggers Precise Charging, all squad members <color=#2BAD00>recover 4 Energy</color>. Whenever any squad member uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, all squad members recover 120 Decibels.
ZKRelic_13701610_des: Promeia's exclusive Tactical Prism. While Cacophony Soundscape is active, Promeia's DMG increases by 15%. When Promeia triggers <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>restores 15 additional</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>, and when triggering <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>recovers 15 additional</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>. When triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>Abloom DMG increases by 6%</color>, stacking up to 10 times, lasting 60s.
ZKRelic_13701710_des: Pyrois's exclusive Tactical Prism. The map will mark the locations of some unopened Electronic Strongboxes. Upon triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color> with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Pyrois <color=#2BAD00>recovers 10 Energy and 20 Solar Prominence</color>.
ZKRelic_13701810_des:
Norma's exclusive Tactical Prism. Etheric Phantom: Scorpse deals 50% more DMG. When another squad member uses an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Norma <color=#2BAD00>immediately gains 100% Preheated Chamber</color>. This effect can trigger once every 40s.
When any Agent uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, that Agent's <color=#2BAD00>Decibel Generation Rate increases by 25%</color> for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
ZKRelic_13701910_des: Velina's exclusive Tactical Prism. Using Etheric Phantom: Unfathomable deals additional Abloom DMG. While <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> is on the field, all squad members' <color=#2BAD00>Energy Generation Rate increases by 40% and Decibel Generation Rate by 30%</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> <color=#2BAD00>lasts 3s longer</color>.
ZKRelic_13702010_des: When an Agent in the team takes fatal damage, if there are other Agents available to switch to, they can be revived once per run. When Remielle is the active character, she <color=#2BAD00>restores1.6 Energy per second</color>. When triggering <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#2BAD00>gains 3</color> special <color=#FFFFFF>Voidflare</color>. After Remiel uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Rainbow's End</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Fleeting Grace</color>, damage taken is reduced by 80% for 3 seconds.
ZKRelic_13702110_des: All squad members gain 40% Cacophony Shield reduction efficiency.The duration of the Stunned state inflicted on The Hound - Ulidim when any squad member attacks it and causes it to become Stunned is increased by 12s. DMG dealt by all squad members to The Hound - Ulidim is increased by 30%. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color> state, the Energy Cost of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> is reduced to <color=#FFFFFF>40</color>; when hit by an enemy attack while using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Sigrid will block with her shield. If the block is successful, the incoming attack DMG is negated, her own attacks ignore <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> of the target's DEF for <color=#FFFFFF>30</color>s, the <color=#FFFFFF>Aerial Patrol Spear</color> state is refreshed, and she gains one use of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>; after a successful block, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to trigger the corresponding stage of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Converging Spear</color>.

ZK_System_Des_001:
<color=#FFFFFF>Investigation Commissions</color>
- Investigation Commissions include <color=#D9A600>Primary</color> and <color=#D9A600>Secondary</color> Commissions. Complete them to claim rewards.
- Complete <color=#D9A600>Primary</color> Commissions to gradually unlock more content in Enigma of the Labyrinth.

<color=#FFFFFF>Weekly Commissions</color>
- Complete Weekly Commissions to earn <color=#D9A600>Bounty Points</color>.
- Earn Bounty Points each week to claim rewards from <color=#D9A600>Bounty Commissions</color>.
- After the Porcelloy Hub reaches <color=#D9A600>Lv. 3</color>, the Weekly Commission lineup will expand the following week, giving you more Weekly Commissions to choose from.
- Bounty Points can be earned in both Enigma of the Labyrinth and Hollow Zero: Lost Void. Weekly Commissions, Bounty Points, and Bounty Commission rewards <color=#D9A600>reset every week</color>.

<color=#FFFFFF>Season Commissions</color>
- Season Commissions have multiple phases. Complete all commissions in the previous phase and reach the required Season level to unlock the next phase.
- Season Commissions <color=#D9A600>reset with each season</color>. Complete them and claim their rewards before the season ends.
ZK_System_Des_002:
- Boojee's Store consists of four sections: Treasures Counter, Permanent Store, Blueprint Direct Sale, and Season Limited.
- The Season Limited section refreshes its stock each season. Stock in the other sections is permanent and does not reset.
ZK_System_Des_003:
- Displays every badge the Proxy has <color=#D9A600>earned</color> in Enigma of the Labyrinth.
- Complete the objective associated with the Season Badge to earn it.
- Badges not earned when the season ends will not be displayed.
ZK_System_Des_004:
- Collect the required number of items under each tab to claim the progress rewards.
- Each Valuable item also has its own Collection Rewards to claim, in addition to the tab's overall progress rewards.

ZenkovWhenyouget1million_Desc_Map1Lv1: When the total value of Supplies extracted in a single run reaches 200,000 Gear Coins, Boojee will trigger a Boojee Reward, giving you a chance to draw high-value Supplies from the Reward Preview. Additionally, reaching extraction values of 600K, 1M, 1.8M, 2.6M, and 3.6M Gear Coins in a single run grants one additional draw opportunity each time, for a maximum of 6 draws.
ZenkovWhenyouget1million_Desc_Map1Lv2: When the total value of Supplies extracted in a single run reaches 200,000 Gear Coins, Boojee will trigger a [Tycoon Reward], giving you a chance to draw high-value Supplies from the [Reward Preview]. Additionally, each time your extracted Supplies value hits 600K, 1M, 1.8M, 2.6M, or 3.6M Gear Coins in a single run, you'll earn one extra draw opportunity — up to 7 times total.
ZenkovWhenyouget1million_Desc_Map1Lv3: In a single run, when the value of Supplies extracted reaches 200,000 Gear Coins, [Tycoon Reward] from Boojee is triggered, giving you a chance to draw high-value Supplies from the [Reward Preview]. ZenkovWhenyouget1million_Desc_Map1Lv4: In a single run, when the value of Supplies extracted reaches 200,000 Gear Coins, it triggers a [Tycoon Reward] from Boojee, giving you a chance to draw high-value Supplies from the [Reward Preview]. Zenkov_AreaType_01_Desc: The Porcelloy Hub scans indicate a high concentration of mechanical parts here, making this a good area for targeted salvage.
Zenkov_AreaType_02_Desc: The Porcelloy Hub scans indicate a high concentration of canned materials here, making this a good area for targeted salvage.

Zenkov_Area_01_Desc: The southern region of the Papago Hollow in the Divine Maze. It appears to be an area simulated from someone's memories of the Outer Ring.
Zenkov_Area_02_Desc: The southern region of the Papago Hollow in the Divine Maze. It appears to be a simulated area based on someone's memories of Blazewood in the Outer Ring. However, the Blazewood sign in their memory seems to be malfunctioning, as the words "Bunless Bae" can be seen throughout the simulated area.
Zenkov_Area_03_Desc: The southern region of the Papago Hollow in the Divine Maze. It appears to be a simulated area based on someone's memories of Fantasy Resort. The aquarium is especially prominent here, suggesting this area was simulated from the memories of a fishing enthusiast.
Zenkov_Area_04_Desc: The southern region of the Papago Hollow in the Divine Maze. It appears to be a simulated area based on someone's memories of a storage facility somewhere in the Outer Ring. The storage facility's layout closely resembles that of the oil company Bahamut.
Zenkov_Area_05_Desc: The northern region of the Papago Hollow in the Divine Maze. It appears to be a simulated area based on someone's memories of Sixth Street. HAND used voice input when entering the area's name, so it seems to have picked up a bit of an accent.
Zenkov_Area_06_Desc: The northern region of the Papago Hollow in the Divine Maze. It appears to be a simulated area based on someone's memories of Brant Street Construction Site. A large number of anti-war documents were discovered during the investigation, suggesting that the memories may have belonged to a pacifist, so the area was renamed Dove Street Construction Site.
Zenkov_Area_06_Evacuate: Evacuation Anchor: Dove Street Construction Site
Zenkov_Area_07_Desc: The northern region of the Papago Hollow in the Divine Maze. It appears to be a simulated area based on someone's memories of Lumina Square. The area's layout closely resembles Janus Quarter's early plans for the Lumina Central commercial district.

Zenkov_Exp_Context:
Earnings safely extracted from a stage will generate <color=#FFAF2C>Season Investigation Data</color> at a set rate, boosting your <color=#FFAF2C>Season Level</color> growth.
Every <color=#FFAF2C>5,000 points of earnings</color> earns you <color=#FFAF2C>1 point of Season Investigation Data</color>.
Loot more, extract safe, and level up your <color=#FFAF2C>Season Level</color> faster!
Zenkov_Hard4_Context:
On High-Risk difficulty, you can <color=#FFAF2C>invest Gear Coins</color> at the Tycoon Investor. The more you invest, the higher the chance of finding <color=#FFAF2C>high-value supplies</color> in the Hollow.
When your Gear Coin investment increases, the Hollow's exploration difficulty increases as well.
Prepare yourself, take on the ultimate challenge, and claim the greatest treasures!
